Returns true if the current running [Task](/gmod/Task) is finished. 
Tasks finish whenever [NPC:TaskComplete](/gmod/NPC:TaskComplete) is called, which sets `TASKSTATUS_COMPLETE` for all NPCs, also sets `self.bTaskComplete` for `ai` type [SENTs](Scripted_Entities).
NOTES: This hook only exists for `ai` type [SENTs](Scripted_Entities).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Is the current running Task is finished or not.

TaskTime.DESCRIPTION: Returns how many seconds we've been doing this current task
NOTES: This hook only exists for `ai` type [SENTs](Scripted_Entities).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: How many seconds we've been doing this current task

TestCollision.DESCRIPTION:
Allows you to override trace result when a trace hits the entity.

Your entity **must** have [Entity:EnableCustomCollisions](/gmod/Entity:EnableCustomCollisions) enabled for this hook to work.

Your entity must also be otherwise "hit-able" with a trace, so it should have [SOLID_OBB](/gmod/Enums/SOLID#SOLID_OBB) or [SOLID_VPHYSICS](/gmod/Enums/SOLID#SOLID_VPHYSICS) be set (as an example), and it must have its [collision bounds](/gmod/Entity:SetCollisionBounds) be set accordingly.
NOTES: This hook is called for `anim` type only.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: startpos
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Start position of the trace.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: delta
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Offset from startpos to the endpos of the trace.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: isbox
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Is the trace a hull trace?

ARGUMENTS.NAME: extents
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Size of the hull trace, with the center of the Bounding Box being `0, 0, 0`, so mins are `-extents`, and maxs are `extents`.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: mask
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The [CONTENTS](/gmod/Enums/CONTENTS) mask.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION:
Returning a `table` will allow you to override trace results. Table should contain the following keys: (All keys fallback to the original trace value)
* [Vector](/gmod/Vector) `HitPos` - The new hit position of the trace.
* [number](/gmod/number) `Fraction` - A number from `0` to `1`, describing how far the trace went from its origin point, `1` = did not hit.
  * Could be calculated like so : `Fraction = ( startpos + delta ):Length() / myCustomHitPos:Length()`
* [Vector](/gmod/Vector) `Normal` - A unit vector (length=1) describing the direction perpendicular to the hit surface.

Returning `true` will allow "normal" collisions to happen for `SOLID_VPHYSICS` and `SOLID_OBB` entities.
Returning `nothing` or `false` allows the trace to ignore the entity completely.

Think.DESCRIPTION:
Called every frame on the client.
Called about 5-6 times per second on the server.
NOTES:
You may need to call [Entity:Spawn](/gmod/Entity:Spawn) to get this hook to run server side.

You can force it to run at servers tickrate using the example below.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return `true` if you used [Entity:NextThink](/gmod/Entity:NextThink) to override the next execution time. Otherwise it will be reset to `CurTime() + 0.2`.

Touch.DESCRIPTION:
Called every tick for every entity being "touched". Touching is usually detected via AABB intersection checks using entity's [collision bounds](/gmod/Entity:GetCollisionBounds).

Entities like triggers would be using the touch hooks for their function.

See [Entity:PhysicsCollide](/gmod/Entity:PhysicsCollide) for physics based collision events.

See also [ENTITY:StartTouch](/gmod/ENTITY:StartTouch) and [ENTITY:EndTouch](/gmod/ENTITY:EndTouch).
NOTES: For physics enabled entities, this hook will **not** be ran while the entity's physics is asleep. See [PhysObj:Wake](/gmod/PhysObj:Wake).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: entity
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity that touched it.

TranslateActivity.DESCRIPTION: Called by the engine to alter NPC activities, if desired by the NPC.
NOTES: This hook only exists for `ai` type SENTs.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: oldAct
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The activity to translate.

RETURNS.NAME: newAct
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION:
The activity that should override the incoming activity. 

Not returning anything, or returning a non value will perform the [default action](https://github.com/ValveSoftware/source-sdk-2013/blob/master/src/game/server/ai_basenpc.cpp#L5976).

TranslateNavGoal.DESCRIPTION: Called by the engine to alter NPC's final position to reach its enemy or target. This is called twice for `GOALTYPE_PATHCORNER`; first is for the first path_corner and second for the next connected path_corner.
NOTES: This hook only exists for `ai` type SENTs.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: target
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The enemy being chased or the path_corner in query.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: currentGoal
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The target's origin.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION:
The actual point that NPC will move to reach its enemy or target. For the path to get updated, the new move path must be away from the current [NPC:GetGoalPos](/gmod/NPC:GetGoalPos) by 120 units.


Not returning anything, or returning a non vector will perform the [default action](https://github.com/ValveSoftware/source-sdk-2013/blob/master/src/game/server/ai_basenpc_schedule.cpp#L4251).

TranslateSchedule.DESCRIPTION: Called by the engine to alter NPC schedules, if desired by the NPC.
NOTES: This hook only exists for `ai` type SENTs.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: schedule
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The schedule to translate. See [SCHED](/gmod/Enums/SCHED).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION:
The schedule that should override the incoming schedule. 

Not returning anything, or returning a non value will perform the [default action](https://github.com/ValveSoftware/source-sdk-2013/blob/master/src/game/server/ai_default.cpp#L253).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: output
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Name of output to fire

ARGUMENTS.NAME: activator
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Activator entity

ARGUMENTS.NAME: data
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The data to give to the output.

UpdateTransmitState.DESCRIPTION: Called whenever the transmit state should be updated.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Transmit state to set, see [TRANSMIT](/gmod/Enums/TRANSMIT).

Use.DESCRIPTION:
Called when an entity "uses" this entity, for example a player pressing their `+use` key (default ) on this entity.

To change how often the hook is called, see [Entity:SetUseType](/gmod/Entity:SetUseType).
NOTES: This hook only works for `nextbot`, `ai` and `anim` scripted entity types.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: activator
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity that caused this input. This will usually be the player who pressed their use key.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: caller
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity responsible for the input. This will typically be the same as `activator` unless some other entity is acting as a proxy.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: useType
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Use type, see [USE](/gmod/Enums/USE).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: value
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Any passed value.

ENT.DESCRIPTION:
A list of hooks **only** available for [Scripted Entities](/gmod/Scripted%20Entities).

The exceptions to this rule are documented at [Custom Entity Fields](/gmod/Custom%20Entity%20Fields), which can be applied to all entities.

Some more "hooks" are available for all entities (including engine entities) with the function [Entity:AddCallback](/gmod/Entity:AddCallback).

See also: [Structures/ENT](/gmod/Structures/ENT)
NOTES: The hooks listed here are also dependent on the scripted entity type. For instance, a base scripted entity will not use [ENTITY:DoSchedule](/gmod/ENTITY:DoSchedule) at all, that is only for scripted NPCs

AcceptInput.DESCRIPTION:
Called when a map I/O event occurs.

See also [Entity:Fire](/gmod/Entity:Fire) and [Entity:Input](/gmod/Entity:Input) for functions to fire Inputs on entities.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Entity that receives the input

ARGUMENTS.NAME: input
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The input name. Is not guaranteed to be a valid input on the entity.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: activator
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Activator of the input

ARGUMENTS.NAME: caller
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Caller of the input

ARGUMENTS.NAME: value
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Data provided with the input. Will be either a [string](/gmod/string), a [number](/gmod/number), a [boolean](/gmod/boolean) or a [nil](/gmod/nil).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return true to prevent this input from being processed. Do not return otherwise.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: attacker
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The name of the attacker

ARGUMENTS.NAME: attackerTeam
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The team of the attacker

ARGUMENTS.NAME: inflictor
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Class name of the entity inflicting the damage

ARGUMENTS.NAME: victim
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Name of the victim

ARGUMENTS.NAME: victimTeam
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Team of the victim

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: `true/false` to prevent the notice from being shown. Do not return otherwise.

AdjustMouseSensitivity.DESCRIPTION: Allows you to adjust the mouse sensitivity.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: defaultSensitivity
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION:
The old sensitivity

In general it will be 0, which is equivalent to a sensitivity of 1.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: localFOV
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Player's current FOV.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: defaultFOV
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Default FOV.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION:
A fraction of the normal sensitivity (0.5 would be half as sensitive).

Return -1 to not override and prevent subsequent hooks and [WEAPON:AdjustMouseSensitivity](/gmod/WEAPON:AdjustMouseSensitivity) from running.  
Return [nil](/gmod/nil) to not override and allow subsequent hooks and [WEAPON:AdjustMouseSensitivity](/gmod/WEAPON:AdjustMouseSensitivity) to run.

AllowPlayerPickup.DESCRIPTION:
Called when a player tries to pick up something using the "use" key, return to override.

This hook will not be called if `sv_playerpickupallowed` is set to 0.

See [GM:GravGunPickupAllowed](/gmod/GM:GravGunPickupAllowed) for the Gravity Gun pickup variant.
See [GM:PhysgunPickup](/gmod/GM:PhysgunPickup) for the Physics Gun pickup variant.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player trying to pick up something.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The Entity the player attempted to pick up.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Allow the player to pick up the entity or not.

CalcMainActivity.DESCRIPTION: This hook is used to calculate animations for a player.
WARNINGS: This hook must return the same values at the same time on both, client **and** server. On client for players to see the animations, on server for hit detection to work properly.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player to apply the animation.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: vel
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The velocity of the player.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: [ACT](/gmod/Enums/ACT) for the activity the player should use. A nil return will be treated as ACT_INVALID.
Sequence for the player to use. This takes precedence over the activity (the activity is still used for layering). Return -1 or nil to let the activity determine the sequence.

CalcVehicleView.DESCRIPTION:
Called from [GM:CalcView](/gmod/GM:CalcView) when player is in driving a vehicle.

This hook may not be called in gamemodes that override [GM:CalcView](/gmod/GM:CalcView).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: veh
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The vehicle the player is driving

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The vehicle driver

ARGUMENTS.NAME: view
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The view data containing players FOV, view position and angles, see [Structures/CamData](/gmod/Structures/CamData)

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The modified view table containing new values, see [Structures/CamData](/gmod/Structures/CamData)

CalcView.DESCRIPTION: Allows override of the default view.
NOTES: To avoid breaking compatibility with other addons, it is recommended to add onto the origin and angle values using [Vector:Add](/gmod/Vector:Add) or [Angle:Add](/gmod/Angle:Add) instead of overriding them completely.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The local player.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: origin
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player's view position.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: angles
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player's view angles.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: fov
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Field of view.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: znear
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Distance to near clipping plane.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: zfar
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Distance to far clipping plane.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: View data table. See [Structures/CamData](/gmod/Structures/CamData).

CalcViewModelView.DESCRIPTION: Allows overriding the position and angle of the viewmodel.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: wep
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The weapon entity

ARGUMENTS.NAME: vm
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The viewmodel entity

ARGUMENTS.NAME: oldPos
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Original position (before viewmodel bobbing and swaying)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: oldAng
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Original angle (before viewmodel bobbing and swaying)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: pos
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Current position

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ang
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Current angle

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: New position
New angle

CanCreateUndo.DESCRIPTION: Called whenever a players tries to create an undo.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player who tried to create something.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: undo
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The undo table as a [Structures/Undo](/gmod/Structures/Undo).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return false to disallow creation of the undo.

CanEditVariable.DESCRIPTION:
Called when a variable is about to be edited on an Entity (called by `Edit Properties...` menu), to determine if the edit should be permitted.

See [Editable entities](/gmod/Editable_Entities) for more details about the system.

By default, Sandbox will also call [ENTITY:CanEditVariables](/gmod/ENTITY:CanEditVariables) if no hook returns a value.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity being edited.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player doing the editing.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: key
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The name of the variable.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: value
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The new value, as a string which will later be converted to its appropriate type.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: editor
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The edit table defined in [Entity:NetworkVar](/gmod/Entity:NetworkVar).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return `false` to disallow editing.

CanExitVehicle.DESCRIPTION:
Determines if the player can exit the vehicle on their own. [Player:ExitVehicle](/gmod/Player:ExitVehicle) will bypass this hook.

See [GM:CanPlayerEnterVehicle](/gmod/GM:CanPlayerEnterVehicle) for the opposite hook.  
See also [GM:PlayerLeaveVehicle](/gmod/GM:PlayerLeaveVehicle) for a hook that will be called whenever a player exits any vehicle for any reason.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: veh
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The vehicle entity

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: True if the player can exit the vehicle.

CanPlayerEnterVehicle.DESCRIPTION:
Determines whether or not a given player player can enter the given vehicle. [Player:EnterVehicle](/gmod/Player:EnterVehicle) will still call this hook.

Called just before [GM:PlayerEnteredVehicle](/gmod/GM:PlayerEnteredVehicle). See also [GM:CanExitVehicle](/gmod/GM:CanExitVehicle).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: player
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player that wants to enter a vehicle.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: vehicle
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The vehicle in question.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: role
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The seat number.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: `false` if the player is not allowed to enter the vehicle.

CanPlayerSuicide.DESCRIPTION: Determines if the player can kill themselves using the `kill` or `explode` console commands.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: player
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: `true` if the player should be allowed to suicide, `false` if not.

CanPlayerUnfreeze.DESCRIPTION: Determines if the player can unfreeze the entity.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: player
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player

ARGUMENTS.NAME: entity
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity

ARGUMENTS.NAME: phys
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The physics object of the entity

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: True if they can unfreeze.

CanProperty.DESCRIPTION: Controls if a [property](/gmod/properties) can be used or not.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Player, that tried to use the property

ARGUMENTS.NAME: property
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Class of the property that is tried to use, for example - bonemanipulate
WARNINGS: This is not guaranteed to be the internal property name used in [properties.Add](/gmod/properties.Add)!

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity, on which property is tried to be used on

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return false to disallow using that property

CanUndo.DESCRIPTION: Called whenever a players tries to undo.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player who tried to undo something.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: undo
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The undo table as a [Structures/Undo](/gmod/Structures/Undo).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return false to disallow the undo.

CaptureVideo.DESCRIPTION: Called each frame to record demos to video using [IVideoWriter](/gmod/IVideoWriter).
NOTES: This hook is called every frame regardless of whether or not a demo is being recorded

ChatText.DESCRIPTION:
Called when a message is printed to the chat box. Note, that this isn't working with player messages even though there are arguments for it.

For player messages see [GM:PlayerSay](/gmod/GM:PlayerSay) and [GM:OnPlayerChat](/gmod/GM:OnPlayerChat)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: index
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The index of the player.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: name
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The name of the player.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: text
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The text that is being sent.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: type
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION:
Chat filter type. Possible values are:
* `joinleave` - Player join and leave messages
* `namechange` - Player name change messages
* `servermsg` - Server messages such as convar changes
* `teamchange` - Team changes?
* `chat` - (Obsolete?) Player chat? Seems to trigger when server console uses the `say` command
* `none` - A fallback value

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return true to suppress the chat message.

ChatTextChanged.DESCRIPTION: Called whenever the content of the user's chat input box is changed.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: text
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The new contents of the input box

CheckPassword.DESCRIPTION:
Called when a **non local player** connects to allow the Lua system to check the password.

The default behaviour in the base gamemodes emulates what would normally happen. If `sv_password` is set and its value matches the password passed in by the client (via `password` concommand) - then they are allowed to join. If `sv_password` isn't set it lets them in too.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: steamID64
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The 64bit Steam ID of the joining player, use [util.SteamIDFrom64](/gmod/util.SteamIDFrom64) to convert it to a `STEAM_0:` one.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ipAddress
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The IP of the connecting client

ARGUMENTS.NAME: svPassword
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The current value of sv_password (the password set by the server)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: clPassword
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The password provided by the client

ARGUMENTS.NAME: name
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The name of the joining player

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: If the hook returns `false` then the player is disconnected

If returning false in the first argument, then this should be the disconnect message. This will default to `#GameUI_ServerRejectBadPassword`, which is `Bad Password.` translated to the client's language.

ClientSignOnStateChanged.DESCRIPTION: Called when a player's sign on state changes.

BUGS.DESCRIPTION: You cannot get a valid player object from the userID at any point during this hook.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: userID
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The userID of the player whose sign on state has changed.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: oldState
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The previous sign on state. See [SIGNONSTATE](/gmod/Enums/SIGNONSTATE) enums.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: newState
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The new/current sign on state. See [SIGNONSTATE](/gmod/Enums/SIGNONSTATE) enums.

CloseDermaMenus.DESCRIPTION: Called when derma menus are closed with [CloseDermaMenus](/gmod/Global.CloseDermaMenus).

CreateClientsideRagdoll.DESCRIPTION:
Called whenever an entity becomes a clientside ragdoll.

See [GM:CreateEntityRagdoll](/gmod/GM:CreateEntityRagdoll) for serverside ragdolls.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: entity
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The Entity that created the ragdoll

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ragdoll
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The ragdoll being created.

CreateEntityRagdoll.DESCRIPTION:
Called when a serverside ragdoll of an entity has been created.

See [GM:CreateClientsideRagdoll](/gmod/GM:CreateClientsideRagdoll) for clientside ragdolls.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: owner
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Entity that owns the ragdoll

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ragdoll
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The ragdoll entity

CreateMove.DESCRIPTION:
Allows you to change the players movements before they're sent to the server.

See [Game Movement](/gmod/Game%20Movement) for an explanation on the move system.
NOTES: Due to this hook being clientside only, it could be overridden by the user allowing them to completely skip your logic, it is recommended to use [GM:StartCommand](/gmod/GM:StartCommand) in a shared file instead.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: cmd
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The User Command data

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION:
Return true to:
* Disable Sandbox C menu "screen clicking"
* Disable Teammate nocollide (verification required)
* Prevent calling of C_BaseHLPlayer::CreateMove & subsequently C_BasePlayer::CreateMove

CreateTeams.DESCRIPTION:
Teams are created within this hook using [team.SetUp](/gmod/team.SetUp).

This hook is called before [GM:PreGamemodeLoaded](/gmod/GM:PreGamemodeLoaded).

DoAnimationEvent.DESCRIPTION: Called upon an animation event, this is the ideal place to call player animation functions such as [Player:AddVCDSequenceToGestureSlot](/gmod/Player:AddVCDSequenceToGestureSlot), [Player:AnimRestartGesture](/gmod/Player:AnimRestartGesture) and so on.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Player who is being animated

ARGUMENTS.NAME: event
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Animation event. See [PLAYERANIMEVENT](/gmod/Enums/PLAYERANIMEVENT)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: data
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The data for the event. This is interpreted as an [ACT](/gmod/Enums/ACT) by `PLAYERANIMEVENT_CUSTOM` and `PLAYERANIMEVENT_CUSTOM_GESTURE`, or a sequence by `PLAYERANIMEVENT_CUSTOM_SEQUENCE`.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The translated activity to send to the weapon. See [ACT](/gmod/Enums/ACT). Return `ACT_INVALID` if you don't want to send an activity.

DoPlayerDeath.DESCRIPTION:
Handles the player's death.

This hook is **not** called if the player is killed by [Player:KillSilent](/gmod/Player:KillSilent). See [GM:PlayerSilentDeath](/gmod/GM:PlayerSilentDeath) for that.

* [GM:PlayerDeath](/gmod/GM:PlayerDeath) is called after this hook
* [GM:PostPlayerDeath](/gmod/GM:PostPlayerDeath) is called after that
NOTES: [Player:Alive](/gmod/Player:Alive) will return false in this hook.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player

ARGUMENTS.NAME: attacker
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity that killed the player

ARGUMENTS.NAME: dmg
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Damage info

DrawDeathNotice.DESCRIPTION: This hook is called every frame to draw all of the current death notices.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: x
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: X position to draw death notices as a ratio

ARGUMENTS.NAME: y
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Y position to draw death notices as a ratio

DrawMonitors.DESCRIPTION: Called every frame before drawing the in-game monitors ( Breencast, in-game TVs, etc ), but doesn't seem to be doing anything, trying to render 2D or 3D elements fail.

DrawOverlay.DESCRIPTION:
Called after all other 2D draw hooks are called. Draws over all VGUI Panels and HUDs.

Unlike [GM:HUDPaint](/gmod/GM:HUDPaint), this hook is called with the game paused and while the Camera SWEP is equipped.

Does not get called when `r_drawvgui` is disabled.

DrawPhysgunBeam.DESCRIPTION: Allows you to override physgun effects rendering.
NOTES: This is still called when `physgun_drawbeams` is set to `0`, because this hook is also capable of overriding physgun sprite effects, while the convar does not.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Physgun owner

ARGUMENTS.NAME: physgun
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The physgun

ARGUMENTS.NAME: enabled
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Is the beam enabled

ARGUMENTS.NAME: target
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Entity we are grabbing. This will be NULL if nothing is being held

ARGUMENTS.NAME: physBone
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: ID of the physics bone ([PhysObj](/gmod/PhysObj)) we are grabbing at. Use [Entity:TranslatePhysBoneToBone](/gmod/Entity:TranslatePhysBoneToBone) to translate to an actual bone.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: hitPos
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Beam hit position relative to the physics bone ([PhysObj](/gmod/PhysObj)) we are grabbing.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return false to hide default effects

EndEntityDriving.DESCRIPTION: Called right before an entity stops driving. Overriding this hook will cause it to not call [drive.End](/gmod/drive.End) and the player will not stop driving.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity being driven

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player driving the entity

EntityEmitSound.DESCRIPTION: Called whenever a sound has been played. This will not be called clientside if the server played the sound without the client also calling [Entity:EmitSound](/gmod/Entity:EmitSound).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: data
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION:
Information about the played sound. Changes done to this table can be applied by returning `true` from this hook.

See [Structures/EmitSoundInfo](/gmod/Structures/EmitSoundInfo).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION:
* Return `true` to apply all changes done to the data table.
* Return `false` to prevent the sound from playing.
* Return `nil` or nothing to play the sound without altering it.

EntityFireBullets.DESCRIPTION:
Called every time a bullet is about to be fired from an entity, which allows to completely modify the bullet structure before the bullet is actually fired.

See [GM:PostEntityFireBullets](/gmod/GM:PostEntityFireBullets) if you wish to hook the final bullet values, such as the aim direction post spread calculations.
WARNINGS: This hook is called directly from [Entity:FireBullets](/gmod/Entity:FireBullets). Due to this, you cannot call [Entity:FireBullets](/gmod/Entity:FireBullets) inside this hook or an infinite loop will occur crashing the game.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: entity
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity that fired the bullet

ARGUMENTS.NAME: data
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The bullet data. See [Structures/Bullet](/gmod/Structures/Bullet).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION:
* Return `true` to apply all changes done to the bullet table.
* Return `false` to suppress the bullet.

EntityKeyValue.DESCRIPTION:
Called when a key-value pair is set on an entity on map spawn. Is **not** called by [Entity:SetKeyValue](/gmod/Entity:SetKeyValue).

See [ENTITY:KeyValue](/gmod/ENTITY:KeyValue) for a [scripted entities](/gmod/scripted%20entities) hook, and its scripted weapon alternative: [WEAPON:KeyValue](/gmod/WEAPON:KeyValue).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Entity that the keyvalue is being set on

ARGUMENTS.NAME: key
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Key of the key/value pair

ARGUMENTS.NAME: value
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Value of the key/value pair

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: If set, the value of the key-value pair will be overridden by this string.

EntityNetworkedVarChanged.DESCRIPTION: Called when an NW2Var is changed.

BUGS.DESCRIPTION: If a NW2Var is set on an entity that is based on a Lua Entity could result in the NW2Var being mixed up with other ones and being updated multiple times.

NOTES:
This hook is fired before the client value is actually changed. Calling the GetNW2 function for the specified variable name within this hook will return the old value, not the current/updated one.  

	This hook gets called for all NW2Vars on all Entities in a full update. The old value will be nil in this case.  
	If this hook seems to be called for no apparent reason, check if it's caused by a full update.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The owner entity of the changed NW2Var

ARGUMENTS.NAME: name
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The name of the changed NW2Var

ARGUMENTS.NAME: oldval
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The old value of the NW2Var

ARGUMENTS.NAME: newval
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The new value of the NW2Var

EntityRemoved.DESCRIPTION: Called right before removal of an entity.
WARNINGS:
This hook is called clientside during full updates due to how networking works in the Source Engine.

This can happen when the client briefly loses connection to the server, and can be simulated via `cl_fullupdate` for testing purposes.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Entity being removed

ARGUMENTS.NAME: fullUpdate
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION:
Whether the removal is happening due to a full update clientside.

The entity may or **may not** be recreated immediately after, depending on whether it is in the local player's [PVS](https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/PVS "PVS - Valve Developer Community"). (See [Entity:IsDormant](/gmod/Entity:IsDormant))

EntityTakeDamage.DESCRIPTION:
Called when an entity is about to take damage. You can modify all parts of the damage info in this hook or completely block the damage event.

See [GM:PostEntityTakeDamage](/gmod/GM:PostEntityTakeDamage) if you wish to hook the final damage event.
WARNINGS: Applying damage from this hook to the entity taking damage will lead to infinite loop/crash.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: target
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity taking damage

ARGUMENTS.NAME: dmg
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Detailed information about the damage event.

BUGS.DESCRIPTION: When you retrieve "the attacker" the player's angle and position will be incorrect.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return true to completely block the damage event

FindUseEntity.DESCRIPTION: This hook polls the entity the player use action should be applied to.
NOTES: The default behavior of this hook is in [CBasePlayer::FindUseEntity](https://github.com/ValveSoftware/source-sdk-2013/blob/0d8dceea4310fde5706b3ce1c70609d72a38efdf/mp/src/game/shared/baseplayer_shared.cpp#L1068-L1270). Despite CBasePlayer::FindUseEntity being defined shared, it is only called serverside in practice, so this hook will be only called serverside, as well. It is possible for modules to call it clientside, so the Lua code should still be treated as shared.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player who initiated the use action.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: defaultEnt
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity that was chosen by the engine.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The entity to use instead of default entity

FinishMove.DESCRIPTION:
Called after [GM:Move](/gmod/GM:Move), applies all the changes from the [CMoveData](/gmod/CMoveData) to the player.

See [Game Movement](/gmod/Game%20Movement) for an explanation on the move system.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Player

ARGUMENTS.NAME: mv
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Movement data

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return true to suppress default engine behavior, i.e. declare that you have already moved the player according to the move data in a custom way.

ForceDermaSkin.DESCRIPTION: Called to allow override of the default Derma skin for all panels.
NOTES: You can [Panel:SetSkin](/gmod/Panel:SetSkin) "Default" (or other skins) on the frame/base panel and they will still take priority
This hook is only called on Lua start up, changing its value (or adding new hooks) after it has been already called will not have any effect.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION:
A **case sensitive** Derma skin name to be used as default, registered previously via [derma.DefineSkin](/gmod/derma.DefineSkin).


Returning nothing, nil or invalid name will make it fallback to the "Default" skin.

GameContentChanged.DESCRIPTION: Called when game content has been changed, for example an addon or a mountable game was (un)mounted.

GetDeathNoticeEntityName.DESCRIPTION: An internal function used to get an untranslated string to show in the kill feed as the entity's name. See [GM:SendDeathNotice](/gmod/GM:SendDeathNotice)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: name
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The name of the entity.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The untranslated name for given NPC. The translation/localization would happen on the client.

GetFallDamage.DESCRIPTION: Called when a player takes damage from falling, allows to override the damage.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player

ARGUMENTS.NAME: speed
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The fall speed

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: New fall damage

GetGameDescription.DESCRIPTION: Called when the game(server) needs to update the text shown in the server browser as the gamemode. Runs at a ~2s interval, runs even when the server is hibernating. This hook doesn't run when `hide_server 1` is set.
NOTES:
This hook (and the `sv_gamename_override` command) may not work on some popular gamemodes like DarkRP or Trouble Terrorist Town. This is not a bug, it's just how it works. See [here](https://github.com/Facepunch/garrysmod-issues/issues/4637#issuecomment-677884989) for more information.

Also, it **only** works on dedicated servers and is called at regular intervals (about one second) **even** if the server has no players and the hibernation function is enabled.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The text to be shown in the server browser as the gamemode.

GetMotionBlurValues.DESCRIPTION: Allows you to modify the Source Engine's motion blur shaders.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: horizontal
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The amount of horizontal blur.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: vertical
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The amount of vertical  blur.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: forward
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The amount of forward/radial blur.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: rotational
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The amount of rotational blur.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: New amount of horizontal blur.
New amount of vertical blur.
New amount of forward/radial blur.
New amount of rotational blur.

GetPreferredCarryAngles.DESCRIPTION: Called to determine preferred carry angles for the entity. It works for both, +use pickup and gravity gun pickup.
NOTES: This hook can **not** override preferred carry angles of props such as the sawblade and the harpoon.
WARNINGS: Due to nature of the gravity gun coding in multiplayer, this hook **MAY** seem to not work ( but rest assured it does ), due to clientside prediction not knowing the carry angles. The +use pickup doesn't present this issue as it doesn't predict the player carrying the object clientside ( as you may notice by the prop lagging behind in multiplayer )

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity to generate carry angles for

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player who is holding the object

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The preferred carry angles for the entity.

GetTeamColor.DESCRIPTION: Returns the color for the given entity's team. This is used in chat and deathnotice text.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Entity

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Team [Color](/gmod/Color)

GetTeamNumColor.DESCRIPTION: Returns the team color for the given team index.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: team
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Team index

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Team [Color](/gmod/Color)

GrabEarAnimation.DESCRIPTION: Override this hook to disable/change ear-grabbing in your gamemode. By default, it is not called anywhere on the server.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Player

GravGunOnDropped.DESCRIPTION:
Called when an entity is released by a gravity gun.

See [GM:PhysgunDrop](/gmod/GM:PhysgunDrop) for the Physics Gun drop variant.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Player who is wielding the gravity gun

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity that has been dropped

GravGunOnPickedUp.DESCRIPTION:
Called when an entity is picked up by a gravity gun.

See [GM:OnPlayerPhysicsPickup](/gmod/GM:OnPlayerPhysicsPickup) for the player `+use` pickup variant.
See [GM:OnPhysgunPickup](/gmod/GM:OnPhysgunPickup) for the Physics Gun pickup variant.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player wielding the gravity gun

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity that has been picked up by the gravity gun

GravGunPickupAllowed.DESCRIPTION:
Called every tick to poll whether a player is allowed to pick up an entity with the gravity gun or not.

See [GM:AllowPlayerPickup](/gmod/GM:AllowPlayerPickup) for the +USE pickup variant.
See [GM:PhysgunPickup](/gmod/GM:PhysgunPickup) for the Physics Gun pickup variant.

Calls [ENTITY:GravGunPickupAllowed](/gmod/ENTITY:GravGunPickupAllowed) on the entity being hovered every frame in Sandbox-derived gamemodes.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player wielding the gravity gun

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity the player is attempting to pick up

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return true to allow entity pick up

GravGunPunt.DESCRIPTION:
Called when an entity is about to be punted with the gravity gun (primary fire).

By default this function makes [ENTITY:GravGunPunt](/gmod/ENTITY:GravGunPunt) work in Sandbox derived gamemodes.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player wielding the gravity gun

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity the player is attempting to punt

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return true to allow and false to disallow.

GUIMouseDoublePressed.DESCRIPTION:
Called when the mouse has been double clicked on any panel derived from CGModBase, such as the panel used by [gui.EnableScreenClicker](/gmod/gui.EnableScreenClicker) and the panel used by [Panel:ParentToHUD](/gmod/Panel:ParentToHUD).

By default this hook calls [GM:GUIMousePressed](/gmod/GM:GUIMousePressed).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: mouseCode
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The code of the mouse button pressed, see [MOUSE](/gmod/Enums/MOUSE)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: aimVector
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: A normalized vector pointing in the direction the client has clicked

GUIMousePressed.DESCRIPTION:
Called whenever a players presses a mouse key on the context menu in Sandbox or on any panel derived from CGModBase, such as the panel used by [gui.EnableScreenClicker](/gmod/gui.EnableScreenClicker) and the panel used by [Panel:ParentToHUD](/gmod/Panel:ParentToHUD).

See [GM:VGUIMousePressed](/gmod/GM:VGUIMousePressed) for a hook that is called on all VGUI elements.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: mouseCode
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The key that the player pressed using [MOUSE](/gmod/Enums/MOUSE).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: aimVector
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: A normalized direction vector local to the camera. Internally, this is  [gui.ScreenToVector](/gmod/gui.ScreenToVector)( [gui.MousePos](/gmod/gui.MousePos)() ).

GUIMouseReleased.DESCRIPTION: Called whenever a players releases a mouse key on the context menu in Sandbox or on any panel derived from CGModBase, such as the panel used by [gui.EnableScreenClicker](/gmod/gui.EnableScreenClicker) and the panel used by [Panel:ParentToHUD](/gmod/Panel:ParentToHUD).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: mouseCode
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The key the player released, see [MOUSE](/gmod/Enums/MOUSE)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: aimVector
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: A normalized direction vector local to the camera. Internally this is  [gui.ScreenToVector](/gmod/gui.ScreenToVector)( [gui.MousePos](/gmod/gui.MousePos)() ).

HandlePlayerArmorReduction.DESCRIPTION: Called to handle player armor reduction, when player receives damage.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player that took damage.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: dmginfo
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The taken damage.

HandlePlayerDriving.DESCRIPTION: Allows to override player driving animations.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Player to process

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return true if we've changed/set the animation, false otherwise

HandlePlayerDucking.DESCRIPTION: Allows to override player crouch animations.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player

ARGUMENTS.NAME: velocity
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Players velocity

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return true if we've changed/set the animation, false otherwise

HandlePlayerJumping.DESCRIPTION: Called every frame by the player model animation system. Allows to override player jumping animations.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player

ARGUMENTS.NAME: velocity
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Players velocity

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return true if we've changed/set the animation, false otherwise

HandlePlayerLanding.DESCRIPTION: Called every frame by the player model animation system. Allows to override player landing animations.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player

ARGUMENTS.NAME: velocity
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Players velocity

ARGUMENTS.NAME: onGround
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Was the player on ground?

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return true if we've changed/set the animation, false otherwise

HandlePlayerNoClipping.DESCRIPTION: Allows to override player noclip animations.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player

ARGUMENTS.NAME: velocity
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Players velocity

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return true if we've changed/set the animation, false otherwise

HandlePlayerSwimming.DESCRIPTION: Allows to override player swimming animations.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player

ARGUMENTS.NAME: velocity
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Players velocity

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return true if we've changed/set the animation, false otherwise

HandlePlayerVaulting.DESCRIPTION: Allows to override player flying ( in mid-air, not noclipping ) animations.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player

ARGUMENTS.NAME: velocity
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Players velocity

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return true if we've changed/set the animation, false otherwise

HUDAmmoPickedUp.DESCRIPTION: Called when the client has picked up ammo. Override to disable default HUD notification.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: itemName
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Name of the item (ammo) picked up

ARGUMENTS.NAME: amount
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Amount of the item (ammo) picked up

HUDDrawPickupHistory.DESCRIPTION: Renders the HUD pick-up history. Override to hide default or draw your own HUD.

HUDDrawScoreBoard.DESCRIPTION:
Called every frame to render the scoreboard.


It is recommended to use Derma and VGUI for this job instead of this hook. Called right after [GM:HUDPaint](/gmod/GM:HUDPaint).

HUDDrawTargetID.DESCRIPTION: Called from [GM:HUDPaint](/gmod/GM:HUDPaint) to draw player info when you hover over a player with your crosshair or mouse.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Should the player info be drawn.

HUDItemPickedUp.DESCRIPTION: Called when an item has been picked up. Override to disable the default HUD notification.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: itemName
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Name of the picked up item

HUDPaint.DESCRIPTION:
Called whenever the HUD should be drawn.

		This is the ideal place to draw custom HUD elements.

		To prevent the default game HUD from drawing, use [GM:HUDShouldDraw](/gmod/GM:HUDShouldDraw).

		This hook does **not** get called when the Camera SWEP is held, or when the  menu is open.  
		If you need to draw in those situations, use [GM:DrawOverlay](/gmod/GM:DrawOverlay) instead.

HUDPaintBackground.DESCRIPTION:
Called before [GM:HUDPaint](/gmod/GM:HUDPaint) when the HUD background is being drawn.

Just like [GM:HUDPaint](/gmod/GM:HUDPaint), this hook will not be called when the main menu is visible. [GM:PostDrawHUD](/gmod/GM:PostDrawHUD) does not have this behavior.

Things rendered in this hook will **always** appear behind things rendered in [GM:HUDPaint](/gmod/GM:HUDPaint).

HUDShouldDraw.DESCRIPTION: Called when the Gamemode is about to draw a given element on the client's HUD (heads-up display).
WARNINGS: This hook is called HUNDREDS of times per second (more than 5 times per frame on average). You shouldn't be performing any computationally intensive operations. For Weapons you SHOULD use [WEAPON:HUDShouldDraw](/gmod/WEAPON:HUDShouldDraw) instead.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: name
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The name of the HUD element. You can find a full list of HUD elements for this hook [here](/gmod/HUD_Element_List).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return false to prevent the given element from being drawn on the client's screen.

HUDWeaponPickedUp.DESCRIPTION: Called when a weapon has been picked up. Override to disable the default HUD notification.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: weapon
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The picked up weapon

Initialize.DESCRIPTION:
Called after the gamemode loads and starts.

No entities would be present at the time this hook is called, please see [GM:InitPostEntity](/gmod/GM:InitPostEntity) for a one time fire hook after all map entities have been initialized.

InitPostEntity.DESCRIPTION: Called after all the entities are initialized. Starting from this hook [LocalPlayer](/gmod/Global.LocalPlayer) will return valid object.
NOTES: At this point the client only knows about the entities that are within the spawnpoints' [PVS (Potential Visibility Set)](https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/PVS "PVS - Valve Developer Community"). For instance, if the server sends an entity that is not within this PVS, the client will receive it as NULL entity.

InputMouseApply.DESCRIPTION: Allows you to modify the supplied User Command with mouse input. This could be used to make moving the mouse do funky things to view angles.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: cmd
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: User command.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: x
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The amount of mouse movement across the X axis this frame.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: y
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The amount of mouse movement across the Y axis this frame.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ang
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The current view angle.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return true if we modified something.

IsSpawnpointSuitable.DESCRIPTION: Check if a player can spawn at a certain spawnpoint.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player who is spawned

ARGUMENTS.NAME: spawnpoint
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The spawnpoint entity (on the map).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: makeSuitable
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: If this is true, it'll kill any players blocking the spawnpoint.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return true to indicate that the spawnpoint is suitable (Allow for the player to spawn here), false to prevent spawning.

KeyPress.DESCRIPTION:
Called whenever a player pressed a key included within the IN keys.

For a more general purpose function that handles all kinds of input, see [GM:PlayerButtonDown](/gmod/GM:PlayerButtonDown).
See [GM:KeyRelease](/gmod/GM:KeyRelease) for the key release event.

Despite being a predicted hook, it will still be called in singleplayer for your convenience.
WARNINGS: Due to this being a predicted hook, [ParticleEffect](/gmod/Global.ParticleEffect)s created only serverside from this hook will not be networked to the client, so make sure to do that on both realms.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player pressing the key. If running client-side, this will always be [LocalPlayer](/gmod/Global.LocalPlayer).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: key
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The key that the player pressed using [IN](/gmod/Enums/IN).

KeyRelease.DESCRIPTION:
Runs when a IN key was released by a player.

For a more general purpose function that handles all kinds of input, see [GM:PlayerButtonUp](/gmod/GM:PlayerButtonUp).
See [GM:KeyPress](/gmod/GM:KeyPress) for the key press event.

Despite being a predicted hook, it will still be called in singleplayer for your convenience.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player releasing the key. If running client-side, this will always be [LocalPlayer](/gmod/Global.LocalPlayer).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: key
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The key that the player released using [IN](/gmod/Enums/IN).

LoadGModSave.DESCRIPTION: Called from `gm_load` when the game should load a map.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: data
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Compressed save data

ARGUMENTS.NAME: map
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The name of the map the save was created on

ARGUMENTS.NAME: timestamp
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The time the save was created on. Will always be 0.

LoadGModSaveFailed.DESCRIPTION: Called while an addon from the Steam workshop is downloading. Used by default to update details on the fancy workshop download panel.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: reason
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Failure Reason.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: workshopid
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: the workshop ID of the missing map (if found). Can be an empty string

MouthMoveAnimation.DESCRIPTION: Override this gamemode function to disable mouth movement when talking on voice chat. By default, it is not called anywhere on the server.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Player in question

Move.DESCRIPTION:
The Move hook is called for you to manipulate the player's MoveData. 

You shouldn't adjust the player's position in any way in the move hook. This is because due to prediction errors, the netcode might run the move hook multiple times as packets arrive late. Therefore you should only adjust the movedata construct in this hook.

Generally you shouldn't have to use this hook - if you want to make a custom move type you should look at the drive system.

This hook is called after [GM:PlayerTick](/gmod/GM:PlayerTick).

See [Game Movement](/gmod/Game%20Movement) for an explanation on the move system.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Player

ARGUMENTS.NAME: mv
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Movement information

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return true to suppress default engine action.

NeedsDepthPass.DESCRIPTION: Returning true in this hook will cause it to render depth buffers defined with [render.GetResolvedFullFrameDepth](/gmod/render.GetResolvedFullFrameDepth).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Render depth buffer

NetworkEntityCreated.DESCRIPTION: Called when an entity has been created over the network.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Created entity

NetworkIDValidated.DESCRIPTION:
Called when a player's SteamID has been validated by Steam.

See also [GM:PlayerAuthed](/gmod/GM:PlayerAuthed) and [Player:IsFullyAuthenticated](/gmod/Player:IsFullyAuthenticated).
NOTES: This hook doesn't work intentionally in singleplayer [because the SteamID is not validated](https://github.com/Facepunch/garrysmod-issues/issues/4906#issuecomment-819337130) in that case. This also applies to `sv_lan 1` servers for every duplicate `-multirun` client.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: name
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Player name

ARGUMENTS.NAME: steamID
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Player SteamID

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ownerID
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: SteamID64 of the game license owner, in case Family Sharing is used. See also [Player:OwnerSteamID64](/gmod/Player:OwnerSteamID64)

NotifyShouldTransmit.DESCRIPTION: Called whenever this entity changes its transmission state for this [LocalPlayer](/gmod/Global.LocalPlayer), such as exiting or re entering the [PVS (Potential Visibility Set)](https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/PVS "PVS - Valve Developer Community").
NOTES:
This is the best place to handle the reset of [Entity:SetPredictable](/gmod/Entity:SetPredictable), as this would be usually called when the player lags and requests a full packet update.

	When the entity stops transmitting, [Entity:IsDormant](/gmod/Entity:IsDormant) will only return true **after** this hook.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: entity
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity that changed its transmission state.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: shouldtransmit
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: `True` if we started transmitting to this client and `false` if we stopped.

OnAchievementAchieved.DESCRIPTION: Called when a player has achieved an achievement. You can get the name and other information from an achievement ID with the [achievements](/gmod/achievements) library.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player that earned the achievement

ARGUMENTS.NAME: achievement
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The index of the achievement

OnChatTab.DESCRIPTION: Called when the local player presses TAB while having their chatbox opened.
WARNINGS: This function now uses [player.Iterator](/gmod/player.Iterator). This means it can't run all the time, as an error in the [GM:OnEntityCreated](/gmod/GM:OnEntityCreated) or [GM:EntityRemoved](/gmod/GM:EntityRemoved) hooks is likely to interrupt it. Make sure that no addon causes an error in these hooks.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: text
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The currently typed into chatbox text

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: What should be placed into the chatbox instead of what currently is when player presses tab

OnCleanup.DESCRIPTION: Called when the player cleans up something.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: name
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The name of the cleanup type

RETURNS.NAME: suppress
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return false to suppress the cleanup notification.

OnClientLuaError.DESCRIPTION:
Called on the server when a Lua error occurs on a client and is sent to the server.
  
        This hook allows server-side code to detect and log client-side errors.

See [GM:OnLuaError](/gmod/GM:OnLuaError) for a hook that captures Lua errors directly within its [realm](States).
NOTES: Warning: the hook "protects" against lua error spam. If it has 5 errors in less than 1 second, the hook will not receive any of these 4 errors.
WARNINGS: Note that the stack argument can contain a table with 0 values.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: error
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION:
The error that occurred. As well as the path and line of the error. Example:  
`addons/test/lua/autorun/client/test_error.lua:4: 'then' expected near '

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player whose client caused the error.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: stack
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The Lua error stack trace

ARGUMENTS.NAME: name
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Title of the addon that is creating the Lua errors, or "ERROR" if addon is not found.

OnCloseCaptionEmit.DESCRIPTION: Called when a caption/subtitle has been emitted to the closed caption box.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: soundScript
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The name of the soundscript, or `customLuaToken` if it's from [gui.AddCaption](/gmod/gui.AddCaption)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: duration
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: How long the caption should stay for

ARGUMENTS.NAME: fromPlayer
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Is this caption coming from the player?

ARGUMENTS.NAME: fullText
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The caption. Can be nil if its token is not registered

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return `true` to prevent the caption from appearing

OnContextMenuClose.DESCRIPTION:
Called when the context menu keybind (+menu_context) is released, which by default is C.

This hook will not run if [input.IsKeyTrapping](/gmod/input.IsKeyTrapping) returns true.

See also [GM:OnContextMenuOpen](/gmod/GM:OnContextMenuOpen).

OnContextMenuOpen.DESCRIPTION:
Called when the context menu keybind (`+menu_context`) is pressed, which by default is .

See also [GM:OnContextMenuClose](/gmod/GM:OnContextMenuClose).

OnCrazyPhysics.DESCRIPTION: Called when the crazy physics detection detects an entity with crazy physics, i.e. position being far outside of the map, velocities being near or at infinity, etc. The primary reason for this system is to prevent program crashes in physics engine.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity that was detected as crazy

ARGUMENTS.NAME: physobj
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The physics object that is going crazy

OnDamagedByExplosion.DESCRIPTION: Called when a player has been hurt by an explosion. Override to disable default sound effect.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Player who has been hurt

ARGUMENTS.NAME: dmginfo
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Damage info from explosion

OnEntityCreated.DESCRIPTION: Called as soon as the entity is created. Very little of the entity's properties will be initialized at this stage. (keyvalues, classname, flags, anything), especially on the serverside.
WARNINGS: Removing the created entity during this event can lead to unexpected problems. Use [SafeRemoveEntityDelayed](/gmod/Global.SafeRemoveEntityDelayed)( entity, 0 ) to safely remove the entity.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: entity
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity

OnEntityWaterLevelChanged.DESCRIPTION:
Called when the [Entity:WaterLevel](/gmod/Entity:WaterLevel) of an entity is changed.

    0 - The entity isn't in water.

    1 - Slightly submerged (at least to the feet).

    2 - The majority of the entity is submerged (at least to the waist).

    3 - Completely submerged.
WARNINGS: This hook can be considered a physics callback, so changing collision rules ([Entity:SetSolidFlags](/gmod/Entity:SetSolidFlags)) in it may lead to a crash!

ARGUMENTS.NAME: entity
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: old
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Previous water level.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: new
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The new water level.

OnGamemodeLoaded.DESCRIPTION:
Called when the gamemode is loaded. [gmod.GetGamemode](/gmod/gmod.GetGamemode) will be functional at this point.

[LocalPlayer](/gmod/Global.LocalPlayer)() returns NULL at the time this is run.

OnLuaError.DESCRIPTION:
Called when a Lua error occurs.
If you want to retrieve client errors on the server side, you can use this hook: [GM:OnClientLuaError](/gmod/GM:OnClientLuaError)
NOTES: On the [server realm](/gmod/States), this hook will only account for server-side errors, not client-side ones.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: error
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The error that occurred.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: realm
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Where the Lua error took place, "client", or "server"

ARGUMENTS.NAME: stack
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The Lua error stack trace

ARGUMENTS.NAME: name
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Title of the addon that is creating the Lua errors, or nil if addon is not found.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: id
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Steam Workshop ID of the addon creating Lua errors, if it is an addon.

OnNotifyAddonConflict.DESCRIPTION: Called when a Addon Conflict occurs, only works in the Menu realm.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: addon1
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The first Addon

ARGUMENTS.NAME: addon2
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The second Addon

ARGUMENTS.NAME: fileName
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The File the Conflict occurred in.

OnNPCDropItem.DESCRIPTION:
Called whenever an NPC drops an item upon its death, such as health kits, armor batteries, etc.

It will NOT be called for dropped weapons, with exception of Half-Life: Source NPCs, since they don't use actual weapon entities and create a weapon entity on death.  
[GM:PlayerDroppedWeapon](/gmod/GM:PlayerDroppedWeapon) works for NPC weapon drops already. (Yes, it's not a typo)

It will also not be called for live grenades spawned by Zombine.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: npc
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The killed NPC

ARGUMENTS.NAME: item
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The item that got dropped by the NPC.

OnNPCKilled.DESCRIPTION: Called whenever an NPC is killed.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: npc
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The killed NPC

ARGUMENTS.NAME: attacker
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The NPCs attacker, the entity that gets the kill credit, for example a player or an NPC.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: inflictor
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Death inflictor. The entity that did the killing. Not necessarily a weapon.

OnPauseMenuBlockedTooManyTimes.DESCRIPTION: Called when the main menu has been blocked by [GM:OnPauseMenuShow](/gmod/GM:OnPauseMenuShow) four times in a small interval. This is used internally to explain to the user that they can hold  to force open the main menu.

OnPauseMenuShow.DESCRIPTION:
Called when the pause menu is attempting to be opened. Allows you to prevent the main menu from being opened that time.

	The user can hold  to not call this hook. If the main menu is blocked multiple times in short succession, a warning will be displayed to the end user on how to bypass the hook.

RETURNS.NAME: ShouldOpen
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Should the menu be allowed to open?

OnPermissionsChanged.DESCRIPTION: Called when a permission gets Granted or Revoked.

OnPhysgunFreeze.DESCRIPTION: Called when a player freezes an entity with the physgun.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: weapon
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The weapon that was used to freeze the entity.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: physobj
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Physics object of the entity.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The target entity.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player who tried to freeze the entity.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return `false` to block the unfreeze.
WARNINGS: The unfreezing is handled by the base gamemode hook. This hook has no return value, returning any value will prevent the gamemode hook from running, which is true for every hook.

OnPhysgunPickup.DESCRIPTION:
Called to when a player has successfully picked up an entity with their Physics Gun.

Not to be confused with [GM:PhysgunPickup](/gmod/GM:PhysgunPickup) which is called to ask if the player should be able to pick up an entity.


See [GM:GravGunOnPickedUp](/gmod/GM:GravGunOnPickedUp) for the Gravity Gun pickup variant.
See [GM:OnPlayerPhysicsPickup](/gmod/GM:OnPlayerPhysicsPickup) for the player `+use` pickup variant.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player that has picked up something using the physics gun.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity that was picked up.

OnPhysgunReload.DESCRIPTION: Called when a player reloads with the physgun. Override this to disable default unfreezing behavior.

BUGS.DESCRIPTION: Regardless of whether or not you return true or false, it will disable reloading. Only returning nil/nothing will allow reloading. The intended behavior should be that returning false disables reloading.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: physgun
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The physgun in question.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player wielding the physgun.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the player can reload with the physgun or not/

DEPRECATED: Use GM:PlayerChangedTeam instead, which works for every Player:SetTeam call.
OnPlayerChangedTeam.DESCRIPTION: Called when a player has changed team using [GM:PlayerJoinTeam](/gmod/GM:PlayerJoinTeam).
WARNINGS: This hook will not work with [hook.Add](/gmod/hook.Add) and it is only called manually from [GM:PlayerJoinTeam](/gmod/GM:PlayerJoinTeam) by the base gamemode

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Player who has changed team

ARGUMENTS.NAME: oldTeam
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Index of the team the player was originally in

ARGUMENTS.NAME: newTeam
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Index of the team the player has changed to

OnPlayerChat.DESCRIPTION: Called whenever a player sends a chat message. For the serverside equivalent, see [GM:PlayerSay](/gmod/GM:PlayerSay).
NOTES: The input (or suppression) of this hook is based on the output from [GM:PlayerSay](/gmod/GM:PlayerSay). Chat events suppressed serverside do not call this hook.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player

ARGUMENTS.NAME: text
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The message's text

ARGUMENTS.NAME: teamChat
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Is the player typing in team chat?

ARGUMENTS.NAME: isDead
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Is the player dead?

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Should the message be suppressed?

OnPlayerHitGround.DESCRIPTION: Called when a player makes contact with the ground after a jump or a fall.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: player
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Player

ARGUMENTS.NAME: inWater
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Did the player land in water?

ARGUMENTS.NAME: onFloater
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Did the player land on an object floating in the water?

ARGUMENTS.NAME: speed
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The speed at which the player hit the ground

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return true to suppress default action

ARGUMENTS.NAME: player
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Player

ARGUMENTS.NAME: speed
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The velocity/impulse of the jump

OnPlayerPhysicsDrop.DESCRIPTION: Called when a player +use drops an entity.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player that dropped the object

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The object that was dropped.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: thrown
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the object was throw or simply let go of.

OnPlayerPhysicsPickup.DESCRIPTION:
Called when a player +use pickups up an entity. This will be called after the entity passes though [GM:AllowPlayerPickup](/gmod/GM:AllowPlayerPickup).

See [GM:GravGunOnPickedUp](/gmod/GM:GravGunOnPickedUp) for the Gravity Gun pickup variant.
See [GM:OnPhysgunPickup](/gmod/GM:OnPhysgunPickup) for the Physics Gun pickup variant.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player that picked up the object

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The object that was picked up.

OnReloaded.DESCRIPTION: Called when gamemode has been reloaded by auto refresh.
NOTES: It seems that this event can be triggered more than once for a single refresh event.

OnScreenSizeChanged.DESCRIPTION:
Called when the player's screen resolution of the game changes. This also called when changing MSAA settings.

[ScrW](/gmod/Global.ScrW) and [ScrH](/gmod/Global.ScrH) will return the new values when this hook is called.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: oldWidth
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The previous width of the game's window.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: oldHeight
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The previous height of the game's window.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: newWidth
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The new/current width of the game's window.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: newHeight
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The new/current height of the game's window.

OnSpawnMenuClose.DESCRIPTION: Called when a player releases the `+menu` bind on their keyboard, which is bound to  by default.

OnSpawnMenuOpen.DESCRIPTION: Called when a player presses the `+menu` bind on their keyboard, which is bound to  by default.

OnTextEntryGetFocus.DESCRIPTION:
Called when a [DTextEntry](/gmod/DTextEntry) gets focus.

This hook is run from [DTextEntry:OnGetFocus](/gmod/DTextEntry:OnGetFocus) and [PANEL:OnMousePressed](/gmod/PANEL:OnMousePressed) of [DTextEntry](/gmod/DTextEntry).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: panel
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The panel that got focus

ARGUMENTS.NAME: panel
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The panel that lost focus

OnUndo.DESCRIPTION: Called when the player undoes something.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: name
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The name of the undo action

ARGUMENTS.NAME: customText
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The custom text for the undo, set by [undo.SetCustomUndoText](/gmod/undo.SetCustomUndoText)

RETURNS.NAME: suppress
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return false to suppress the undo notification.

OnViewModelChanged.DESCRIPTION: Called when the player changes their weapon to another one - and their viewmodel model changes.

BUGS.DESCRIPTION: This is not always called clientside.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: viewmodel
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The viewmodel that is changing

ARGUMENTS.NAME: oldModel
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The old model

ARGUMENTS.NAME: newModel
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The new model

PhysgunDrop.DESCRIPTION:
Called when a player drops an entity with the Physgun.

See [GM:GravGunOnDropped](/gmod/GM:GravGunOnDropped) for the Gravity Gun drop variant.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: player
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player who dropped an entity

ARGUMENTS.NAME: entity
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The dropped entity

PhysgunPickup.DESCRIPTION:
Called to determine if a player should be able to pick up an entity with the Physics Gun.

See [GM:OnPhysgunPickup](/gmod/GM:OnPhysgunPickup) for a hook which is called when a player has successfully picked up an entity.

See [GM:GravGunPickupAllowed](/gmod/GM:GravGunPickupAllowed) for the Gravity Gun pickup variant.
See [GM:AllowPlayerPickup](/gmod/GM:AllowPlayerPickup) for the `+USE` pickup variant.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: player
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player that is picking up using the Physics Gun.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: entity
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity that is being picked up.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether the player can pick up the entity or not.

PlayerAmmoChanged.DESCRIPTION: Called after player's reserve ammo count changes.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player whose ammo is being affected.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ammoID
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The ammo type ID.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: oldCount
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The old ammo count.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: newCount
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The new ammo count.

PlayerAuthed.DESCRIPTION:
Called after the player gets their [Player:UniqueID](/gmod/Player:UniqueID) set for the first time. This hook will also be called in singleplayer.

See [GM:NetworkIDValidated](/gmod/GM:NetworkIDValidated) for a hook that is called with the player's SteamID is validated by Steam.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player

ARGUMENTS.NAME: steamid
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player's SteamID.
WARNINGS: This will always be an empty string `""` in singleplayer.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: uniqueid
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player's UniqueID.
WARNINGS: This will always be `"1"` in singleplayer.

PlayerBindPress.DESCRIPTION: Runs when a bind has been pressed. Allows to block commands.

BUGS.DESCRIPTION: The third argument will always be true.
This does not run for function keys binds (F1-F12).

NOTES:
By using the "alias" console command, this hook can be effectively circumvented. To prevent this use [input.TranslateAlias](/gmod/input.TranslateAlias).

To stop the user from using `+attack`, `+left` and any other movement commands of the sort, please look into using [GM:StartCommand](/gmod/GM:StartCommand) instead.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player who used the command; this will always be equal to [LocalPlayer](/gmod/Global.LocalPlayer).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: bind
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The bind command.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: pressed
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: If the bind was activated or deactivated.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: code
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The button code. See [BUTTON_CODE](/gmod/Enums/BUTTON_CODE) Enums.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return `true` to prevent the bind.

PlayerButtonDown.DESCRIPTION:
Called when a player presses a button.

This will not be called if player has a panel opened with keyboard input enabled, use [PANEL:OnKeyCodePressed](/gmod/PANEL:OnKeyCodePressed) instead.

See [GM:KeyPress](/gmod/GM:KeyPress) for an alternative that uses [IN](/gmod/Enums/IN).
See [GM:PlayerButtonUp](/gmod/GM:PlayerButtonUp) for the "key release" event.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Player who pressed the button

ARGUMENTS.NAME: button
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The button, see [BUTTON_CODE](/gmod/Enums/BUTTON_CODE)

PlayerButtonUp.DESCRIPTION:
Called when a player releases a button.

This will not be called if player has a panel opened with keyboard input enabled, use [PANEL:OnKeyCodeReleased](/gmod/PANEL:OnKeyCodeReleased) instead.

See [GM:KeyRelease](/gmod/GM:KeyRelease) for an alternative that uses [IN](/gmod/Enums/IN).
See [GM:PlayerButtonDown](/gmod/GM:PlayerButtonDown) for the "key press" event.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Player who released the button

ARGUMENTS.NAME: button
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The button, see [BUTTON_CODE](/gmod/Enums/BUTTON_CODE)

PlayerCanHearPlayersVoice.DESCRIPTION: Decides whether a player can hear another player using voice chat.
WARNINGS:
This hook is called **players count * speaking players count** times every 0.3 seconds if at least 1 player is talking or every 5 seconds if no one is talking.
	You should ensure that your code is efficient, or this will definitely influence performance.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: listener
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The listening player.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: talker
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The talking player.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return `true` if the listener should hear the talker, `false` if they shouldn't.
3D sound. If set to `true`, will fade out the sound the further away listener is from the  talker, the voice will also be in stereo, and not mono.

PlayerCanJoinTeam.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether or not a player is allowed to join a team
WARNINGS: This hook will not work with [hook.Add](/gmod/hook.Add) and it is only called manually from [GM:PlayerJoinTeam](/gmod/GM:PlayerJoinTeam) by the base gamemode

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Player attempting to switch teams

ARGUMENTS.NAME: team
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Index of the team

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Allowed to switch

PlayerCanPickupItem.DESCRIPTION:
Returns whether or not a player is allowed to pick an item up. (ammo, health, armor)

This will typically only work for base game entities, unless mod authors that implement similar entities also manually call this hook.

See [GM:PlayerCanPickupWeapon](/gmod/GM:PlayerCanPickupWeapon) for a hook that controls weapon pickups.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Player attempting to pick up

ARGUMENTS.NAME: item
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The item the player is attempting to pick up

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Allow pick up

PlayerCanPickupWeapon.DESCRIPTION:
Returns whether or not a player is allowed to pick up a weapon.

 	If this returns `false`, [Player:Give](/gmod/Player:Give) won't work.

See [GM:PlayerCanPickupItem](/gmod/GM:PlayerCanPickupItem) for a hook that affects things like health kits, armor batteries and ammo entities.

See [GM:WeaponEquip](/gmod/GM:WeaponEquip) for a hook that is called when a player successfully picks up a weapon after passing this hook.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player attempting to pick up the weapon.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: weapon
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The weapon entity in question.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: `false` to disallow pickup.

PlayerCanSeePlayersChat.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether or not the player can see the other player's chat.
NOTES: The **speaker** parameter does not have to be a valid [Player](/gmod/Player) object which happens when console messages are displayed for example.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: text
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The chat text

ARGUMENTS.NAME: teamOnly
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: If the message is team-only

ARGUMENTS.NAME: listener
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player receiving the message

ARGUMENTS.NAME: speaker
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player sending the message.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Can see other player's chat

PlayerChangedTeam.DESCRIPTION: Called when a player has changed team using [Player:SetTeam](/gmod/Player:SetTeam).
WARNINGS: [Player:Team](/gmod/Player:Team) inside this hook will return `oldTeam`.
Avoid calling [Player:SetTeam](/gmod/Player:SetTeam) in this hook as it may cause an infinite loop!

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Player whose team has changed.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: oldTeam
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Index of the team the player was originally in. See [team.GetName](/gmod/team.GetName) and the [team](/gmod/team) library.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: newTeam
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Index of the team the player has changed to.

PlayerCheckLimit.DESCRIPTION: Called whenever a player is about to spawn something to see if they hit a limit for whatever they are spawning.
NOTES: This hook will not be called in singleplayer, as singleplayer does not have limits.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player who is trying to spawn something.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: limitName
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The limit's name.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: current
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The amount of whatever player is trying to spawn that the player already has spawned.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: defaultMax
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The default maximum count, as dictated by the `sbox_max

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return `false` to indicate the limit was hit, or nothing otherwise

PlayerClassChanged.DESCRIPTION: Called whenever a player's class is changed on the server-side with [player_manager.SetPlayerClass](/gmod/player_manager.SetPlayerClass).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player whose class has been changed.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: newID
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION:
The network ID of the player class's name string, or `0` if we are clearing a player class from the player.

Pass this into [util.NetworkIDToString](/gmod/util.NetworkIDToString) to retrieve the proper name of the player class.

PlayerConnect.DESCRIPTION: Executes when a player connects to the server. Called before the player has been assigned a [UserID](/gmod/Player:UserID) and entity. See the [player_connect](/gmod/gameevent/player_connect) gameevent for a version of this hook called after the player entity has been created.
NOTES: This is not called clientside for the local player.
This is only called clientside for listen server hosts.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: name
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player's name.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ip
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player's IP address. Will be "none" for bots.
NOTES: This argument will only be passed serverside.

PlayerDeath.DESCRIPTION:
Called when a player is killed by [Player:Kill](/gmod/Player:Kill) or any other normal means.

This hook is **not** called if the player is killed by [Player:KillSilent](/gmod/Player:KillSilent). See [GM:PlayerSilentDeath](/gmod/GM:PlayerSilentDeath) for that.

* [GM:DoPlayerDeath](/gmod/GM:DoPlayerDeath) is called **before** this hook.
* [GM:PostPlayerDeath](/gmod/GM:PostPlayerDeath) is called **after** this hook.

See [Player:LastHitGroup](/gmod/Player:LastHitGroup) if you need to get the last hit hitgroup of the player.
NOTES: [Player:Alive](/gmod/Player:Alive) will return false in this hook.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: victim
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player who died

ARGUMENTS.NAME: inflictor
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Item used to kill the victim

ARGUMENTS.NAME: attacker
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Player or entity that killed the victim

PlayerDeathSound.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether or not the default death sound should be muted.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Mute death sound

PlayerDeathThink.DESCRIPTION:
Called every think while the player is dead. The return value will determine if the player respawns.

Overwriting this function will prevent players from respawning by pressing space or clicking.

BUGS.DESCRIPTION: This hook is not called for players with the [FL_FROZEN](/gmod/Enums/FL) flag applied.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player affected in the hook.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return a non-nil value to prevent the current gamemode from handling this event. In the `base` gamemode, the gamemode handles player respawning in this hook. So blocking the gamemode hook will prevent player from respawning, in this specific case.
NOTES: This hook does not define a return value. The description below just describes how the hook library works in general.

PlayerDisconnected.DESCRIPTION: Called when a player leaves the server. See the [player_disconnect gameevent](/gmod/gameevent/player_disconnect) for a shared version of this hook that includes the disconnect reason too.

BUGS.DESCRIPTION: This is not called in single-player or listen servers for the host.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: the player

PlayerDriveAnimate.DESCRIPTION: Called to update the player's animation during a drive.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The driving player

PlayerDroppedWeapon.DESCRIPTION:
Called when a weapon is dropped by a player via [Player:DropWeapon](/gmod/Player:DropWeapon). Despite its name, this hook is also called for NPC weapon drops.

Also called when a weapon is removed from a player via [Player:StripWeapon](/gmod/Player:StripWeapon).

See also [GM:WeaponEquip](/gmod/GM:WeaponEquip) for a hook when a player picks up a weapon.

The weapon's [Entity:GetOwner](/gmod/Entity:GetOwner) will be NULL at the time this hook is called.

[WEAPON:OnDrop](/gmod/WEAPON:OnDrop) will be called before this hook is.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: owner
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The player or NPC who owned this weapon before it was dropped.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: wep
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The weapon that was dropped.

PlayerEndVoice.DESCRIPTION:
Called when player stops using voice chat.

See [GM:PlayerStartVoice](/gmod/GM:PlayerStartVoice) for the opposite hook.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Player who stopped talking. Can be NULL when player entity is outside of the PVS. Use the player index.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: plyIndex
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The [player index](/gmod/Entity:EntIndex) of the talking player.

PlayerEnteredVehicle.DESCRIPTION:
Called when a player enters a vehicle.

Called just after [GM:CanPlayerEnterVehicle](/gmod/GM:CanPlayerEnterVehicle).

See also [GM:PlayerLeaveVehicle](/gmod/GM:PlayerLeaveVehicle).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ply
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Player who entered vehicle.
