See also [DIconLayout:SetStretchHeight](/gmod/DIconLayout:SetStretchHeight)

DIconLayout.DESCRIPTION:
DIconLayout is what replaced [DPanelList](/gmod/DPanelList) in Garry's Mod 13. 
		DPanelList still exists in GMod but is deprecated and does not support the new GWEN skin.

		[DIconLayout](/gmod/DIconLayout) is used to make a list of panels. 
		Unlike DPanelList, DIconLayout does not automatically add a scroll bar - the example below shows you how you can do this.

DoLoadMaterial.DESCRIPTION: Actually loads the [IMaterial](/gmod/IMaterial) to render it. Called from [DImage:LoadMaterial](/gmod/DImage:LoadMaterial).

FixVertexLitMaterial.DESCRIPTION:
"Fixes" the current material of the [DImage](/gmod/DImage) if it has VertexLit shader by creating a new one with the same name and a prefix of "_DImage" and automatically calling [DImage:SetMaterial](/gmod/DImage:SetMaterial) with the new material.

This fixes the problem where using materials using shaders that expect lighting information causing "weird" flickering when displayed in 2D/Unlit environment.

GetFailsafeMatName.DESCRIPTION: Returns the texture path set by [DImage:SetFailsafeMatName](/gmod/DImage:SetFailsafeMatName).

GetImage.DESCRIPTION: Returns the image loaded in the image panel.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The path to the image that is loaded.

GetImageColor.DESCRIPTION: Returns the color override of the image panel.

RETURNS.NAME: col
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The color override of the image. Uses [Color](/gmod/Color).

GetKeepAspect.DESCRIPTION:
Returns whether the [DImage](/gmod/DImage) should keep the aspect ratio of its image when being resized.

See [DImage:SetKeepAspect](/gmod/DImage:SetKeepAspect) for more info on how it works.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the [DImage](/gmod/DImage) should keep the aspect ratio of its image when being resized.

GetMatName.DESCRIPTION: Returns the texture path set by [DImage:SetMatName](/gmod/DImage:SetMatName).

LoadMaterial.DESCRIPTION:
Initializes the loading process of the material to render if it is not loaded yet.

You do not need to call this function. It is done for you automatically.

PaintAt.DESCRIPTION: Paints a ghost copy of the DImage panel at the given position and dimensions. This function overrides [Panel:PaintAt](/gmod/Panel:PaintAt).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: posX
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The x coordinate to draw the panel from.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: posY
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The y coordinate to draw the panel from.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: width
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The width of the panel image to be drawn.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: height
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The height of the panel image to be drawn.

SetFailsafeMatName.DESCRIPTION: Sets the backup material to be loaded when the image is first rendered. Used by [DImage:SetOnViewMaterial](/gmod/DImage:SetOnViewMaterial).

SetImage.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the image to load into the frame. If the first image can't be loaded and `strBackup` is set, that image will be loaded instead.

This eventually calls [DImage:SetMaterial](/gmod/DImage:SetMaterial).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: strImage
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The path of the image to load, relative to the `materials/` folder. When no file extension is supplied the `.vmt` file extension is assumed.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: strBackup
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The path of the backup image.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: col
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The color override of the image. Uses [Color](/gmod/Color).

SetKeepAspect.DESCRIPTION:
Sets whether the [DImage](/gmod/DImage) should keep the aspect ratio of its image when being resized.

Note that this will not try to fit the image inside the button, but instead it will fill the button with the image.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: keep
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: true to keep the aspect ratio, false not to

SetMaterial.DESCRIPTION: Sets a [Material](/gmod/Global.Material) directly as an image.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: mat
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The material to set

SetMatName.DESCRIPTION: Sets the material to be loaded when the image is first rendered. Used by [DImage:SetOnViewMaterial](/gmod/DImage:SetOnViewMaterial).

SetOnViewMaterial.DESCRIPTION:
Similar to [DImage:SetImage](/gmod/DImage:SetImage), but will only do the expensive part of actually loading the textures/material if the material is about to be rendered/viewed.

Useful for cases like [DIconBrowser](/gmod/DIconBrowser), where there are hundreds of small icons in 1 panel in a list that do not need all to be loaded at the same time.

Unloaded.DESCRIPTION: Returns true if the image is **not** yet loaded.

DImage.DESCRIPTION:
[DImage](/gmod/DImage) is an advanced, more robust version of the [Material](/gmod/Material) panel.

		See [DImageButton](/gmod/DImageButton) for a click-able version of this panel.

DepressImage.DESCRIPTION: Used internally to briefly scale the image when clicked.

GetDepressImage.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether [DImageButton:DepressImage](/gmod/DImageButton:DepressImage) is functional or not.

RETURNS.NAME: enable
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: `true` to enable image depressing when clicked.

GetImage.DESCRIPTION: Returns the "image" of the [DImageButton](/gmod/DImageButton). Equivalent of [DImage:GetImage](/gmod/DImage:GetImage).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The path to the image that is loaded.

GetStretchToFit.DESCRIPTION:
Returns whether the image inside the button should be stretched to fit it or not

See [DImageButton:SetStretchToFit](/gmod/DImageButton:SetStretchToFit)

SetColor.DESCRIPTION: Sets the color of the image. Equivalent of [DImage:SetImageColor](/gmod/DImage:SetImageColor)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: color
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The [Color](/gmod/Color) to set

SetDepressImage.DESCRIPTION: Controls whether [DImageButton:DepressImage](/gmod/DImageButton:DepressImage) is functional or not.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: enable
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: `true` to enable image depressing when clicked.

SetImage.DESCRIPTION: Sets the "image" of the [DImageButton](/gmod/DImageButton). Equivalent of [DImage:SetImage](/gmod/DImage:SetImage).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: strImage
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The path of the image to load, relative to the `materials/` folder. When no file extension is supplied the `.vmt` file extension is assumed.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: strBackup
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The path of the backup image.

SetImageVisible.DESCRIPTION: Hides or shows the image of the image button. Internally this calls [Panel:SetVisible](/gmod/Panel:SetVisible) on the internal [DImage](/gmod/DImage).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: visible
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Set true to make it visible ( default ), or false to hide the image

SetKeepAspect.DESCRIPTION:
Sets whether the [DImageButton](/gmod/DImageButton) should keep the aspect ratio of its image. Equivalent of [DImage:SetKeepAspect](/gmod/DImage:SetKeepAspect).

Note that this will not try to fit the image inside the button, but instead it will fill the button with the image.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: keep
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: true to keep the aspect ratio, false not to

SetMaterial.DESCRIPTION: Sets a [Material](/gmod/Global.Material) directly as an image. Equivalent of [DImage:SetMaterial](/gmod/DImage:SetMaterial).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: mat
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The material to set

SetStretchToFit.DESCRIPTION:
Sets whether the image inside the [DImageButton](/gmod/DImageButton) should be stretched to fill the entire size of the button, without preserving aspect ratio.

If set to false, the image will not be resized at all.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: stretch
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: True to stretch, false to not to stretch

DImageButton.DESCRIPTION:
An image button.

		This panel inherits all methods of [DButton](/gmod/DButton), such as [DLabel:DoClick](/gmod/DLabel:DoClick).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The name of the killicon currently being displayed.

SetName.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the killicon to be displayed. You should call [Panel:SizeToContents](/gmod/Panel:SizeToContents) following this.

Killicons can be added with [killicon.Add](/gmod/killicon.Add) and [killicon.AddFont](/gmod/killicon.AddFont).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: iconName
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The name of the killicon to be displayed.

DKillIcon.DESCRIPTION: Uses the [killicon](/gmod/killicon) to persistently draw a killicon.

DoClick.DESCRIPTION:
Called when the label is left clicked (on key release) by the player.

This will be called after [DLabel:OnDepressed](/gmod/DLabel:OnDepressed) and [DLabel:OnReleased](/gmod/DLabel:OnReleased).

This can be overridden; by default, it calls [DLabel:Toggle](/gmod/DLabel:Toggle).

See also [DLabel:DoRightClick](/gmod/DLabel:DoRightClick), [DLabel:DoMiddleClick](/gmod/DLabel:DoMiddleClick) and [DLabel:DoDoubleClick](/gmod/DLabel:DoDoubleClick).

DoDoubleClick.DESCRIPTION:
Called when the label is double clicked by the player with left clicks.

[DLabel:SetDoubleClickingEnabled](/gmod/DLabel:SetDoubleClickingEnabled) must be set to true for this hook to work, which it is by default.

This will be called after [DLabel:OnDepressed](/gmod/DLabel:OnDepressed) and [DLabel:OnReleased](/gmod/DLabel:OnReleased) and [DLabel:DoClick](/gmod/DLabel:DoClick).

See also [DLabel:DoRightClick](/gmod/DLabel:DoRightClick) and [DLabel:DoMiddleClick](/gmod/DLabel:DoMiddleClick).

DoMiddleClick.DESCRIPTION:
Called when the label is middle mouse (Mouse wheel, also known as mouse 3) clicked (on key release) by the player.

This will be called after [DLabel:OnDepressed](/gmod/DLabel:OnDepressed) and [DLabel:OnReleased](/gmod/DLabel:OnReleased).

See also [DLabel:DoClick](/gmod/DLabel:DoClick), [DLabel:DoRightClick](/gmod/DLabel:DoRightClick) and [DLabel:DoDoubleClick](/gmod/DLabel:DoDoubleClick).

DoRightClick.DESCRIPTION:
Called when the label is right clicked (on key release) by the player.

This will be called after [DLabel:OnDepressed](/gmod/DLabel:OnDepressed) and [DLabel:OnReleased](/gmod/DLabel:OnReleased).

See also [DLabel:DoClick](/gmod/DLabel:DoClick), [DLabel:DoMiddleClick](/gmod/DLabel:DoMiddleClick) and [DLabel:DoDoubleClick](/gmod/DLabel:DoDoubleClick).

OnDepressed.DESCRIPTION:
Called when the player presses the label with any mouse button.

This works as an alternative to [PANEL:OnMousePressed](/gmod/PANEL:OnMousePressed) as that hook is used heavily by [DLabel](/gmod/DLabel) and overriding it will break functionality.

See also [DLabel:DoClick](/gmod/DLabel:DoClick), [DLabel:DoMiddleClick](/gmod/DLabel:DoMiddleClick), [DLabel:DoRightClick](/gmod/DLabel:DoRightClick), [DLabel:OnReleased](/gmod/DLabel:OnReleased) and [DLabel:DoDoubleClick](/gmod/DLabel:DoDoubleClick).

OnReleased.DESCRIPTION:
Called when the player releases any mouse button on the label. This is always called after [DLabel:OnDepressed](/gmod/DLabel:OnDepressed).

This works as an alternative to [PANEL:OnMouseReleased](/gmod/PANEL:OnMouseReleased) as that hook is used heavily by [DLabel](/gmod/DLabel) and overriding it will break functionality.

See also [DLabel:DoClick](/gmod/DLabel:DoClick), [DLabel:DoMiddleClick](/gmod/DLabel:DoMiddleClick), [DLabel:DoRightClick](/gmod/DLabel:DoRightClick) and [DLabel:DoDoubleClick](/gmod/DLabel:DoDoubleClick).

OnToggled.DESCRIPTION:
Called when the toggle state of the label is changed by [DLabel:Toggle](/gmod/DLabel:Toggle).

In order to use toggle functionality, you must first call [DLabel:SetIsToggle](/gmod/DLabel:SetIsToggle) with `true`, as it is disabled by default.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: toggleState
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The new toggle state.

DoClickInternal.DESCRIPTION:
Called just before [DLabel:DoClick](/gmod/DLabel:DoClick).

In [DLabel](/gmod/DLabel) does nothing and is safe to override. Used by [DMenuOption](/gmod/DMenuOption) and [DCollapsibleCategory](/gmod/DCollapsibleCategory)'s tabs.

DoDoubleClickInternal.DESCRIPTION: Called just before [DLabel:DoDoubleClick](/gmod/DLabel:DoDoubleClick). In [DLabel](/gmod/DLabel) does nothing and is safe to override.

GetAutoStretchVertical.DESCRIPTION:
Returns whether the label stretches vertically or not.

Set by [DLabel:SetAutoStretchVertical](/gmod/DLabel:SetAutoStretchVertical).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the label stretches vertically or not.

GetBright.DESCRIPTION:
Returns whether the [DLabel](/gmod/DLabel) should set its text color to the current skin's bright text color.

See [DLabel:SetBright](/gmod/DLabel:SetBright).

GetColor.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the actual color of the text.

See also [DLabel:GetTextColor](/gmod/DLabel:GetTextColor) and [DLabel:GetTextStyleColor](/gmod/DLabel:GetTextStyleColor).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The the actual [Color](/gmod/Color) of the text.

GetDark.DESCRIPTION:
Returns whether the [DLabel](/gmod/DLabel) should set its text color to the current skin's dark text color.

See [DLabel:SetDark](/gmod/DLabel:SetDark).

GetDisabled.DESCRIPTION: Gets the disabled state of the [DLabel](/gmod/DLabel). This is set with [DLabel:SetDisabled](/gmod/DLabel:SetDisabled).
DEPRECATED: Use Panel:IsEnabled instead.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The disabled state of the label.

GetDoubleClickingEnabled.DESCRIPTION:
Returns whether or not double clicking will call [DLabel:DoDoubleClick](/gmod/DLabel:DoDoubleClick).

See [DLabel:SetDoubleClickingEnabled](/gmod/DLabel:SetDoubleClickingEnabled).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: true = enabled, false means disabled

GetDrawBackground.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether or not the panel background is being drawn. Alias of [DLabel:GetPaintBackground](/gmod/DLabel:GetPaintBackground).
DEPRECATED: You should use DLabel:GetPaintBackground instead.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: True if the panel background is drawn, false otherwise.

GetFont.DESCRIPTION: Returns the current font of the DLabel. This is set with [DLabel:SetFont](/gmod/DLabel:SetFont).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The name of the font in use.

GetHighlight.DESCRIPTION:
Returns whether the [DLabel](/gmod/DLabel) should set its text color to the current skin's highlighted text color.

See [DLabel:SetHighlight](/gmod/DLabel:SetHighlight).

GetIsMenu.DESCRIPTION:
Used internally by [DComboBox](/gmod/DComboBox).

Returns whether the frame is part of a derma menu or not.

If this is `true`, [CloseDermaMenus](/gmod/Global.CloseDermaMenus) will not be called when the frame is clicked, and thus any open menus will remain open.

RETURNS.NAME: isMenu
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether this panel is a Menu Component

GetIsToggle.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether the toggle functionality is enabled for a label. Set with [DLabel:SetIsToggle](/gmod/DLabel:SetIsToggle).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether or not toggle functionality is enabled.

GetPaintBackground.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether or not the background should be painted.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: If the background is painted or not

GetTextColor.DESCRIPTION: Returns the "override" text color, set by [DLabel:SetTextColor](/gmod/DLabel:SetTextColor).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The [Color](/gmod/Color) of the text, or nil.

GetTextStyleColor.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the "internal" or fallback color of the text.

See also [DLabel:GetTextColor](/gmod/DLabel:GetTextColor) and [DLabel:SetTextStyleColor](/gmod/DLabel:SetTextStyleColor).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The "internal" [Color](/gmod/Color) of the text

GetToggle.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the current toggle state of the label. This can be set with [DLabel:SetToggle](/gmod/DLabel:SetToggle) and toggled with [DLabel:Toggle](/gmod/DLabel:Toggle).

In order to use toggle functionality, you must first call [DLabel:SetIsToggle](/gmod/DLabel:SetIsToggle) with `true`, as it is disabled by default.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The current toggle state.

SetAutoStretchVertical.DESCRIPTION: Automatically adjusts the height of the label dependent of the height of the text inside of it.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: stretch
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Whenever to stretch the label vertically or not.

SetBright.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the color of the text to the bright text color defined in the skin.

Disables [DLabel:SetDark](/gmod/DLabel:SetDark). Gets overridden by [DLabel:SetHighlight](/gmod/DLabel:SetHighlight).

You should only consider using this if you are using background elements that are not manually painted and are using the skin colors. Otherwise use [DLabel:SetTextColor](/gmod/DLabel:SetTextColor).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: bright
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Whenever to set the text to bright or not.

SetColor.DESCRIPTION: Changes color of label. Alias of [DLabel:SetTextColor](/gmod/DLabel:SetTextColor).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: color
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The color to set. Uses [Color](/gmod/Color).

SetDark.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the color of the text to the dark text color defined in the skin.

Disables [DLabel:SetBright](/gmod/DLabel:SetBright). Gets overridden by [DLabel:SetHighlight](/gmod/DLabel:SetHighlight).

You should only consider using this if you are using background elements that are not manually painted and are using the skin colors. Otherwise use [DLabel:SetTextColor](/gmod/DLabel:SetTextColor).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: dark
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Whenever to set the text to dark or not.

SetDisabled.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the disabled state of the [DLabel](/gmod/DLabel).

When disabled, the label does not respond to click, toggle or drag & drop actions.
DEPRECATED: Use Panel:SetEnabled instead.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: disable
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: `true` to disable the DLabel, `false` to enable it.

SetDoubleClickingEnabled.DESCRIPTION:
Sets whether or not double clicking should call [DLabel:DoDoubleClick](/gmod/DLabel:DoDoubleClick).

This is enabled by default.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: enable
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: true to enable, false to disable

SetDrawBackground.DESCRIPTION: Sets whether or not to draw the panel background. Alias of [DLabel:SetPaintBackground](/gmod/DLabel:SetPaintBackground).
DEPRECATED: You should use DLabel:SetPaintBackground instead.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: draw
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: True to show the panel's background, false to hide it.

SetFont.DESCRIPTION: Sets the font of the label.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: fontName
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION:
The name of the font.

See [here](/gmod/Default_Fonts) for a list of existing fonts.
Alternatively, use [surface.CreateFont](/gmod/surface.CreateFont) to create your own custom font.

SetHighlight.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the color of the text to the highlight text color defined in the skin.

For the default Derma skin this makes the label red.

Overrides colors set by both [DLabel:SetBright](/gmod/DLabel:SetBright) and [DLabel:SetDark](/gmod/DLabel:SetDark) while active.

You should only consider using this if you are using background elements that are not manually painted and are using the skin colors. Otherwise use [DLabel:SetTextColor](/gmod/DLabel:SetTextColor).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: highlight
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: true to set the label's color to skins's text highlight color, false otherwise.

SetIsMenu.DESCRIPTION:
Used internally by [DComboBox](/gmod/DComboBox).


Sets whether the frame is part of a derma menu or not.

If this is set to `true`, [CloseDermaMenus](/gmod/Global.CloseDermaMenus) will not be called when the frame is clicked, and thus any open menus will remain open.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: isMenu
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Whether this pane is a Menu Component

SetIsToggle.DESCRIPTION:
Enables or disables toggle functionality for a label. Retrieved with [DLabel:GetIsToggle](/gmod/DLabel:GetIsToggle).

You must call this before using [DLabel:SetToggle](/gmod/DLabel:SetToggle), [DLabel:GetToggle](/gmod/DLabel:GetToggle) or [DLabel:Toggle](/gmod/DLabel:Toggle).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: allowToggle
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Whether or not to enable toggle functionality.

SetPaintBackground.DESCRIPTION: Sets whether or not the background should be painted. This is mainly used by derivative classes, such as [DButton](/gmod/DButton).

SetTextColor.DESCRIPTION: Sets the text color of the [DLabel](/gmod/DLabel). This will take precedence over [DLabel:SetTextStyleColor](/gmod/DLabel:SetTextStyleColor).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: color
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The text color. Uses [Color](/gmod/Color).

SetTextStyleColor.DESCRIPTION: Used by [DLabel:SetDark](/gmod/DLabel:SetDark), [DLabel:SetBright](/gmod/DLabel:SetBright) and [DLabel:SetHighlight](/gmod/DLabel:SetHighlight) to set the text color without affecting [DLabel:SetTextColor](/gmod/DLabel:SetTextColor) calls.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: color
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The text color. Uses the [Color](/gmod/Color).

SetToggle.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the toggle state of the label. This can be retrieved with [DLabel:GetToggle](/gmod/DLabel:GetToggle) and toggled with [DLabel:Toggle](/gmod/DLabel:Toggle).

In order to use toggle functionality, you must first call [DLabel:SetIsToggle](/gmod/DLabel:SetIsToggle) with `true`, as it is disabled by default.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: toggleState
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The toggle state to be set.

Toggle.DESCRIPTION:
Toggles the label's state. This can be set and retrieved with [DLabel:SetToggle](/gmod/DLabel:SetToggle) and [DLabel:GetToggle](/gmod/DLabel:GetToggle).

In order to use toggle functionality, you must first call [DLabel:SetIsToggle](/gmod/DLabel:SetIsToggle) with `true`, as it is disabled by default.

UpdateColours.DESCRIPTION: A hook called from within [PANEL:ApplySchemeSettings](/gmod/PANEL:ApplySchemeSettings) to determine the color of the text on display.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: skin
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: A table supposed to contain the color values listed above.

UpdateFGColor.DESCRIPTION: Called internally to update the color of the text.

DLabel.DESCRIPTION: A standard Derma text label. A lot of this panels functionality is a base for button elements, such as [DButton](/gmod/DButton)

GetAutoStretch.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether the editable label will stretch to the text entered or not.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the editable label will stretch to the text entered or not.

IsEditing.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether this [DLabelEditable](/gmod/DLabelEditable) is being edited or not. (i.e. has focus)

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether this [DLabelEditable](/gmod/DLabelEditable) is being edited or not

OnLabelTextChanged.DESCRIPTION:
A hook called when the player presses Enter (i.e. the finished editing the label) and the text has changed.

Allows you to override/modify the text that will be set to display.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: txt
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The original user input text

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: If provided, will override the text that will be applied to the label itself.

SetAutoStretch.DESCRIPTION: Sets whether the editable label should stretch to the text entered or not.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: stretch
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the editable label should stretch to the text entered or not.

DLabelEditable.DESCRIPTION:
An editable [DLabel](/gmod/DLabel), double click on it to edit.

		This is used in the spawnmenu spawnlist headers.

RETURNS.NAME: draw
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Does nothing.

GetColor.DESCRIPTION: Gets the current text color of the [DLabelURL](/gmod/DLabelURL). Returns either [DLabelURL:GetTextColor](/gmod/DLabelURL:GetTextColor) or if that is unset -  [DLabelURL:GetTextStyleColor](/gmod/DLabelURL:GetTextStyleColor).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The current text [Color](/gmod/Color).

GetTextColor.DESCRIPTION: Gets the current text color of the [DLabelURL](/gmod/DLabelURL) set by [DLabelURL:SetTextColor](/gmod/DLabelURL:SetTextColor).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The current text [Color](/gmod/Color).
The [Color](/gmod/Color)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: draw
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Does nothing.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: col
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The [Color](/gmod/Color) to use.

SetTextColor.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the text color of the [DLabelURL](/gmod/DLabelURL). Overrides [DLabelURL:SetTextStyleColor](/gmod/DLabelURL:SetTextStyleColor).


This should only be used immediately after it is created, and otherwise [Panel:SetFGColor](/gmod/Panel:SetFGColor).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: col
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The [Color](/gmod/Color) to use.

SetTextStyleColor.DESCRIPTION: Sets the base text color of the [DLabelURL](/gmod/DLabelURL). This is overridden by [DLabelURL:SetTextColor](/gmod/DLabelURL:SetTextColor).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: color
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The [Color](/gmod/Color) to set

UpdateFGColor.DESCRIPTION: Used internally to set correct text color via [Panel:SetFGColor](/gmod/Panel:SetFGColor) and [DLabelURL:GetColor](/gmod/DLabelURL:GetColor).

DLabelURL.DESCRIPTION:
Underlined link label without a DoClick function. When a valid URL is set and the label is clicked, it will open a browser window and navigate to the address.

This panel uses [gui.OpenURL](/gmod/gui.OpenURL) internally and its restrictions apply.

GetMultiple.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether the list box can select multiple items.

RETURNS.NAME: multiple
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the list box can select multiple items.
The selected items. A list of [DListBoxItem](/gmod/DListBoxItem).
The selected item values. A list of [Panel:GetValue](/gmod/Panel:GetValue) of each selected [DListBoxItem](/gmod/DListBoxItem).

SelectByName.DESCRIPTION: Select a [DListBoxItem](/gmod/DListBoxItem) based on its value.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: val
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: [Panel:GetValue](/gmod/Panel:GetValue) of a [DListBoxItem](/gmod/DListBoxItem) to select.

SelectItem.DESCRIPTION: Used internally to select a specific panel.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: item
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: [DListBox](/gmod/DListBox) to select.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: onlyme
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Whether to deselect other selected items.

SetMultiple.DESCRIPTION: Sets whether the list box can select multiple items.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: multiple
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the list box can select multiple items.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: items
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The items to select. A list of [DListBoxItem](/gmod/DListBoxItem).

DListBox.DESCRIPTION:
A simple list box with optional multi-select.  
		As this is deprecated, it is recommended that you use [DListView](/gmod/DListView), which contains the same functionality with multi-column options.
DEPRECATED: Derived from the deprecated DPanelList.

GetMother.DESCRIPTION: Returns the parent "mother" of this **DListBoxItem** set by [DListBoxItem:SetMother](/gmod/DListBoxItem:SetMother).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The "mother" [DListBox](/gmod/DListBox).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: onlyMe
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Whether to deselect other items.

SetMother.DESCRIPTION: Sets the "mother" (parent) panel for this item. Done internally by [DListBox:AddItem](/gmod/DListBox:AddItem)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: parent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The "mother" panel to set.

DEPRECATED: Used Internally by DListBox.

DoDoubleClick.DESCRIPTION: Called when a line in the DListView is double clicked.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: lineID

DScrollPanel.DESCRIPTION:
DScrollPanel is a VGUI Element similar to DPanel however it has a vertical scrollbar docked to the right which can be used to put more content in a smaller area. DScrollPanels are essentially [DPanel](/gmod/DPanel)s with the Scroll Bar.

This can be used to replace the [DPanelList](/gmod/DPanelList) with [DPanelList:EnableVerticalScrollbar](/gmod/DPanelList:EnableVerticalScrollbar) and get similar functionality as well as using a non-deprecated element.

If you would like to paint or edit the elements of the scrollbar use [DScrollPanel:GetVBar](/gmod/DScrollPanel:GetVBar). If you want to see if the scrollbar is visible then use the VBar.Enabled variable on the scrollbar's VBar.

By default, this only checks whether the panel disallows numeric characters, preventing it from being edited if the value contains any.

This is actually an engine hook that only works on [TextEntry](/gmod/TextEntry) derived elements.

If you are looking for a way to modify character limits, see [Panel:SetMaximumCharCount](/gmod/Panel:SetMaximumCharCount)

DTileLayout.DESCRIPTION:
Similarly to [DIconLayout](/gmod/DIconLayout), this lays out panels in two dimensions as tiles.

		The difference between this and [DIconLayout](/gmod/DIconLayout) is that [DIconLayout](/gmod/DIconLayout) items all have the same height while
		[DTileLayout](/gmod/DTileLayout) items do not have this enforcement. 
		[DTileLayout](/gmod/DTileLayout) will find the best way to "pack" its children.  
		For example, in a two column layout, a item of height 2 units will be placed in one column while 
		two items of height 1 unit will be placed in the other column. 

		It is worth noting however that because this panel iterates through its children in an undefined order and lays out while
		it is iterating, there is no guarantee that this packing will lead to the lowest possible height.

		This is used by the spawnmenu to arrange spawnicons.

		The base size defines the smallest a tile can be, and it will resize vertically to accommodate all child panels.
		The number of elements in each row is determined by the base size and width.

		It also optionally permits the rearrangement of these tiles.
		To enable this functionality, call [DDragBase:MakeDroppable](/gmod/DDragBase:MakeDroppable) on the DTileLayout with a unique identifier.
		All panels added following this will be moveable.

GetDoubleClickToOpen.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether the double clock to collapse/expand functionality is enabled on this node.

GetDrawLines.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether or not this node is drawing lines

GetExpanded.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether the node is expanded or not.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Expanded or not.

GetFileName.DESCRIPTION: Returns the filepath of the file attached to this node.

GetFolder.DESCRIPTION: Returns the folder path to search in, set by [DTree_Node:MakeFolder](/gmod/DTree_Node:MakeFolder).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The folder path.

GetForceShowExpander.DESCRIPTION:
Returns whether the expand/collapse button is shown on this node regardless of whether or not it has sub-nodes.

See also [DTree_Node:SetForceShowExpander](/gmod/DTree_Node:SetForceShowExpander).

GetHideExpander.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether the expand button (little + button) should be shown or hidden.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Цhether the expand button should be shown or hidden.

GetIcon.DESCRIPTION: Returns the image path to the icon of this node.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The path to the image

GetIndentSize.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the indentation level of the [DTree](/gmod/DTree) this node belongs to.

Alias of [DTree:GetIndentSize](/gmod/DTree:GetIndentSize), see it for more info.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The indentation level.

GetLastChild.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether this node is the last child on this level or not.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether this node is the last child on this level or not.

GetLineHeight.DESCRIPTION:
The height of a single [DTree_Node](/gmod/DTree_Node) of the [DTree](/gmod/DTree) this node belongs to.

Alias of [DTree:GetLineHeight](/gmod/DTree:GetLineHeight).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The height of a single [DTree_Node](/gmod/DTree_Node).

GetNeedsChildSearch.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether the node still needs a filesystem search for sub-nodes.
DEPRECATED: Seems to be unused entirely.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the node still needs a filesystem search.

GetNeedsPopulating.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether or not the node is set to be populated from the filesystem.

GetParentNode.DESCRIPTION: Returns the parent [DTree_Node](/gmod/DTree_Node). Note that [Panel:GetParent](/gmod/Panel:GetParent) will not be the same!

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The parent node.

GetPathID.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the path ID ([File Search Paths](/gmod/File%20Search%20Paths)) used in populating the [DTree](/gmod/DTree) from the filesystem.

See [DTree_Node:SetPathID](/gmod/DTree_Node:SetPathID) and [DTree_Node:MakeFolder](/gmod/DTree_Node:MakeFolder).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The Path ID

GetRoot.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the root node, the [DTree](/gmod/DTree) this node is under.

See also [DTree_Node:GetParentNode](/gmod/DTree_Node:GetParentNode).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The root node

GetShowFiles.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether or not nodes for files should/will be added when populating the node from filesystem.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The search wildcard

Insert.DESCRIPTION: Inserts a sub-node into this node before or after the given node.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: node
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The [DTree_Node](/gmod/DTree_Node) to insert.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: nodeNextTo
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The node to insert the node above before or after.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: before
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: true to insert before, false to insert after.

InsertNode.DESCRIPTION:
Inserts an existing node as a "child" or a sub-node of this node.
Used internally by the drag'n'drop functionality.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: node
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Has to be [DTree_Node](/gmod/DTree_Node)

InstallDraggable.DESCRIPTION:
Called automatically internally.

Makes the target node compatible with this node's drag'n'drop.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: node
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The [DTree_Node](/gmod/DTree_Node).

IsRootNode.DESCRIPTION: Returns true if [DTree_Node:GetRoot](/gmod/DTree_Node:GetRoot) is the same as [DTree_Node:GetParentNode](/gmod/DTree_Node:GetParentNode) of this node.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: If this is a root node.

LeaveTree.DESCRIPTION:
Removes given node as a sub-node of this node.

It doesn't actually remove or unparent the panel, just removes it from the internal [DListView](/gmod/DListView).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: pnl
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The node to remove

MakeFolder.DESCRIPTION:
Makes this node a folder in the filesystem. This will make it automatically populated.

See also [DTree_Node:AddFolder](/gmod/DTree_Node:AddFolder).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: folder
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The folder in the filesystem to use, relative to the garrysmod/ folder.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: path
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The path to search in. See [File Search Paths](/gmod/File%20Search%20Paths)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: showFiles
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Should files be added as nodes (true) or folders only (false)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: wildcard
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The wildcard to use when searching for files.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: dontForceExpandable
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: If set to true, don't show the expand buttons on empty nodes.

MoveChildTo.DESCRIPTION:
Moves given panel to the top of the children of this node.

Despite name of this function, it cannot move the children to any position but the topmost.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: node
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The node to move.

MoveToTop.DESCRIPTION: Moves this node to the top of the level.

PerformRootNodeLayout.DESCRIPTION: Called automatically to perform layout on this node if this node [DTree_Node:IsRootNode](/gmod/DTree_Node:IsRootNode).

PopulateChildrenAndSelf.DESCRIPTION: Called automatically from [DTree_Node:SetExpanded](/gmod/DTree_Node:SetExpanded) (or when user manually expands the node) to populate the node with sub-nodes from the filesystem if this was enabled via [DTree_Node:MakeFolder](/gmod/DTree_Node:MakeFolder).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: expand
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Expand self once population process is finished.

SetDirty.DESCRIPTION: Appears to have no effect on the [DTree_Node](/gmod/DTree_Node).

SetDoubleClickToOpen.DESCRIPTION: Sets whether double clicking the node should expand/collapse it or not.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: enable
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: true to enable, false to disable this functionality.

SetDraggableName.DESCRIPTION: Used to store name for sub elements for a [Panel:Droppable](/gmod/Panel:Droppable) call.

SetDrawLines.DESCRIPTION: Sets whether or not this node should draw visual lines.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: expand
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Whether to expand (true) or collapse (false)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: surpressAnimation
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Whether to play animation (false) or not (true)

SetFileName.DESCRIPTION: Sets the file full filepath to the file attached to this node

SetFolder.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the folder to search files and folders in.

Use [DTree_Node:MakeFolder](/gmod/DTree_Node:MakeFolder) instead.

SetForceShowExpander.DESCRIPTION: Sets whether or not the expand/collapse button (+/- button) should be shown on this node regardless of whether it has sub-elements or not.

SetHideExpander.DESCRIPTION: Sets whether the expand button (little + button) should be shown or hidden.

SetIcon.DESCRIPTION: Sets the material for the icon of the [DTree_Node](/gmod/DTree_Node).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: path
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The path to the material to be used. Do not include "materials/". .pngs are supported.

SetLastChild.DESCRIPTION: Called automatically to set whether this node is the last child on this level or not.

SetNeedsChildSearch.DESCRIPTION: Sets whether the node still needs a filesystem search for sub-nodes.
DEPRECATED: Seems to be unused entirely.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: newState
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: New state.

SetNeedsPopulating.DESCRIPTION: Sets whether or not the node needs populating from the filesystem.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: needs
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Whether or not the node needs populating

SetParentNode.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the parent node of this node. Not the same as [Panel:SetParent](/gmod/Panel:SetParent).

This is set automatically, you shouldn't use this.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: parent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The panel to set as a parent node for this node

SetPathID.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the path ID ([File Search Paths](/gmod/File%20Search%20Paths)) for populating the tree from the filesystem.

Use [DTree_Node:MakeFolder](/gmod/DTree_Node:MakeFolder) instead.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: path
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The path ID to set.

SetRoot.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the root node (the [DTree](/gmod/DTree)) of this node.

This is set automatically, you shouldn't use this.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: root
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The panel to set as root node.

SetSelected.DESCRIPTION: Called automatically to update the "selected" status of this node.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: selected
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Whether this node is currently selected or not.

SetShowFiles.DESCRIPTION: Sets whether or not nodes for files should be added when populating the node from filesystem.

SetWildCard.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the search wildcard.

Use [DTree_Node:MakeFolder](/gmod/DTree_Node:MakeFolder) instead

ARGUMENTS.NAME: wildcard
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The wildcard to set

ShowIcons.DESCRIPTION:
Returns whether or not the [DTree](/gmod/DTree) this node is in has icons enabled.

See [DTree:ShowIcons](/gmod/DTree:ShowIcons) for more info.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the icons are shown or not

DTree_Node.DESCRIPTION:
This panel is created whenever you add a node to a [DTree](/gmod/DTree).
The root node of a [DTree](/gmod/DTree) is also a [DTree_Node](/gmod/DTree_Node) and controls much of its action. it can be accessed with [DTree:Root](/gmod/DTree:Root).

DoConstraints.DESCRIPTION: Used internally to clamp the vertical divider to [DVerticalDivider:GetTopMin](/gmod/DVerticalDivider:GetTopMin) and [DVerticalDivider:GetBottomMin](/gmod/DVerticalDivider:GetBottomMin).

GetBottom.DESCRIPTION: Returns the bottom content panel of the [DVerticalDivider](/gmod/DVerticalDivider).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The bottom content panel.

GetBottomMin.DESCRIPTION: Returns the minimum height of the bottom content panel.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The minimum height of the bottom content panel.

GetDividerHeight.DESCRIPTION: Returns the height of the divider bar between the top and bottom content panels of the [DVerticalDivider](/gmod/DVerticalDivider).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The height of the divider bar.

GetDragging.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether the divider is being dragged or not.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: If true, mouse movement will alter the size of the divider.

GetHoldPos.DESCRIPTION: Returns the local Y position of where the user starts dragging the divider.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The local Y position where divider dragging has started.

GetMiddle.DESCRIPTION: Returns the middle content panel of the [DVerticalDivider](/gmod/DVerticalDivider).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The middle content panel.

GetTop.DESCRIPTION: Returns the top content panel of the [DVerticalDivider](/gmod/DVerticalDivider).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The top content panel.

GetTopHeight.DESCRIPTION: Returns the current height of the top content panel set by [DVerticalDivider:SetTopHeight](/gmod/DVerticalDivider:SetTopHeight) or by the user.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The current height of the [DVerticalDivider](/gmod/DVerticalDivider).

GetTopMax.DESCRIPTION: Returns the maximum height of the top content panel. See [DVerticalDivider:SetTopMax](/gmod/DVerticalDivider:SetTopMax) for more information.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The maximum height of the top content panel.

GetTopMin.DESCRIPTION: Returns the minimum height of the top content panel.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The minimum height of the top content panel.

SetBottom.DESCRIPTION: Sets the passed panel as the bottom content of the [DVerticalDivider](/gmod/DVerticalDivider).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: pnl
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The panel to set as the bottom content.

SetBottomMin.DESCRIPTION: Sets the minimum height of the bottom content panel.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: height
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The minimum height of the bottom content panel. Default is 50.

SetDividerHeight.DESCRIPTION: Sets the height of the divider bar between the top and bottom content panels of the [DVerticalDivider](/gmod/DVerticalDivider).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: height
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The height of the divider bar.

SetDragging.DESCRIPTION: Sets whether the divider is being dragged or not.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: isDragging
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Setting this to true causes cursor movement to alter the position of the divider.

SetHoldPos.DESCRIPTION: Sets the local Y position of where the user starts dragging the divider.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: y
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The local Y position where divider dragging has started.

SetMiddle.DESCRIPTION: Places the passed panel in between the top and bottom content panels of the [DVerticalDivider](/gmod/DVerticalDivider).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: pnl
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The panel to set as the middle content.

SetTop.DESCRIPTION: Sets the passed panel as the top content of the [DVerticalDivider](/gmod/DVerticalDivider).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: pnl
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The panel to set as the top content.

SetTopHeight.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the height of the top content panel.

The height of the bottom content panel is automatically calculated by taking the total height of the [DVerticalDivider](/gmod/DVerticalDivider) and subtracting it with the height of the top content panel and the divider bar.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: height
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The height of the top content panel.

SetTopMax.DESCRIPTION: Sets the maximum height of the top content panel. This is ignored if the panel would exceed the minimum bottom content panel height set from [DVerticalDivider:SetBottomMin](/gmod/DVerticalDivider:SetBottomMin).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: height
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The maximum height of the top content panel. Default is 4096.

SetTopMin.DESCRIPTION: Sets the minimum height of the top content panel.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: height
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The minimum height of the top content panel. Default is 50.

StartGrab.DESCRIPTION: Causes the user to start dragging the divider.

AddScroll.DESCRIPTION: Adds specified amount of scroll in pixels.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: add
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: How much to scroll downwards. Can be negative for upwards scroll

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: True if the scroll level was changed (i.e. if we did or did not scroll)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: scroll
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The scroll level to animate to. In pixels from the top ( from 0 )

ARGUMENTS.NAME: length
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Length of the animation in seconds

ARGUMENTS.NAME: delay
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Delay of the animation in seconds

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ease
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: See [Panel:NewAnimation](/gmod/Panel:NewAnimation) for explanation.

BarScale.DESCRIPTION: Returns the scale of the scroll bar based on the difference in size between the visible "window" into the canvas that is being scrolled. Should be used after [DVScrollBar:SetUp](/gmod/DVScrollBar:SetUp).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The scale of the scrollbar.

GetHideButtons.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether or not the manual up/down scroll buttons are visible or not. Set by [DVScrollBar:SetHideButtons](/gmod/DVScrollBar:SetHideButtons).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether or not the manual up/down scroll buttons are visible or not.
The scroll offset.

GetScroll.DESCRIPTION: Returns the amount of scroll level from the top in pixels

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The amount of scroll level from the top

SetHideButtons.DESCRIPTION: Allows hiding the up and down buttons for better visual stylisation.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: hide
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: True to hide

SetScroll.DESCRIPTION: Sets the scroll level in pixels.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: scroll
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The new scroll value.

SetUp.DESCRIPTION:
Sets up the scrollbar for use.

The scrollbar will automatically disable itself if the total height of the canvas is lower than the height of the panel that holds the canvas during this function call.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: barSize
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The size of the panel that holds the canvas, basically size of "1 page".

ARGUMENTS.NAME: canvasSize
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The total size of the canvas, this typically is the bigger number.

DVScrollBar.DESCRIPTION:
A generic vertical scrollbar, used in [DScrollPanel](/gmod/DScrollPanel). See the horizontal alternative [here](DHScrollBar).

The scrollbar notably contains `DVScrollBar.btnUp`, `DVScrollBar.btnDown`, and `DVScrollBar.btnGrip` which are the up button, down button, and grip respectively. Editing the paint functions of these allows custom scrollbar styling (See [DScrollPanel:GetVBar](/gmod/DScrollPanel:GetVBar) for an example), although it is a better idea to use [Derma Skins](Derma_Skin_Creation).

ConsoleMessage.DESCRIPTION:
Called when the page inside the [HTML](/gmod/HTML) window runs the `console.log` javascript function.

On the x86-64 beta, it's called for all built-in `console.*` javascript functions.

Overwriting this function in any way will disable default behavior of printing the message to the in-game console.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: msg
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The message to be logged (or Lua code to be executed; see above).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: file
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The message source file, if any.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: lineNr
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The line number in the file the message was output from.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: severity
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION:
The severity of the message. Possible values are:
* "log"
* "warn"
* "error"
* "debug"

OnBeginLoadingDocument.DESCRIPTION: Called when this panel begins loading a page.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: url
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The URL of the current page.

OnCallback.DESCRIPTION: Called by the engine when a callback function is called.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: library
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Library name of the JS function that was called.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: name
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Name of the JS function that was called.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: arguments
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Table containing all arguments passed to the JS function.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Return `true` to suppress default engine action.

OnChangeAddressBar.DESCRIPTION: Called when this panel's address changes.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: url
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The URL of the new page.

OnChangeTargetURL.DESCRIPTION: Called by HTML panels when the target URL of the frame has changed, this happens when you hover over a link.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: url
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: New target URL.

OnChangeTitle.DESCRIPTION: Called by HTML panels when the title of the loaded page has been changed.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: newTitle
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The new title of the page.

OnChildViewCreated.DESCRIPTION: Called by HTML panels when the page attempts to open a new child view (such as a popup or new tab).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: sourceURL
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The URL of the page requesting to create a child.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: targetURL
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The URL of the requested child.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: isPopup
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: True if the requested view is a popup.

OnDocumentReady.DESCRIPTION: Called by HTML panels when the panel's DOM has been set up. You can run JavaScript in here.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: url
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The URL of the current page.

OnFinishLoadingDocument.DESCRIPTION: Called when this panel successfully loads a page.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: url
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The URL of the current page.

HTML.DESCRIPTION:
The HTML control can be used to display web pages just like an internet browser.

[DHTML](/gmod/DHTML) has additional functionality for interfacing with the page, such as sending and receiving data.


## Blocked URL Extentions

This means your url cannot end in any of these extensions, e.g.: (http://yourdomain.com/garry.exe)
* .exe
* .bat
* .dll
* .zip
* .mp3
* .swf
NOTES: For more information on Garry's Mod's web rendering, you can consult the following page: [HTML_Web_Engine](/gmod/HTML_Web_Engine)

AboveLayout.DESCRIPTION:
Applies the top-down view camera settings for the model in the [DAdjustableModelPanel](/gmod/DAdjustableModelPanel).

Called when a user clicks the `Above` (third) button (See [IconEditor](/gmod/IconEditor)).

BestGuessLayout.DESCRIPTION:
Applies the best camera settings for the model in the [DAdjustableModelPanel](/gmod/DAdjustableModelPanel), using the values returned by [PositionSpawnIcon](/gmod/Global.PositionSpawnIcon).

Called when a user clicks the `wand` button (See the ) and when [IconEditor:Refresh](/gmod/IconEditor:Refresh) is called.

FillAnimations.DESCRIPTION: Fills the [DListView](/gmod/DListView) on the left of the editor with the model entity's animation list. Called by [IconEditor:Refresh](/gmod/IconEditor:Refresh).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity being rendered within the model panel.

FullFrontalLayout.DESCRIPTION:
Applies the front view camera settings for the model in the [DAdjustableModelPanel](/gmod/DAdjustableModelPanel).

Called when a user clicks the `Front` (second) button (See the ).

OriginLayout.DESCRIPTION:
Places the camera at the origin (0,0,0), relative to the entity, in the [DAdjustableModelPanel](/gmod/DAdjustableModelPanel).

Called when a user clicks the `Center` (fifth) button (See the ).

Refresh.DESCRIPTION:
Updates the internal [DAdjustableModelPanel](/gmod/DAdjustableModelPanel) and [SpawnIcon](/gmod/SpawnIcon). 

This should be called immediately after setting the SpawnIcon with [IconEditor:SetIcon](/gmod/IconEditor:SetIcon).

RenderIcon.DESCRIPTION:
Re-renders the [SpawnIcon](/gmod/SpawnIcon).

Called when a user clicks the `RENDER` button, this retrieves the render data from the internal [DAdjustableModelPanel](/gmod/DAdjustableModelPanel) and passes it as a table to [Panel:RebuildSpawnIconEx](/gmod/Panel:RebuildSpawnIconEx).

RightLayout.DESCRIPTION:
Applies the right side view camera settings for the model in the [DAdjustableModelPanel](/gmod/DAdjustableModelPanel).

Called when a user clicks the `Right` (fourth) button (See the ). (Note: The icon for this points left.)

SetDefaultLighting.DESCRIPTION: Sets up the default ambient and directional lighting for the [DAdjustableModelPanel](/gmod/DAdjustableModelPanel). Called by [IconEditor:Refresh](/gmod/IconEditor:Refresh).

SetFromEntity.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the editor's model and icon from an entity. Alternative to [IconEditor:SetIcon](/gmod/IconEditor:SetIcon), with uses a [SpawnIcon](/gmod/SpawnIcon).

You do not need to call [IconEditor:Refresh](/gmod/IconEditor:Refresh) after this.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity to retrieve the model and skin from.

SetIcon.DESCRIPTION: Sets the [SpawnIcon](/gmod/SpawnIcon) to modify. You should call [Panel:Refresh](/gmod/Panel:Refresh) immediately after this, as the user will not be able to make changes to the icon beforehand.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: icon
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The [SpawnIcon](/gmod/SpawnIcon) object to be modified.

UpdateEntity.DESCRIPTION: Updates the entity being rendered in the internal [DAdjustableModelPanel](/gmod/DAdjustableModelPanel). Called by the model panel's [DModelPanel:LayoutEntity](/gmod/DModelPanel:LayoutEntity) method.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity being rendered within the model panel.

IconEditor.DESCRIPTION:
An icon editor that permits a user to modify a [SpawnIcon](/gmod/SpawnIcon) and re-render it. This is used by the spawn menu and is what is shown when you right-click an icon and select `Edit Icon`.

This makes use of the [DAdjustableModelPanel](/gmod/DAdjustableModelPanel) element.
NOTES: This panel is only available in Sandbox and Sandbox derived gamemodes!

GetChecked.DESCRIPTION: Returns the checked state of the [ImageCheckBox](/gmod/ImageCheckBox)

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: true for checked, false otherwise

Set.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the checked state of the checkbox.

Checked state can be obtained by [ImageCheckBox](/gmod/ImageCheckBox).State.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: OnOff
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: true for checked, false otherwise

SetChecked.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the checked state of the checkbox.

Checked state can be obtained via [ImageCheckBox:GetChecked](/gmod/ImageCheckBox:GetChecked)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: bOn
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: true for checked, false otherwise

SetMaterial.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the material that will be visible when the [ImageCheckBox](/gmod/ImageCheckBox) is checked.

Internally calls [Material:SetMaterial](/gmod/Material:SetMaterial).
NOTES: Will error if no material was set.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: mat
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The file path of the material to set (relative to "garrysmod/materials/").

ImageCheckBox.DESCRIPTION:
A checkbox panel similar to [DCheckBox](/gmod/DCheckBox) and [DImageButton](/gmod/DImageButton) with customizable checked state image.

Uses the [Material](/gmod/Material) panel internally. Can't have a label.
NOTES: Will error if no material was set.

SetAlpha.DESCRIPTION: Sets the alpha value of the Material panel.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: alpha
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The alpha value, from 0 to 255.

SetMaterial.DESCRIPTION: Sets the material used by the panel.
NOTES: If the material is not showing up as the correct size, try setting the Material panel's `AutoSize` variable to **false**

ARGUMENTS.NAME: matname
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The file path of the material to set (relative to "garrysmod/materials/").

Material.DESCRIPTION: Material is a VGUI element that renders a VMT material.

OnRightClick.DESCRIPTION:
Called when the player right clicks a material.

By default, this opens a menu that lets the player copy the material path.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: pnl
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The [DImageButton](/gmod/DImageButton) that was clicked.

OnSelect.DESCRIPTION: Called when the player selects a material.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: material
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Material path of the selected material, not including any file extension.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: pnl
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The [DImageButton](/gmod/DImageButton) that was clicked.

SelectedItemPaintOver.DESCRIPTION: Defines a paint over function for a [DImageButton](/gmod/DImageButton) when it is selected.
WARNINGS: `self` in the context of this function is the [DImageButton](/gmod/DImageButton)!

ARGUMENTS.NAME: w
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Width of the [DImageButton](/gmod/DImageButton) panel.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: h
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Height of the [DImageButton](/gmod/DImageButton) panel.

AddMaterial.DESCRIPTION: Adds a new material to the selection list.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: label
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Tooltip for the material, for when the player hovers over the material.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: path
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Path to the material. Relative to `materials/` folder (do not include it), and do not include the `.vmt` extension.

AddMaterialEx.DESCRIPTION: Adds a new material to the selection list, with some extra options.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: label
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Tooltip for the material, for when the player hovers over the material.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: path
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Path to the material. Relative to `materials/` folder (do not include it), and do not include the `.vmt` extension.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: value
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Overrides the "value" of the material. This will be what [MatSelect:OnSelect](/gmod/MatSelect:OnSelect) receives in the first argument. It also affects [MatSelect:FindMaterialByValue](/gmod/MatSelect:FindMaterialByValue).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: convars
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: A list of convar names (as keys) and their values to set when the user selects this material. [ContextBase:SetConVar](/gmod/ContextBase:SetConVar) will be ignored.

FindAndSelectMaterial.DESCRIPTION: Find a material and selects it, if it exists in this panel.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: mat
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The material to find and select within this [MatSelect](/gmod/MatSelect).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: mat

GetAutoHeight.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether the panel would set its own height to fit all materials within its height.

RETURNS.NAME: autoSize

SetAutoHeight.DESCRIPTION: Sets whether the panel should set its own height to fit all materials within its height.

SetItemWidth.DESCRIPTION: Sets the width of a single material in pixels.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: width

SetNumRows.DESCRIPTION: Sets the target height of the panel, in number of rows.

MatSelect.DESCRIPTION:
The panel used by Material & Lamp Sandbox tools for texture selection. Despite being only used in Sandbox, it is **not** exclusive to that gamemode.

See also [PropSelect](/gmod/PropSelect) for the prop selecting alternative.

OnRightClick.DESCRIPTION:
Called when the player right clicks a model.

By default, this opens a menu that lets the player copy the model path.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: pnl
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The [Spawnicon](/gmod/Spawnicon) that was clicked.

OnSelect.DESCRIPTION: Called when the player selects a model.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: pnl
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The [Spawnicon](/gmod/Spawnicon) that was clicked.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: model
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Path of the selected model, or its "value".

ARGUMENTS.NAME: icon
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The spawnicon to select, retrieved via [PropSelect:FindModelByValue](/gmod/PropSelect:FindModelByValue).

AddModel.DESCRIPTION: Adds a new model to the selection list.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: model
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Model path, **including** `models/` and `.mdl`.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: convars
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: A list of convar names (as keys) and their values to set when the user selects this model.

AddModelEx.DESCRIPTION: Adds a new model to the selection list.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: value
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The "value" for this model, which is used to set the [ContextBase:SetConVar](/gmod/ContextBase:SetConVar).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: model
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Model path, **including** `models/` and `.mdl`.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: skin
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The skin number for this model. It will **not** be set to the convar, use the value argument to track skin-model combos.

FindAndSelectButton.DESCRIPTION: Find and select a [SpawnIcon](/gmod/SpawnIcon) panel based on the input model path.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: mdl
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The model to find and select within this [PropSelect](/gmod/PropSelect).

FindModelByValue.DESCRIPTION: Find a [SpawnIcon](/gmod/SpawnIcon) panel based on the input model path.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: mdl
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The model to find within this [PropSelect](/gmod/PropSelect).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The found spawnicon, or `nil`.

PropSelect.DESCRIPTION:
Used in Sandbox tools to allow the player to select models out of a list. Despite being only used in Sandbox, it is **not** exclusive to that gamemode.

See also [MatSelect](/gmod/MatSelect) for the material selecting alternative.

GetBodyGroup.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the currently active [Sub Model IDs](/gmod/Structures/BodyGroupData#submodels) for each Body Group of the spawn icon.  
		
		This is set by [SpawnIcon:SetBodyGroup](/gmod/SpawnIcon:SetBodyGroup).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The Body Groups of the spawnicon, in format `"00010100"` where each position indicates a bodygroup ID, and each value indicates the bodygroup value for that ID/position, 0-9a-z

GetModelName.DESCRIPTION: Returns the currently set model name. This is set by [SpawnIcon:SetModelName](/gmod/SpawnIcon:SetModelName).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The model name

GetSkinID.DESCRIPTION: Returns the currently set skin of the spawnicon. This is set by [SpawnIcon:SetSkinID](/gmod/SpawnIcon:SetSkinID).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Current skin ID

OpenMenu.DESCRIPTION: Called when right clicked on the SpawnIcon. It will not be called if there is a selection ([Panel:GetSelectionCanvas](/gmod/Panel:GetSelectionCanvas)), in which case [SANDBOX:SpawnlistOpenGenericMenu](/gmod/SANDBOX:SpawnlistOpenGenericMenu) is called.

SetBodyGroup.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the active [Sub Model ID](/gmod/Structures/BodyGroupData#submodels) for the given [Body Group 		ID](/gmod/Structures/BodyGroupData#id), so it can be retrieved with [SpawnIcon:GetBodyGroup](/gmod/SpawnIcon:GetBodyGroup).  

		Use [Panel:SetModel](/gmod/Panel:SetModel) instead.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: bodyGroupId
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION:
The Body Group ID to set the active Sub Model ID for.  
			Body Group IDs start at `0`.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: activeSubModelId
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION:
The Sub Model ID to set as active.  
			Sub Model IDs start at `0`.

SetModelName.DESCRIPTION: Sets the model name, so it can be retrieved with [SpawnIcon:GetModelName](/gmod/SpawnIcon:GetModelName). Use [Panel:SetModel](/gmod/Panel:SetModel) instead.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: mdl
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The model name to set

SetSkinID.DESCRIPTION: Sets the skin id of the spawn icon, so it can be retrieved with [SpawnIcon:GetSkinID](/gmod/SpawnIcon:GetSkinID). Use [Panel:SetModel](/gmod/Panel:SetModel) instead.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: skin
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Skin ID to set

SpawnIcon.DESCRIPTION:

AchievementIcon.DESCRIPTION:
Used to show an icon for any of the [Garry's Mod Steam achievements](http://steamcommunity.com/stats/GarrysMod/achievements).

		If the viewer has not unlocked the achievement on Steam, the icon will be grayed out.

AvatarImage.DESCRIPTION: Used to show a player's Steam avatar. You are recommended but not limited to pick one of the following sizes: 16, 32, 64, 84, 128, 184.

Awesomium.DESCRIPTION: Base panel for elements using the [Awesomium](http://www.awesomium.com) UI engine.
DEPRECATED: You should be using HTML panel, which this is an alias of.
NOTES: On the `x86-64` beta this panel isn't actually Awesomium, its the same as `HTML` (`HtmlPanel`)

Button.DESCRIPTION:
Creates a button that players can click on.
	[View source](https://github.com/Facepunch/garrysmod/blob/dfdafba0f04e75be122961291a56d9c1714a3d8a/garrysmod/lua/vgui/dbutton.lua#L181-L193)
DEPRECATED: Only exists for backwards compatibility with Panel:SetActionFunction. Use DButton instead.
Use DCheckBoxLabel instead.

ContentSidebarToolbox.DESCRIPTION:
The ContentSidebarToolbox is internally used by the [ContentSidebar](/gmod/ContentSidebar) and is used to change the icon of a category.
It internally consists of a [DTextEntry](/gmod/DTextEntry), [DPanel](/gmod/DPanel), [DImageButton](/gmod/DImageButton), [Panel](/gmod/Panel), [ContentHeader](/gmod/ContentHeader) and a [DIconBrowser](/gmod/DIconBrowser)

CtrlListBox.DESCRIPTION:
A [DComboBox](/gmod/DComboBox) based dropdown menu with build in easy [ConVar](/gmod/ConVar) support.

This control only exists in Sandbox derived gamemodes.

DListLayout.DESCRIPTION:
A vertical list of panels that optionally allows child elements to be rearranged with the mouse cursor.

Child panels' widths are set to the width of the DListLayout, and it resizes vertically to accommodate the heights of all children. You can place this inside a [DScrollPanel](/gmod/DScrollPanel) when adding many panels.

To enable the drag & drop rearrangement functionality, call [DDragBase:MakeDroppable](/gmod/DDragBase:MakeDroppable) on the DListLayout with a unique identifier. All panels added following this will be moveable.

DNumPad.DESCRIPTION: GMod 12 style "number pad" panel used by tools for binding keys to tool actions. Deprecated in favor of [DBinder](/gmod/DBinder).
DEPRECATED: You should use DBinder instead.

DProperty_Entity.DESCRIPTION: Entity picker control for the [DProperties](/gmod/DProperties) panel.

DScrollBarGrip.DESCRIPTION: An internal panel used by [DVScrollBar](/gmod/DVScrollBar) as the grip (middle) part of the scrollbar.

EditablePanel.DESCRIPTION: Base panel used by [DFrame](/gmod/DFrame), this panel is needed so that elements such as the [TextEntry](/gmod/TextEntry) can obtain focus.

fingerposer.DESCRIPTION: A panel used by Sandbox's Finger Poser tool.

FingerVar.DESCRIPTION: A panel used by Sandbox's Finger Poser tool.

Frame.DESCRIPTION: A window that in which you can place just about every other component and even another frame.
DEPRECATED: You should use DFrame instead.

Label.DESCRIPTION: A basic label or "single line text area" that is non-editable. You might be looking for [DLabel](/gmod/DLabel), which uses this panel internally.

ModelImage.DESCRIPTION: Panel used to display models, used by [SpawnIcon](/gmod/SpawnIcon).

PanelList.DESCRIPTION: A panel list with a custom vertical scroll bar that doesn't have up/down buttons and has a momentum to scrolling.
DEPRECATED: You should use DScrollPanel instead

PresetEditor.DESCRIPTION:
A preset editor, which can be opened by [ControlPresets](/gmod/ControlPresets).
		This control only exists in Sandbox derived gamemodes.

RadioButton.DESCRIPTION: Currently there are no functions to retrieve checked state of a Radio Button, and their visuals are seemingly broken.

RichText.DESCRIPTION:
A very versatile text display element that's used to power the default chat and console.

Rich Text panels allows multicolored, highlight-able, and interactive text using individual text segment markup (segments are defined by the [Panel:AppendText](/gmod/Panel:AppendText) method).

The **RichText** element has a `64000` character limit.

You can hide the RichText scrollbar with the following function: [Panel:SetVerticalScrollbarEnabled](/gmod/Panel:SetVerticalScrollbarEnabled)

DEPRECATED: Used in deprecated  PanelList. Use DVScrollBar (Used in DScrollPanel).

Slider.DESCRIPTION: A simple slider featuring an numeric display.
DEPRECATED:
Only exists for backwards compatibility with Panel:SetActionFunction and Panel:PostMessage.
			Use DNumSlider instead.

TGAImage.DESCRIPTION: A panel capable of loading `.tga` images.
DEPRECATED: DImage should be used instead (with `.png` or `.jpg` images). `TGAImage` panel has no advantages.

URLLabel.DESCRIPTION: A panel similar to [Label](/gmod/Label), but can be clicked to open a URL in the Steam Overlay, and appears with an underline. This is used by [DLabelURL](/gmod/DLabelURL).

CONTINUOUS_USE.BASE_DESCRIPTION:
Enumerations used by [Entity:SetUseType](/gmod/Entity:SetUseType). Affects when [ENTITY:Use](/gmod/ENTITY:Use) is triggered.

Not to be confused with [USE](/gmod/Enums/USE) used for [ENTITY:Use](/gmod/ENTITY:Use) and others.
CONTINUOUS_USE.DESCRIPTION: Fire a [USE_ON](/gmod/Enums/USE) signal every tick as long as the player holds their use key and aims at the target.

ONOFF_USE.BASE_DESCRIPTION:
Enumerations used by [Entity:SetUseType](/gmod/Entity:SetUseType). Affects when [ENTITY:Use](/gmod/ENTITY:Use) is triggered.

Not to be confused with [USE](/gmod/Enums/USE) used for [ENTITY:Use](/gmod/ENTITY:Use) and others.
ONOFF_USE.DESCRIPTION: Fires a [USE_ON](/gmod/Enums/USE) signal when starting to use an entity, and a [USE_OFF](/gmod/Enums/USE) signal when letting go.
WARNINGS:
There is no guarantee to receive both ON and OFF signals. A signal will only be sent when pushing or letting go of the use key while actually aiming at the entity, so an ON signal might not be followed by an OFF signal if the player is aiming somewhere else when releasing the key, and similarly, an OFF signal may not be preceded by an ON signal if the player started aiming at the entity only after pressing the key.

Therefore, this method of input is unreliable and should not be used.

DIRECTIONAL_USE.BASE_DESCRIPTION:
Enumerations used by [Entity:SetUseType](/gmod/Entity:SetUseType). Affects when [ENTITY:Use](/gmod/ENTITY:Use) is triggered.

Not to be confused with [USE](/gmod/Enums/USE) used for [ENTITY:Use](/gmod/ENTITY:Use) and others.

SIMPLE_USE.BASE_DESCRIPTION:
Enumerations used by [Entity:SetUseType](/gmod/Entity:SetUseType). Affects when [ENTITY:Use](/gmod/ENTITY:Use) is triggered.

Not to be confused with [USE](/gmod/Enums/USE) used for [ENTITY:Use](/gmod/ENTITY:Use) and others.
SIMPLE_USE.DESCRIPTION: Fire a [USE_ON](/gmod/Enums/USE) signal only once when player presses their use key while aiming at the target.
