GetMovementSequence.DESCRIPTION: Returns the index of the sequence the NPC uses to move.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The movement sequence index

GetMoveVelocity.DESCRIPTION: Returns the current move velocity of the NPC.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The current move velocity of the NPC.
The nav type. See [NAV](/gmod/Enums/NAV).

GetNearestSquadMember.DESCRIPTION: Returns the nearest member of the squad the NPC is in.

RETURNS.NAME: nearest_member
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The nearest member of the squad the NPC is in.

GetNextWaypointPos.DESCRIPTION: Gets the NPC's next waypoint position, where NPC will be moving after reaching current waypoint, if any is available.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The position of the next NPC waypoint.
The NPC's current state, see [NPC_STATE](/gmod/Enums/NPC_STATE).

GetPathDistanceToGoal.DESCRIPTION: Returns the distance the NPC is from Target Goal.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The number of hammer units the NPC is away from the Goal.

GetPathTimeToGoal.DESCRIPTION: Returns the amount of time it will take for the NPC to get to its Target Goal.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The amount of time to get to the target goal.

GetShootPos.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the shooting position of the NPC, i.e. where their bullets would come from, etc. 

If the NPC does not overwrite this, it will return [Entity:GetPos](/gmod/Entity:GetPos).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The NPC's shooting position.

GetSquad.DESCRIPTION: Returns the current squad name of the NPC, as set via [NPC:SetSquad](/gmod/NPC:SetSquad).

RETURNS.NAME: name
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The new squad name to set.

RETURNS.NAME: height
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The current step height.

GetTarget.DESCRIPTION: Returns the NPC's current target set by [NPC:SetTarget](/gmod/NPC:SetTarget).

BUGS.DESCRIPTION: This returns nil if the NPC has no target. You should use [IsValid](/gmod/Global.IsValid) (which accounts for nil and NULL) on the return to verify validity of the target.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Target entity

GetTaskStatus.DESCRIPTION: Returns the status of the current task.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The status. See [TASKSTATUS](/gmod/Enums/TASKSTATUS).

GetTimeEnemyLastReacquired.DESCRIPTION: Returns [CurTime](/gmod/Global.CurTime) based time since the enemy was reacquired, meaning it is currently in Line of Sight of the NPC.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: enemy
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The enemy to test. Defaults to currently active enemy ([NPC:GetEnemy](/gmod/NPC:GetEnemy))

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Time enemy was last reacquired.

GetViewOffset.DESCRIPTION: Returns the view offset of the NPC. Set by [NPC:SetViewOffset](/gmod/NPC:SetViewOffset).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The view offset of the NPC.

GetWeapon.DESCRIPTION: Returns a specific weapon the NPC owns.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: class
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: A classname of the weapon to try to get.

RETURNS.NAME: wep
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The weapon for the specified class, or NULL of the NPC doesn't have given weapon.

GetWeapons.DESCRIPTION: Returns a table of the NPC's weapons.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: A list of the weapons the NPC currently has.

Give.DESCRIPTION: Used to give a weapon to an already spawned NPC.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: weapon
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Class name of the weapon to equip to the NPC.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The weapon entity given to the NPC.

HasCondition.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether or not the NPC has the given condition.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: condition
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The condition index, see [COND](/gmod/Enums/COND).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: True if the NPC has the given condition, false otherwise.

HasEnemyEluded.DESCRIPTION: Polls the enemy memory to check if the given entity has eluded us or not.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: enemy
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The enemy to test.

RETURNS.NAME: eluded
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: If the enemy has eluded us.

HasEnemyMemory.DESCRIPTION: Polls the enemy memory to check if the NPC has any memory of given enemy.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: enemy
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity to test.

RETURNS.NAME: eluded
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: If we have any memory on given enemy.

HasObstacles.DESCRIPTION: Returns true if the current navigation has an obstacle, this is different from [NPC:GetBlockingEntity](/gmod/NPC:GetBlockingEntity), this is for virtual navigation obstacles put by AI's local navigation system to prevent movement to the marked area, forcing NPC to steer around, [for example](https://github.com/ValveSoftware/source-sdk-2013/blob/master/src/game/server/hl2/npc_playercompanion.cpp#L2897).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: `true` if the current navigation has an obstacle.

IdleSound.DESCRIPTION: Force an NPC to play their Idle sound.

IgnoreEnemyUntil.DESCRIPTION: Makes the NPC ignore given entity/enemy until given time.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: enemy
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The enemy to ignore.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: until
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: How long to ignore the enemy for. This will be compared to [CurTime](/gmod/Global.CurTime), so your value should be based on it.

IsCrouching.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether the NPC is currently crouching or not. Citizens and Combine Soldiers are capable of this behavior by default.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the NPC is currently crouching.

IsCurrentSchedule.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether or not the NPC is performing the given schedule.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: schedule
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The schedule number, see [SCHED](/gmod/Enums/SCHED).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: True if the NPC is performing the given schedule, false otherwise.

IsCurWaypointGoal.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether the current navigational waypoint is the final one.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the current navigational waypoint is the final one.

IsFacingIdealYaw.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether the NPC is facing their ideal yaw. See [NPC:SetIdealYaw](/gmod/NPC:SetIdealYaw), [NPC:GetIdealYaw](/gmod/NPC:GetIdealYaw) and [NPC:SetIdealYawAndUpdate](/gmod/NPC:SetIdealYawAndUpdate).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the NPC is facing their ideal yaw.

IsGoalActive.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether the NPC has an active goal.

RETURNS.NAME: act
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the NPC has an active goal or not.

IsInViewCone.DESCRIPTION: Tests whether a position or an NPC is in the view cone of the NPC.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: position
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The position to test.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity to test. Will use the entity's position.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: If the given position is in the view cone.

IsMoveYawLocked.DESCRIPTION: Returns if the current movement is locked on the Yaw axis.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the movement is yaw locked or not.

IsMoving.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether the NPC is moving or not.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the NPC is moving or not.

IsRunningBehavior.DESCRIPTION: Checks if the NPC is running an **ai_goal**. ( e.g. An npc_citizen NPC following the Player. )

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Returns true if running an ai_goal, otherwise returns false.

IsSquadLeader.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether the current NPC is the leader of the squad it is in.

RETURNS.NAME: is_leader
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the NPC is the leader of the squad or not.

IsUnforgettable.DESCRIPTION: Returns the "forgettable" status for a given enemy, as set by [NPC:SetUnforgettable](/gmod/NPC:SetUnforgettable), or by internal logic of engine NPCs.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: enemy
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Enemy entity to check.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the given enemy is unforgettable (`true`) or not.

IsUnreachable.DESCRIPTION:
Returns true if the entity was remembered as unreachable. The memory is updated automatically from following engine tasks if they failed:
* TASK_GET_CHASE_PATH_TO_ENEMY
* TASK_GET_PATH_TO_ENEMY_LKP
* TASK_GET_PATH_TO_INTERACTION_PARTNER
* TASK_ANTLIONGUARD_GET_CHASE_PATH_ENEMY_TOLERANCE
* SCHED_FAIL_ESTABLISH_LINE_OF_FIRE - Combine NPCs, also when failing to change their enemy

ARGUMENTS.NAME: testEntity
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity to test.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: If the entity is reachable or not.

LostEnemySound.DESCRIPTION: Force an NPC to play their LostEnemy sound.

MaintainActivity.DESCRIPTION: Tries to achieve our ideal animation state, playing any transition sequences that we need to play to get there.

MarkEnemyAsEluded.DESCRIPTION: Causes the NPC to temporarily forget the current enemy and switch on to a better one.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: enemy
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The enemy to mark

MarkTookDamageFromEnemy.DESCRIPTION:
Marks the NPC as took damage from given entity.

See also [NPC:GetLastTimeTookDamageFromEnemy](/gmod/NPC:GetLastTimeTookDamageFromEnemy).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: enemy
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The enemy to mark. Defaults to currently active enemy ([NPC:GetEnemy](/gmod/NPC:GetEnemy))

MoveClimbExec.DESCRIPTION:
Executes a climb move.

Related functions are [NPC:MoveClimbStart](/gmod/NPC:MoveClimbStart) and [NPC:MoveClimbStop](/gmod/NPC:MoveClimbStop).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: destination
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The destination of the climb.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: dir
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The direction of the climb.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: distance
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The distance.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: yaw
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The yaw angle.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: left
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Amount of climb nodes left?

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The result. See [AIMR](/gmod/Enums/AIMR).

MoveClimbStart.DESCRIPTION:
Starts a climb move.

Related functions are [NPC:MoveClimbExec](/gmod/NPC:MoveClimbExec) and [NPC:MoveClimbStop](/gmod/NPC:MoveClimbStop).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: destination
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The destination of the climb.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: dir
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The direction of the climb.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: distance
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The distance.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: yaw
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The yaw angle.

MoveClimbStop.DESCRIPTION:
Stops a climb move.

Related functions are [NPC:MoveClimbExec](/gmod/NPC:MoveClimbExec) and [NPC:MoveClimbStart](/gmod/NPC:MoveClimbStart).

MoveGroundStep.DESCRIPTION:
Similar to other `NPC:Move*` functions, invokes internal code to move the NPC to a given location.

Meant to be used within [ENTITY:OverrideMove](/gmod/ENTITY:OverrideMove).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: pos
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The position we want to reach.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: targetEntity
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Used to test whether we hit the move target when deciding success.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: yaw
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Target Yaw angle at the end of the move. -1 to keep original yaw.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: asFarAsCan
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Whether to move as far as possible.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: testZ
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Also test the Z axis of the target position and NPC position to decide success.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION:
Whether the movement succeeded or not.

`AIMotorMoveResult_t` enum:
* AIM_FAILED = 0
* AIM_SUCCESS = 1
* AIM_PARTIAL_HIT_NPC = 2
* AIM_PARTIAL_HIT_WORLD = 3
* AIM_PARTIAL_HIT_TARGET = 4

MoveJumpExec.DESCRIPTION:
Executes a jump move.

Related functions are [NPC:MoveJumpStart](/gmod/NPC:MoveJumpStart) and [NPC:MoveJumpStop](/gmod/NPC:MoveJumpStop).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The result. See [AIMR](/gmod/Enums/AIMR).

MoveJumpStart.DESCRIPTION:
Starts a jump move.

Related functions are [NPC:MoveJumpExec](/gmod/NPC:MoveJumpExec) and [NPC:MoveJumpStop](/gmod/NPC:MoveJumpStop).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: vel
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The jump velocity.

MoveJumpStop.DESCRIPTION:
Stops a jump move.

Related functions are [NPC:MoveJumpExec](/gmod/NPC:MoveJumpExec) and [NPC:MoveJumpStart](/gmod/NPC:MoveJumpStart).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The result. See [AIMR](/gmod/Enums/AIMR).

MoveOrder.DESCRIPTION:
Makes the NPC walk toward the given position. The NPC will return to the player after amount of time set by **player_squad_autosummon_time** [ConVar](/gmod/ConVar).

Only works on Citizens (npc_citizen) and is a part of the Half-Life 2 squad system.

The NPC **must** be in the player's squad for this to work.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: position
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The target position for the NPC to walk to.

MovePause.DESCRIPTION:
Pauses the NPC movement?

Related functions are [NPC:MoveStart](/gmod/NPC:MoveStart), [NPC:MoveStop](/gmod/NPC:MoveStop) and [NPC:ResetMoveCalc](/gmod/NPC:ResetMoveCalc).

MoveStart.DESCRIPTION:
Starts NPC movement?

Related functions are [NPC:MoveStop](/gmod/NPC:MoveStop), [NPC:MovePause](/gmod/NPC:MovePause) and [NPC:ResetMoveCalc](/gmod/NPC:ResetMoveCalc).

MoveStop.DESCRIPTION:
Stops the NPC movement?

Related functions are [NPC:MoveStart](/gmod/NPC:MoveStart), [NPC:MovePause](/gmod/NPC:MovePause) and [NPC:ResetMoveCalc](/gmod/NPC:ResetMoveCalc).

NavSetGoal.DESCRIPTION: Picks random node around given vector, around specified length, using dir as search direction start. Works similarly to [NPC:NavSetRandomGoal](/gmod/NPC:NavSetRandomGoal), but you can decide any position you want as a search starting point rather than your NPC.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: pos
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The origin to calculate a path from.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: length
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The target length of the path to calculate.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: dir
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The direction in which to look for a new path end goal.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether path generation was successful or not.

NavSetGoalPos.DESCRIPTION:
Creates a path to closest node at given position. This won't actually force the NPC to move.



See also [NPC:NavSetRandomGoal](/gmod/NPC:NavSetRandomGoal).
NOTES: This will call either [NPC:TaskComplete](/gmod/NPC:TaskComplete) or [NPC:TaskFail](/gmod/NPC:TaskFail) for the current schedule and task, forcing the current task to progress to next task or fail.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: pos
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The position to calculate a path to.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether path generation was successful or not.

NavSetGoalTarget.DESCRIPTION:
Set the goal target for an NPC.

This will call either [NPC:TaskComplete](/gmod/NPC:TaskComplete) or [NPC:TaskFail](/gmod/NPC:TaskFail) for the current schedule and task, forcing the current task to progress to next task or fail.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: target
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The targeted entity to set the goal to.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: offset
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The offset to apply to the targeted entity's position.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether path generation was successful or not

NavSetRandomGoal.DESCRIPTION: Creates a random path of specified minimum length between a closest start node and random node in the specified direction. This won't actually force the NPC to move.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: minPathLength
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Minimum length of path in units

ARGUMENTS.NAME: dir
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Unit vector pointing in the direction of the target random node

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether path generation was successful or not

NavSetWanderGoal.DESCRIPTION: Sets a goal in x, y offsets for the NPC to wander to

ARGUMENTS.NAME: xOffset
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: X offset

ARGUMENTS.NAME: yOffset
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Y offset

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether path generation was successful or not

PickupWeapon.DESCRIPTION: Forces the NPC to pickup an existing weapon entity. The NPC will not pick up the weapon if they already own a weapon of given type, or if the NPC could not normally have this weapon in their inventory.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: wep
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The weapon to try to pick up.

RETURNS.NAME: result
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the NPC succeeded in picking up the weapon or not.

PlaySentence.DESCRIPTION: Forces the NPC to play a sentence from scripts/sentences.txt

ARGUMENTS.NAME: sentence
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The sentence string to speak.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: delay
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Delay in seconds until the sentence starts playing.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: volume
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The volume of the sentence, from 0 to 1.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Returns the sentence index, -1 if the sentence couldn't be played.

RememberUnreachable.DESCRIPTION: Makes the NPC remember an entity or an enemy as unreachable, for a specified amount of time. Use [NPC:IsUnreachable](/gmod/NPC:IsUnreachable) to check if an entity is still unreachable.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity to mark as unreachable.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: time
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: For how long to remember the entity as unreachable. Negative values will act as `3` seconds.

RemoveIgnoreConditions.DESCRIPTION: Removes conditions to ignore for the this NPC.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: conditions
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Ignore conditions to remove, see [COND](/gmod/Enums/COND). If omitted, removes all ignore conditions.

ResetIdealActivity.DESCRIPTION: Resets the ideal activity of the NPC. See also [NPC:SetIdealActivity](/gmod/NPC:SetIdealActivity).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: act
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The new activity. See [ACT](/gmod/Enums/ACT).

ResetMoveCalc.DESCRIPTION:
Resets all the movement calculations.

Related functions are [NPC:MoveStart](/gmod/NPC:MoveStart), [NPC:MovePause](/gmod/NPC:MovePause) and [NPC:MoveStop](/gmod/NPC:MoveStop).

RunEngineTask.DESCRIPTION:
Starts an engine task.

Used internally by the [ai_task](/gmod/ai_task).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: taskID
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The task ID, see [ai_task.h](https://github.com/ValveSoftware/source-sdk-2013/blob/55ed12f8d1eb6887d348be03aee5573d44177ffb/mp/src/game/server/ai_task.h#L89-L502)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: taskData
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The task data.

SelectWeapon.DESCRIPTION: Forces the NPC to switch to a specific weapon the NPC owns. See [NPC:GetWeapons](/gmod/NPC:GetWeapons).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: weapon
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: A classname of the weapon or a [Weapon](/gmod/Weapon) entity to switch to.

SentenceStop.DESCRIPTION:
Stops any sounds (speech) the NPC is currently playing.

Equivalent to `Entity:EmitSound( "AI_BaseNPC.SentenceStop" )`

ARGUMENTS.NAME: act
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The new activity to set, see [ACT](/gmod/Enums/ACT).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: act
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: See [ACT](/gmod/Enums/ACT).

SetArrivalDirection.DESCRIPTION: Sets the direction from the NPC origin to its current navigational destination.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: dir
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The new arrival direction.

SetArrivalDistance.DESCRIPTION: Sets the distance to goal at which the NPC should stop moving and continue to other business such as doing the rest of their tasks in a schedule.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: dist
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The distance to goal that is close enough for the NPC

SetArrivalSequence.DESCRIPTION: Sets the sequence to be played when the NPC arrives at its goal.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: seq
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: See [Entity:LookupSequence](/gmod/Entity:LookupSequence).

SetArrivalSpeed.DESCRIPTION: Sets the arrival speed? of the NPC

ARGUMENTS.NAME: speed
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The new arrival speed

ARGUMENTS.NAME: condition
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The condition index, see [COND](/gmod/Enums/COND).

SetCurrentWeaponProficiency.DESCRIPTION: Sets the weapon proficiency of an NPC (how skilled an NPC is with its current weapon).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: proficiency
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The proficiency for the NPC's current weapon. See [WEAPON_PROFICIENCY](/gmod/Enums/WEAPON_PROFICIENCY).

SetEnemy.DESCRIPTION: Sets the target for an NPC.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: enemy
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The enemy that the NPC should target

ARGUMENTS.NAME: newenemy
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Calls [NPC:SetCondition](/gmod/NPC:SetCondition)(COND.NEW_ENEMY) if the new enemy is valid and not equal to the last enemy.

SetExpression.DESCRIPTION: Sets the NPC's .vcd expression. Similar to [Entity:PlayScene](/gmod/Entity:PlayScene) except the scene is looped until it's interrupted by default NPC behavior or [NPC:ClearExpression](/gmod/NPC:ClearExpression).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: m_iszExpressionScene
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The expression filepath.

RETURNS.NAME: flDuration
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Default duration of assigned expression, in seconds.

SetForceCrouch.DESCRIPTION: Forces given NPC to crouch, if it is able to do so. Only Citizens and Combine Soldiers can by default.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: force
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Whether to force the NPC to crouch or not. `false` clears the "force crouch" flag, but does not guarantee to force the NPC to stand back up.

SetFOV.DESCRIPTION: Sets the Field Of View of the NPC, for use with such functions as [NPC:IsInViewCone](/gmod/NPC:IsInViewCone). it is also used internally by the NPC for enemy detection, etc.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: fov
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The new FOV for the NPC in degrees.

SetHullSizeNormal.DESCRIPTION: Updates the NPC's hull and physics hull in order to match its model scale. [Entity:SetModelScale](/gmod/Entity:SetModelScale) seems to take care of this regardless.

SetHullType.DESCRIPTION: Sets the hull type for the NPC.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: hullType
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Hull type. See [HULL](/gmod/Enums/HULL)

SetIdealActivity.DESCRIPTION: Sets the ideal activity the NPC currently wants to achieve. This is most useful for custom SNPCs.

ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The ideal activity to set. [ACT](/gmod/Enums/ACT).

SetIdealSequence.DESCRIPTION: Sets the ideal sequence the NPC currently wants to achieve. This is most useful for custom SNPCs.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: sequenceId
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The ideal sequence to set. [Entity:LookupSequence](/gmod/Entity:LookupSequence).

SetIdealYaw.DESCRIPTION: Sets the ideal yaw angle (left-right rotation) for the NPC. Does not actually force the NPC to start turning in that direction. See [NPC:UpdateYaw](/gmod/NPC:UpdateYaw), [NPC:GetIdealYaw](/gmod/NPC:GetIdealYaw) and [NPC:SetIdealYawAndUpdate](/gmod/NPC:SetIdealYawAndUpdate).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: angle
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The aim direction to set, the `yaw` component.

SetIdealYawAndUpdate.DESCRIPTION: Sets the ideal yaw angle (left-right rotation) for the NPC and forces them to turn to that angle.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: angle
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The aim direction to set, the `yaw` component.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: speed
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION:
The turn speed. Special values are:
* `-1` - Calculate automatically
* `-2` - Keep the previous yaw speed

SetIgnoreConditions.DESCRIPTION: Sets conditions to ignore, which would normally interrupt an Engine-based schedule. Specified conditions will still be set, will call [ENTITY:OnCondition](/gmod/ENTITY:OnCondition) and can be returned by [NPC:HasCondition](/gmod/NPC:HasCondition), but they will no longer interrupt the Engine schedule.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: conditions
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Conditions to ignore, see [COND](/gmod/Enums/COND). The table must be sequential, numerical and values must correspond to condition enums.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: size
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Number of conditions to include in the ignored conditions table. Set this to the size of ignored conditions table to ignore all specified conditions.

SetLastPosition.DESCRIPTION: Sets the last registered or memorized position for this NPC. When using scheduling, the NPC will focus on navigating to the last position via nodes.
NOTES: The navigation requires ground nodes to function properly, otherwise the NPC could only navigate in a small area. (https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Info_node)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: position
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Where the NPC's last position will be set.

SetMaxLookDistance.DESCRIPTION: Sets NPC's max view distance. An NPC will not be able to see enemies outside of this distance.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: dist
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: New maximum distance the NPC can see at. Default is 2048 and 6000 for long range NPCs such as the sniper.

SetMaxRouteRebuildTime.DESCRIPTION: Sets how long to try rebuilding path before failing task.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: time
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: How long to try rebuilding path before failing task

SetMoveDelay.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the movement delay for given NPC.

See [NPC:GetMoveDelay](/gmod/NPC:GetMoveDelay).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: delay
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The amount of time in seconds to delay movement by.

SetMoveInterval.DESCRIPTION: Sets the timestep the internal NPC motor is working on.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: time
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The new timestep.

SetMovementActivity.DESCRIPTION: Sets the activity the NPC uses when it moves.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: activity
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The movement activity, see [ACT](/gmod/Enums/ACT).

SetMovementSequence.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the sequence the NPC navigation path uses for speed calculation. Doesn't seem to have any visible effect on NPC movement or actively playing sequence.
	
To be able to use this, first set [NPC:SetIdealActivity](/gmod/NPC:SetIdealActivity) to `ACT_DO_NOT_DISTURB`, set this to any sequence with root motion data and call [Entity:SetSequence](/gmod/Entity:SetSequence) on your desired sequence. As long as your NPC's [NPC:GetMovementSequence](/gmod/NPC:GetMovementSequence) has root motion data, your NPC will move to navigation point even though your NPC's [Entity:GetSequence](/gmod/Entity:GetSequence) doesn't have any motion.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: sequenceId
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The movement sequence index

SetMoveVelocity.DESCRIPTION: Sets the move velocity of the NPC

ARGUMENTS.NAME: vel
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The new movement velocity.

SetMoveYawLocked.DESCRIPTION: Sets whether the current movement should locked on the Yaw axis or not.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: lock
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the movement should yaw locked or not.

SetNavType.DESCRIPTION: Sets the navigation type of the NPC.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: navtype
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The new nav type. See [NAV](/gmod/Enums/NAV).

SetNPCState.DESCRIPTION: Sets the state the NPC is in to help it decide on a ideal schedule.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: state
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: New NPC state, see [NPC_STATE](/gmod/Enums/NPC_STATE)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: schedule
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The NPC schedule, see [SCHED](/gmod/Enums/SCHED).

SetSquad.DESCRIPTION:
Assigns the NPC to a new squad. A squad can have up to 16 NPCs. NPCs in a single squad should be friendly to each other.

See also [ai.GetSquadMembers](/gmod/ai.GetSquadMembers) and [NPC:GetSquad](/gmod/NPC:GetSquad).

NPCs within the same squad are meant to function more effectively, tactics wise.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: name
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The new squad name to set. Do not provide this argument to reset the squad.

NOTES: This only works for [scripted NPCs](/gmod/Scripted_Entities).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: height
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The new step height. Default is 18 Hammer Units.

SetTarget.DESCRIPTION: Sets the NPC's target. This is used in some engine schedules.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: entity
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The target of the NPC.

SetTaskStatus.DESCRIPTION: Sets the status of the current task.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: status
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The status. See [TASKSTATUS](/gmod/Enums/TASKSTATUS).

SetUnforgettable.DESCRIPTION: Sets given entity as an unforgettable enemy. The state can be retrieved via [NPC:IsUnforgettable](/gmod/NPC:IsUnforgettable).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: enemy
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The enemy entity to set.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: set
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The entity to set.

SetViewOffset.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the view offset of the NPC. Player alternative of [Player:SetViewOffset](/gmod/Player:SetViewOffset).

This affects NPC's [NPC:GetShootPos](/gmod/NPC:GetShootPos).

ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The view offset to set.

StartEngineTask.DESCRIPTION: Forces the NPC to start an engine task, this has different results for every NPC.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: task
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The id of the task to start, see [ai_task.h](https://github.com/ValveSoftware/source-sdk-2013/blob/55ed12f8d1eb6887d348be03aee5573d44177ffb/mp/src/game/server/ai_task.h#L89-L502)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: taskData
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The task data as a float, not all tasks make use of it.

StopMoving.DESCRIPTION: Resets the NPC's movement animation and velocity. Does not actually stop the NPC from moving.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: immediate
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Whether to stop moving even when currently active goal doesn't want us to.

TargetOrder.DESCRIPTION:
Cancels [NPC:MoveOrder](/gmod/NPC:MoveOrder) basically.

Only works on Citizens (npc_citizen) and is a part of the Half-Life 2 squad system.

The NPC **must** be in the player's squad for this to work.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: target
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Must be a player, does nothing otherwise.

TaskComplete.DESCRIPTION:
Marks the current NPC task as completed.

This is meant to be used alongside [NPC:TaskFail](/gmod/NPC:TaskFail) to complete or fail custom Lua defined tasks. ([Schedule:AddTask](/gmod/Schedule:AddTask))

TaskFail.DESCRIPTION:
Marks the current NPC task as failed.

This is meant to be used alongside [NPC:TaskComplete](/gmod/NPC:TaskComplete) to complete or fail custom Lua defined tasks. ([Schedule:AddTask](/gmod/Schedule:AddTask))

ARGUMENTS.NAME: failReason
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Fail reason to be passed onto [ENTITY:OnTaskFailed](/gmod/ENTITY:OnTaskFailed). The fail reason can also be seen when the NPC's `ent_text` is active.

UpdateEnemyMemory.DESCRIPTION: Force the NPC to update information on the supplied enemy, as if it had line of sight to it.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: enemy
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The enemy to update.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: pos
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The last known position of the enemy.

UpdateTurnActivity.DESCRIPTION: Updates the turn activity. Basically applies the turn animations depending on the current turn yaw.

UpdateYaw.DESCRIPTION: Forces the NPC to turn to their ideal yaw angle. See [NPC:SetIdealYaw](/gmod/NPC:SetIdealYaw) and [NPC:SetIdealYawAndUpdate](/gmod/NPC:SetIdealYawAndUpdate).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: speed
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION:
The turn speed. Special values are:
* `-1` - Calculate automatically
* `-2` - Keep the previous yaw speed

NOTES: This function only works on `ai` type [SENTs](Scripted_Entities).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: If we succeeded setting the behavior.

UseAssaultBehavior.DESCRIPTION: Enables the AI's [Assault Behavior](https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Assault "Assault Behavior") when an `ai_goal_assault` is set for this SENT.
NOTES: This function only works on `ai` type [SENTs](Scripted_Entities).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the action succeeded.

NOTES: This function only works on `ai` type [SENTs](Scripted_Entities).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: If we succeeded setting the behavior.

UseFuncTankBehavior.DESCRIPTION: Orders the SNPC to control any nearby `func_tank`s looking for an NPC to operate itself, if available.
NOTES: This function only works on `ai` type [SENTs](Scripted_Entities).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the action succeeded.

UseLeadBehavior.DESCRIPTION: Enables the AI's [Lead Behavior](https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/ai_goal_lead "Lead Behavior") when an `ai_goal_lead` is set for this SENT.
NOTES: This function only works on `ai` type [SENTs](Scripted_Entities).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the action succeeded.

NOTES: This function only works on `ai` type [SENTs](Scripted_Entities).

NPC.DESCRIPTION: This is a list of all methods only available for NPCs. It is also possible to call [Entity](/gmod/Entity) functions on NPCs.

Add.DESCRIPTION: When provided with a string or table, this function will create a new vgui element with that name and set the parent to the panel that this method is called on. When provided with a panel it will use [Panel:SetParent](/gmod/Panel:SetParent) on the provided panel to set it to our source panel

ARGUMENTS.NAME: object
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The panel to be added (parented).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: class
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The class to be added.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: table
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The table to create the panel from.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: New panel

DEPRECATED: Does nothing

AlignBottom.DESCRIPTION: Aligns the panel on the bottom of its parent with the specified offset.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: offset
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The align offset.

AlignLeft.DESCRIPTION: Aligns the panel on the left of its parent with the specified offset.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: offset
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The align offset.

AlignRight.DESCRIPTION: Aligns the panel on the right of its parent with the specified offset.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: offset
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The align offset.

AlignTop.DESCRIPTION: Aligns the panel on the top of its parent with the specified offset.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: offset
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The align offset.

AlphaTo.DESCRIPTION: Uses animation to transition the current alpha value of a panel to a new alpha, over a set period of time and after a specified delay.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: alpha
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The alpha value (0-255) to approach.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: duration
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The time in seconds it should take to reach the alpha.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: delay
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The delay before the animation starts.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: callback
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The function to be called once the animation finishes.

AnimationThinkInternal.DESCRIPTION:
Performs the per-frame operations required for panel animations.

This is called every frame by [PANEL:AnimationThink](/gmod/PANEL:AnimationThink).

AnimTail.DESCRIPTION: Returns the [SysTime](/gmod/Global.SysTime) value when all animations for this panel object will end.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The system time value when all animations will end for this panel.

AppendText.DESCRIPTION: Appends text to a [RichText](/gmod/RichText) element. This does not automatically add a new line.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: txt
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The text to append (add on).

AppendTextWithURLs.DESCRIPTION: Appends text to a [RichText](/gmod/RichText) element (exactly like [Panel:AppendText](/gmod/Panel:AppendText)), while also parsing and adding valid URLs ([Panel:InsertClickableTextStart](/gmod/Panel:InsertClickableTextStart)). This does not automatically add a new line.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: txt
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The text to append (add on).

ApplyGWEN.DESCRIPTION:
Used by [Panel:LoadGWENFile](/gmod/Panel:LoadGWENFile) and [Panel:LoadGWENString](/gmod/Panel:LoadGWENString) to apply a GWEN controls table to a panel object.

You can do this manually using [file.Read](/gmod/file.Read) and [util.JSONToTable](/gmod/util.JSONToTable) to import and create a GWEN table structure from a `.gwen` file. This method can then be called, passing the GWEN table's `Controls` member.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: GWENTable
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The GWEN controls table to apply to the panel.

Center.DESCRIPTION:
Centers the panel on its parent. 

See [Panel:CenterHorizontal](/gmod/Panel:CenterHorizontal) and [Panel:CenterVertical](/gmod/Panel:CenterVertical) for more specialized functions.
NOTES:
This will center the panel using the current size of the panel, so it should be called **AFTER** setting or adjusting the size of the panel.

Take special care when using [Panel:Dock](/gmod/Panel:Dock) as it will not update the size immediately.

You may want to use [Panel:PerformLayout](/gmod/Panel:PerformLayout) to set positions of child panels.

CenterHorizontal.DESCRIPTION:
Centers the panel horizontally with specified fraction.

See [Panel:CenterVertical](/gmod/Panel:CenterVertical) for vertical only centering, and  [Panel:Center](/gmod/Panel:Center) for a function that does both axes.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: fraction
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The center fraction.

CenterVertical.DESCRIPTION:
Centers the panel vertically with specified fraction.

See [Panel:CenterHorizontal](/gmod/Panel:CenterHorizontal) for horizontal only centering, and  [Panel:Center](/gmod/Panel:Center) for a function that does both axes.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: fraction
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The center fraction.

ChildCount.DESCRIPTION: Returns the amount of children of the of panel.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The amount of children the panel has.

ChildrenSize.DESCRIPTION: Returns the width and height of the space between the position of the panel (upper-left corner) and the max bound of the children panels (farthest reaching lower-right corner).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The children size width.
The children size height.

Clear.DESCRIPTION: Removes all of the panel's children. Many panels also override this method to gracefully clear their contents without breaking themselves.

ColorTo.DESCRIPTION: Fades panels color to specified one.
NOTES: The panel must have `GetColor` and `SetColor` functions for `ColorTo` to work.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: color
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The color to fade to

ARGUMENTS.NAME: length
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Length of the animation

ARGUMENTS.NAME: delay
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Delay before start fading

ARGUMENTS.NAME: callback
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Function to execute when finished

ConVarChanged.DESCRIPTION: Updates a panel object's associated console variable. This must first be set up with [Derma_Install_Convar_Functions](/gmod/Global.Derma_Install_Convar_Functions), and have a ConVar set using [Panel:SetConVar](/gmod/Panel:SetConVar).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: newValue
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The new value to set the associated console variable to.

ConVarNumberThink.DESCRIPTION:
A think hook for [Panel](/gmod/Panel)s using ConVars as a value. Call it in the Think hook. Sets the panel's value should the convar change.

This function is best for: checkboxes, sliders, number wangs

For a string alternative, see [Panel:ConVarStringThink](/gmod/Panel:ConVarStringThink).
NOTES: Make sure your Panel has a SetValue function, else you may get errors.

ConVarStringThink.DESCRIPTION:
A think hook for [panels](/gmod/Panel) using ConVars as a value. Call it in the Think hook. Sets the panel's value should the convar change.

This function is best for: text inputs, read-only inputs, dropdown selects

For a number alternative, see [Panel:ConVarNumberThink](/gmod/Panel:ConVarNumberThink).
NOTES: Make sure your Panel has a SetValue function, else you may get errors.

CopyBase.DESCRIPTION: Gets the size, position and dock state of the passed panel object, and applies it to this one.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: srcPanel
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The panel to copy the boundary and dock settings from.

CopyBounds.DESCRIPTION: Copies position and size of the panel.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: base
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The panel to copy size and position from.

CopyHeight.DESCRIPTION: Copies the height of the panel.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: base
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Panel to copy the height from.

CopyPos.DESCRIPTION: Copies the position of the panel.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: base
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Panel to position the width from.

CopySelected.DESCRIPTION: Performs the  +  key combination effect ( Copy selection to clipboard ) on selected text in a [TextEntry](/gmod/TextEntry) or [RichText](/gmod/RichText) based element.

CopyWidth.DESCRIPTION: Copies the width of the panel.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: base
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Panel to copy the width from.

CursorPos.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the cursor position relative to the top left of the panel.

This is equivalent to calling [gui.MousePos](/gmod/gui.MousePos) and then [Panel:ScreenToLocal](/gmod/Panel:ScreenToLocal).
WARNINGS:
This function uses a cached value for the screen position of the panel, computed at the end of the last VGUI Think/Layout pass.

ie. inaccurate results may be returned if the panel or any of its ancestors have been repositioned outside of [PANEL:Think](/gmod/PANEL:Think) or [PANEL:PerformLayout](/gmod/PANEL:PerformLayout) within the last frame.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: X coordinate of the cursor, relative to the top left of the panel.
Y coordinate of the cursor, relative to the top left of the panel.

CutSelected.DESCRIPTION: Performs the  +  (delete text and copy it to clipboard buffer) action on selected text in a [TextEntry](/gmod/TextEntry) or [RichText](/gmod/RichText) based element.

DeleteCookie.DESCRIPTION: Deletes a cookie value using the panel's cookie name ( [Panel:GetCookieName](/gmod/Panel:GetCookieName) ) and the passed extension.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: cookieName
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The unique cookie name to delete.

DisableLerp.DESCRIPTION:
Resets the panel object's [Panel:SetPos](/gmod/Panel:SetPos) method and removes its animation table (`Panel.LerpAnim`). This effectively undoes the changes made by [Panel:LerpPositions](/gmod/Panel:LerpPositions).

In order to use Lerp animation again, you must call [Panel:Stop](/gmod/Panel:Stop) before setting its `SetPosReal` property to `nil`. See the example below.

Distance.DESCRIPTION: Returns the linear distance from the center of this panel object and another. **Both panels must have the same parent for this function to work properly.**

ARGUMENTS.NAME: tgtPanel
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The target object with which to compare position.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The linear (straight-line) distance between the center of the two objects.

DistanceFrom.DESCRIPTION: Returns the distance between the center of this panel object and a specified point **local to the parent panel**.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: posX
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The horizontal (x) position in pixels of the point to compare with. Local to the parent panel, or container, not the panel the function is called on.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: posY
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The vertical (y) position in pixels of the point to compare with. Local to the parent panel, or container, not the panel the function is called on.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The linear (straight-line) distance between the specified point local to parent panel and the center of this panel object.

Dock.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the dock type for the panel, making the panel "dock" in a certain direction, modifying it's position and size.

You can set the inner spacing of a panel's docking using [Panel:DockPadding](/gmod/Panel:DockPadding), which will affect docked child panels, and you can set the outer spacing of a panel's docking using [Panel:DockMargin](/gmod/Panel:DockMargin), which affects how docked siblings are positioned/sized.

You may need to use [Panel:SetZPos](/gmod/Panel:SetZPos) to ensure child panels ([DTextEntry](/gmod/DTextEntry)) stay in a specific order.
NOTES: After using this function, if you want to get the correct panel's bounds (position, size), use [Panel:InvalidateParent](/gmod/Panel:InvalidateParent) (use `true` as argument if you need to update immediately)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: dockType
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Dock type using [DOCK](/gmod/Enums/DOCK).

DockMargin.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the dock margin of the panel.

The dock margin is the extra space that will be left around the edge when this element is docked inside its parent element.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: marginLeft
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The left margin to the parent.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: marginTop
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The top margin to the parent.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: marginRight
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The right margin to the parent.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: marginBottom
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The bottom margin to the parent.

DockPadding.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the dock padding of the panel.

The dock padding is the extra space that will be left around the edge when child elements are docked inside this element.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: paddingLeft
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The left padding to the parent.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: paddingTop
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The top padding to the parent.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: paddingRight
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The right padding to the parent.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: paddingBottom
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The bottom padding to the parent.

DoModal.DESCRIPTION:
Makes the panel "lock" the screen until it is removed. All input will be directed to the given panel.

It will silently fail if used while cursor is not visible.
Call [Panel:MakePopup](/gmod/Panel:MakePopup) before calling this function.
This must be called on a panel derived from [EditablePanel](/gmod/EditablePanel).

DragClick.DESCRIPTION: Called by [Panel:DragMouseRelease](/gmod/Panel:DragMouseRelease) when a user clicks one mouse button whilst dragging with another.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Always returns `true`.

DragHover.DESCRIPTION: Called by [dragndrop.HoverThink](/gmod/dragndrop.HoverThink) to perform actions on an object that is dragged and hovered over another.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: HoverTime
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: If this time is greater than 0.1, [PANEL:DragHoverClick](/gmod/PANEL:DragHoverClick) is called, passing it as an argument.

DragHoverEnd.DESCRIPTION: Called to end a drag and hover action. This resets the panel's [PANEL:PaintOver](/gmod/PANEL:PaintOver) method, and is primarily used by [dragndrop.StopDragging](/gmod/dragndrop.StopDragging).

DragMousePress.DESCRIPTION: Called to inform the [dragndrop](/gmod/dragndrop) that a mouse button is being held down on a panel object.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: mouseCode
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The code for the mouse button pressed, passed by, for example, [PANEL:OnMousePressed](/gmod/PANEL:OnMousePressed). See the [MOUSE](/gmod/Enums/MOUSE).

DragMouseRelease.DESCRIPTION: Called to inform the [dragndrop](/gmod/dragndrop) that a mouse button has been depressed on a panel object.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: mouseCode
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The code for the mouse button pressed, passed by, for example, [PANEL:OnMouseReleased](/gmod/PANEL:OnMouseReleased). See the [MOUSE](/gmod/Enums/MOUSE).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: `true` if an object was being dragged, otherwise `false`.

DrawDragHover.DESCRIPTION: Called to draw the drop target when an object is being dragged across another. See [Panel:SetDropTarget](/gmod/Panel:SetDropTarget).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: x
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The x coordinate of the top-left corner of the drop area.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: y
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The y coordinate of the top-left corner of the drop area.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: width
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The width of the drop area.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: height
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The height of the drop area.

DrawFilledRect.DESCRIPTION: Draws a coloured rectangle to fill the panel object this method is called on. The colour is set using [surface.SetDrawColor](/gmod/surface.SetDrawColor). This should only be called within the object's [PANEL:Paint](/gmod/PANEL:Paint) or [PANEL:PaintOver](/gmod/PANEL:PaintOver) hooks, as a shortcut for [surface.DrawRect](/gmod/surface.DrawRect).

DrawOutlinedRect.DESCRIPTION: Draws a hollow rectangle the size of the panel object this method is called on, with a border width of 1 px. The border colour is set using [surface.SetDrawColor](/gmod/surface.SetDrawColor). This should only be called within the object's [PANEL:Paint](/gmod/PANEL:Paint) or [PANEL:PaintOver](/gmod/PANEL:PaintOver) hooks, as a shortcut for [surface.DrawOutlinedRect](/gmod/surface.DrawOutlinedRect).

DrawSelections.DESCRIPTION: Used to draw the magenta highlight colour of a panel object when it is selected. This should be called in the object's [PANEL:PaintOver](/gmod/PANEL:PaintOver) hook. Once this is implemented, the highlight colour will be displayed only when the object is selectable and selected. This is achieved using [Panel:SetSelectable](/gmod/Panel:SetSelectable) and [Panel:SetSelected](/gmod/Panel:SetSelected) respectively.

DrawTextEntryText.DESCRIPTION: Used to draw the text in a [DTextEntry](/gmod/DTextEntry) within a derma skin. This is usually called within the [SKIN:PaintTextEntry](/gmod/SKIN:PaintTextEntry) skin hook.
NOTES: Will silently fail if any of arguments are not given.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: textCol
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The colour of the main text.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: highlightCol
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The colour of the selection highlight (when selecting text).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: cursorCol
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The colour of the text cursor (or caret).

DrawTexturedRect.DESCRIPTION: Draws a textured rectangle to fill the panel object this method is called on. The texture is set using [surface.SetTexture](/gmod/surface.SetTexture) or [surface.SetMaterial](/gmod/surface.SetMaterial). This should only be called within the object's [PANEL:Paint](/gmod/PANEL:Paint) or [PANEL:PaintOver](/gmod/PANEL:PaintOver) hooks, as a shortcut for [surface.DrawTexturedRect](/gmod/surface.DrawTexturedRect).

Droppable.DESCRIPTION:
Makes this panel droppable. This is used with [Panel:Receiver](/gmod/Panel:Receiver) to create drag and drop events.

Can be called multiple times with different names allowing to be dropped onto different receivers.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: name
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Name of your droppable panel

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Blank table stored on the panel itself under pnl.m_DragSlot[ name ]. Is reset every time this function is called and does not appear to be used or exposed anywhere else.

EndBoxSelection.DESCRIPTION: Completes a box selection. If the end point of the selection box is within the selection canvas, mouse capture is disabled for the panel object, and the selected state of each child object within the selection box is toggled.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the end point of the selection box was within the selection canvas.

Exec.DESCRIPTION: Used to run commands within a [DHTML](/gmod/DHTML) window.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: cmd
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The command to be run.

Find.DESCRIPTION: Finds a panel in its children(and sub children) with the given name.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: panelName
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The name of the panel that should be found.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: foundPanel

FocusNext.DESCRIPTION: Focuses the next panel in the focus queue.

FocusPrevious.DESCRIPTION: Focuses the previous panel in the focus queue.

GetAlpha.DESCRIPTION: Returns the alpha multiplier for this panel.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: alphaMul

GetBGColor.DESCRIPTION: Returns the background color of a panel such as a [RichText](/gmod/RichText), [Label](/gmod/Label) or [DColorCube](/gmod/DColorCube).
NOTES: This doesn't apply to all VGUI elements and its function varies between them

RETURNS.NAME: color
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The [Color](/gmod/Color).

GetBounds.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the position and size of the panel.

This is equivalent to calling [Panel:GetPos](/gmod/Panel:GetPos) and [Panel:GetSize](/gmod/Panel:GetSize) together.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The x coordinate of the panel, relative to its parent's top left.
The y coordinate of the panel, relative to its parent's top left.
The width of the panel.
The height of the panel.

GetCaretPos.DESCRIPTION: Returns the position/offset of the caret (or text cursor) in a text-based panel object.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The caret position/offset from the start of the text. A value of `0` means the caret sits before the first character.

GetChild.DESCRIPTION: Gets a child by its index. For use with [Panel:ChildCount](/gmod/Panel:ChildCount).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: childIndex
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The index of the child to get.
NOTES: This index starts at 0, except when you use this on a [DMenu](/gmod/DMenu).

GetChildPosition.DESCRIPTION: Gets a child object's position relative to this panel object. The number of levels is not relevant; the child may have many parents between itself and the object on which the method is called.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: pnl
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The panel to get the position of.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The horizontal (x) position of the child relative to this panel object.
The vertical (y) position of the child relative to this panel object.

GetChildren.DESCRIPTION: Returns a table with all the child panels of the panel.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: All direct children of this panel.

GetChildrenInRect.DESCRIPTION: Returns a table of all visible, selectable children of the panel object that lie at least partially within the specified rectangle.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: x
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The horizontal (x) position of the top-left corner of the rectangle, relative to the panel object.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: y
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The vertical (y) position of the top-left corner of the rectangle, relative to the panel object.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: w
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The width of the rectangle.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: h
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The height of the rectangle.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: A table of panel objects that lie at least partially within the specified rectangle.

GetClassName.DESCRIPTION: Returns the class name of the panel. This would be the class name of the base engine-level panel, not Lua classname. The latter is stored usually in [Panel:GetName](/gmod/Panel:GetName).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The panel's class name.

GetClosestChild.DESCRIPTION: Returns the child of this panel object that is closest to the specified point. The point is relative to the object on which the method is called. The distance the child is from this point is also returned.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: x
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The horizontal (x) position of the point.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: y
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The vertical (y) position of the point.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The child object that was closest to the specified point.
The distance that this child was from the point.

GetContentAlignment.DESCRIPTION: Returns the alignment of the text of a [Label](/gmod/Label).
NOTES: This function only works on [Label](/gmod/Label) panels and its derivatives.

RETURNS.NAME: alignment
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION:
The direction of the content, based on the number pad. See [ContentAlignment](/gmod/Enums/ContentAlignment).

: **bottom-left** 
: **bottom-center** 
: **bottom-right** 
: **middle-left** 
: **center** 
: **middle-right** 
: **top-left** 
: **top-center** 
: **top-right**

GetContentSize.DESCRIPTION:
Gets the size of the content/children within a panel object.

Only works with [Label](/gmod/Label) derived panels by default such as [DLabel](/gmod/DLabel).


Will also work on any panel that manually implements this method.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The content width of the object.
The content height of the object.

GetCookie.DESCRIPTION:
Gets the value of a cookie stored by the panel object. This can also be done with [cookie.GetString](/gmod/cookie.GetString), using the panel's cookie name, a fullstop, and then the actual name of the cookie.

Make sure the panel's cookie name has not changed since writing, or the cookie will not be accessible. This can be done with [Panel:GetCookieName](/gmod/Panel:GetCookieName) and [Panel:SetCookieName](/gmod/Panel:SetCookieName).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: cookieName
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The name of the cookie from which to retrieve the value.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: default
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The default value to return if the cookie does not exist.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The value of the stored cookie, or the default value should the cookie not exist.

GetCookieName.DESCRIPTION: Gets the name the panel uses to store cookies. This is set with [Panel:SetCookieName](/gmod/Panel:SetCookieName).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION:
The name the panel uses when reading or writing cookies. The format used is as follows: 
```
panelCookieName.individualCookieName
```

GetCookieNumber.DESCRIPTION:
Gets the value of a cookie stored by the panel object, as a number. This can also be done with [cookie.GetNumber](/gmod/cookie.GetNumber), using the panel's cookie name, a fullstop, and then the actual name of the cookie.

Make sure the panel's cookie name has not changed since writing, or the cookie will not be accessible. This can be done with [Panel:GetCookieName](/gmod/Panel:GetCookieName) and [Panel:SetCookieName](/gmod/Panel:SetCookieName).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: cookieName
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The name of the cookie from which to retrieve the value.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: default
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The default value to return if the cookie does not exist.

GetSelectedChildren.DESCRIPTION: Returns a table of all children of the panel object that are selected. This means that not all first-level members in the returned table will be of type [Panel](/gmod/Panel).

GetSelectedTextRange.DESCRIPTION:

GetSelectionCanvas.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the selection canvas for this panel. This will be the first parent that has [Panel:SetSelectionCanvas](/gmod/Panel:SetSelectionCanvas) set to true (or `self` if this panel is the selection canvas)

A selection canvas would be the panel that contains a bunch of selectable panels ([Panel:SetSelectable](/gmod/Panel:SetSelectable)), usually for the drag'n'drop system. GetSize.DESCRIPTION:

The panel's height ([Panel:GetTall](/gmod/Panel:GetTall))

GetSkin.DESCRIPTION: Returns the table for the derma skin currently being used by this panel object.

GetTable.DESCRIPTION: Returns the internal Lua table of the panel.

GetTall.DESCRIPTION:

GetText.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the panel's text (where applicable).

This method returns a maximum of 1023 bytes, except for [TextEntry](/gmod/TextEntry).

GetTextInset.DESCRIPTION: Gets the left and top text margins of a text-based panel object, such as a [DButton](/gmod/DButton) or [DLabel](/gmod/DLabel). This is set with [Panel:SetTextInset](/gmod/Panel:SetTextInset).

The top margin of the text, in pixels.

GetTextSize.DESCRIPTION: Gets the size of the text within a [Label](/gmod/Label) derived panel.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The width of the text in the DLabel.
The height of the text in the DLabel.

GetTooltip.DESCRIPTION: Returns the tooltip text that was set with [PANEL:SetTooltip](/gmod/PANEL:SetTooltip).

RETURNS.NAME: tooltip
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The tooltip text, if it was set.

GetTooltipDelay.DESCRIPTION:

If the delay is not explicitly set by this function, it will fallback to the value of the `tooltip_delay` [ConVar](/gmod/ConVar), which is `0.5` by default.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The tooltip delay in seconds, if it was set.

GetTooltipPanel.DESCRIPTION: Returns the tooltip panel that was set with [PANEL:SetTooltipPanel](/gmod/PANEL:SetTooltipPanel).

RETURNS.NAME: tooltip
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The tooltip panel, if it was set.

GetValidReceiverSlot.DESCRIPTION: Gets valid receiver slot of currently dragged panel.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The panel this was called on if a valid receiver slot exists, otherwise false.
The slot table.

GetValue.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the value the panel holds.

In engine is only implemented for [CheckButton](/gmod/CheckButton), [Label](/gmod/Label) and [TextEntry](/gmod/TextEntry) as a string.
NOTES: This function is limited to 8092 Bytes. If using [DTextEntry](/gmod/DTextEntry), use [Panel:GetText](/gmod/Panel:GetText) for unlimited bytes.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The value the panel holds.

GetWide.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the width of the panel.

See [Panel:GetTall](/gmod/Panel:GetTall) for the height of the panel. See also [Panel:GetSize](/gmod/Panel:GetSize) for a function that returns both.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: width

GetX.DESCRIPTION:

GetY.DESCRIPTION:

GetZPos.DESCRIPTION: Returns the Z position of the panel.

GoForward.DESCRIPTION: Goes forward one page in the HTML panel's history if available.

ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The text to be applied to the DCheckBoxLabel.

GWEN_SetControlName.DESCRIPTION: Used by [Panel:ApplyGWEN](/gmod/Panel:ApplyGWEN) to apply the `ControlName` property to a panel. This calls [Panel:SetName](/gmod/Panel:SetName).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: name
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The new name to apply to the panel.

GWEN_SetDock.DESCRIPTION: Used by [Panel:ApplyGWEN](/gmod/Panel:ApplyGWEN) to apply the `Dock` property to a  panel object. This calls [Panel:Dock](/gmod/Panel:Dock).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: dockState
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION:
The dock mode to pass to the panel's `Dock` method. This reads a string and applies the approriate [DOCK](/gmod/Enums/DOCK).

GWEN_SetHorizontalAlign.DESCRIPTION: Used by [Panel:ApplyGWEN](/gmod/Panel:ApplyGWEN) to apply the `HorizontalAlign` property to a  panel object. This calls [Panel:SetContentAlignment](/gmod/Panel:SetContentAlignment).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: hAlign
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION:
The alignment, as a string, to pass to [Panel:SetContentAlignment](/gmod/Panel:SetContentAlignment). Accepts:
* `Right`: Align mid-right.
* `Left`: Align mid-left.
* `Center`: Align mid-center.

GWEN_SetMargin.DESCRIPTION: Used by [Panel:ApplyGWEN](/gmod/Panel:ApplyGWEN) to apply the `Margin` property to a  panel object. This calls [Panel:DockMargin](/gmod/Panel:DockMargin).

ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION:
A four-membered table containing the margins as numbers:
* [number](/gmod/number) left - The left margin.
* [number](/gmod/number) top - The top margin.
* [number](/gmod/number) right - The right margin.
* [number](/gmod/number) bottom - The bottom margin.

GWEN_SetMax.DESCRIPTION: Used by [Panel:ApplyGWEN](/gmod/Panel:ApplyGWEN) to apply the `Max` property to a  [DNumberWang](/gmod/DNumberWang), [Slider](/gmod/Slider), [DNumSlider](/gmod/DNumSlider) or [DNumberScratch](/gmod/DNumberScratch). This calls `SetMax` on one of the previously listed methods.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: maxValue
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The maximum value the element is to permit.

GWEN_SetMin.DESCRIPTION: Used by [Panel:ApplyGWEN](/gmod/Panel:ApplyGWEN) to apply the `Min` property to a  [DNumberWang](/gmod/DNumberWang), [Slider](/gmod/Slider), [DNumSlider](/gmod/DNumSlider) or [DNumberScratch](/gmod/DNumberScratch). This calls `SetMin` on one of the previously listed methods.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: minValue
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The minimum value the element is to permit.

GWEN_SetPosition.DESCRIPTION: Used by [Panel:ApplyGWEN](/gmod/Panel:ApplyGWEN) to apply the `Position` property to a  panel object. This calls [Panel:SetPos](/gmod/Panel:SetPos).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: pos
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION:
A two-membered table containing the x and y coordinates as numbers:
* [number](/gmod/number) x - The x coordinate.
* [number](/gmod/number) y - The y coordinate.

GWEN_SetSize.DESCRIPTION: Used by [Panel:ApplyGWEN](/gmod/Panel:ApplyGWEN) to apply the `Size` property to a  panel object. This calls [Panel:SetSize](/gmod/Panel:SetSize).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: size
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION:
A two-membered table containing the width and heights as numbers:
* [number](/gmod/number) w - The width.
* [number](/gmod/number) h - The height.

GWEN_SetText.DESCRIPTION: Used by [Panel:ApplyGWEN](/gmod/Panel:ApplyGWEN) to apply the `Text` property to a panel.

ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The text to be applied to the panel.

InsertClickableTextEnd.DESCRIPTION: Marks the end of a clickable text segment in a [RichText](/gmod/RichText) element, started with [Panel:InsertClickableTextStart](/gmod/Panel:InsertClickableTextStart).

InsertClickableTextStart.DESCRIPTION:
Starts the insertion of clickable text for a [RichText](/gmod/RichText) element. Any text appended with [Panel:AppendText](/gmod/Panel:AppendText) between this call and [Panel:InsertClickableTextEnd](/gmod/Panel:InsertClickableTextEnd) will become clickable text.

The hook [PANEL:OnTextClicked](/gmod/PANEL:OnTextClicked) is called when the text is clicked.
NOTES: The clickable text is a separate Derma panel which will not inherit the current font from the `RichText`.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: signalValue
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The text passed as the action signal's value.

InsertColorChange.DESCRIPTION: Inserts a color change in a [RichText](/gmod/RichText) element, which affects the color of all text added with [Panel:AppendText](/gmod/Panel:AppendText) until another color change is applied.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: r
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The red value `(0 - 255)`.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: g
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The green value `(0 - 255)`.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: b
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The blue value `(0 - 255)`.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: a
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The alpha value `(0 - 255)`.

InsertFade.DESCRIPTION:
Begins a text fade for a [RichText](/gmod/RichText) element where the last appended text segment is fully faded out after a specific amount of time, at a specific speed.

The alpha of the text at any given time is determined by the text's base alpha * ((`sustain` - [CurTime](/gmod/Global.CurTime)) / `length`) where [CurTime](/gmod/Global.CurTime) is added to `sustain` when this method is called.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: sustain
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The number of seconds the text remains visible.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: length
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION:
The number of seconds it takes the text to fade out.

If set **lower** than `sustain`, the text will not begin fading out until (`sustain` - `length`) seconds have passed.

If set **higher** than `sustain`, the text will begin fading out immediately at a fraction of the base alpha.

If set to **-1**, the text doesn't fade out.

InvalidateChildren.DESCRIPTION: Invalidates the layout of this panel object and all its children. This will cause these objects to re-layout immediately, calling [PANEL:PerformLayout](/gmod/PANEL:PerformLayout). If you want to perform the layout in the next frame, you will have loop manually through all children, and call [Panel:InvalidateLayout](/gmod/Panel:InvalidateLayout) on each.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: recursive
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: If `true`, the method will recursively invalidate the layout of all children. Otherwise, only immediate children are affected.

InvalidateLayout.DESCRIPTION:
Causes the panel to re-layout in the next frame. During the layout process  [PANEL:PerformLayout](/gmod/PANEL:PerformLayout) will be called on the target panel.

You should avoid calling this function every frame.

BUGS.DESCRIPTION: Using this on a panel after clicking on a docked element will cause docked elements to reorient themselves incorrectly. This can be fixed by assigning a unique [Panel:SetZPos](/gmod/Panel:SetZPos) to each docked element.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: layoutNow
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: If true the panel will re-layout instantly and not wait for the next frame.

InvalidateParent.DESCRIPTION:
Calls [Panel:InvalidateLayout](/gmod/Panel:InvalidateLayout) on the panel's [parent](/gmod/Panel:GetParent). This function will silently fail if the panel has no parent.

This will cause the parent panel to re-layout, calling [PANEL:PerformLayout](/gmod/PANEL:PerformLayout).

Internally sets `LayingOutParent` to `true` on this panel, and will silently fail if it is already set.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: layoutNow
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: If `true`, the re-layout will occur immediately, otherwise it will be performed in the next frame.

IsChildHovered.DESCRIPTION: Determines whether the mouse cursor is hovered over one of this panel object's children. This is a reverse process using [vgui.GetHoveredPanel](/gmod/vgui.GetHoveredPanel), and looks upward to find the parent.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: immediate
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Set to true to check only the immediate children of given panel ( first level )

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether or not one of this panel object's children is being hovered over.

IsDraggable.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether this panel is draggable ( if user is able to drag it ) or not.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether this panel is draggable ( if user is able to drag it ) or not.

IsDragging.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether this panel is currently being dragged or not.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether this panel is currently being dragged or not.

IsEnabled.DESCRIPTION:
Returns whether the the panel is enabled or disabled.

See [Panel:SetEnabled](/gmod/Panel:SetEnabled) for a function that makes the panel enabled or disabled.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the panel is enabled or disabled.

IsHovered.DESCRIPTION:
Returns whether the mouse cursor is hovering over this panel or not

Uses [vgui.GetHoveredPanel](/gmod/vgui.GetHoveredPanel) internally.

Requires [Panel:SetMouseInputEnabled](/gmod/Panel:SetMouseInputEnabled) to be set to true.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: true if the panel is hovered

IsKeyboardInputEnabled.DESCRIPTION: Returns true if the panel can receive keyboard input.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: keyboardInputEnabled

IsLoading.DESCRIPTION: Determines whether or not a [HTML](/gmod/HTML) or [DHTML](/gmod/DHTML) element is currently loading a page.
NOTES: Before calling [Panel:SetHTML](/gmod/Panel:SetHTML) or [DHTML:OpenURL](/gmod/DHTML:OpenURL), the result seems to be `false` with the Awesomium web renderer and `true` for the Chromium web renderer. This difference can be used to determine the available HTML5 capabilities.

On Awesomium, the result remains `true` until the root document is loaded and when in-page content is loading (when adding pictures, frames, etc.). During this state, the HTML texture is not refreshed and the panel is not painted (it becomes invisible).

On Chromium, the value is only `true` when the root document is not ready. The rendering is not suspended when in-page elements are loading.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether or not the (D)HTML object is loading.

IsMarkedForDeletion.DESCRIPTION: Returns if the panel is going to be deleted in the next frame.

IsModal.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether the panel was made modal or not. See [Panel:DoModal](/gmod/Panel:DoModal).

IsMouseInputEnabled.DESCRIPTION: Returns true if the panel can receive mouse input.

IsMultiline.DESCRIPTION: Determines whether or not a [TextEntry](/gmod/TextEntry) panel is in multi-line mode. This is set with [Panel:SetMultiline](/gmod/Panel:SetMultiline).

IsOurChild.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether the panel contains the given panel, recursively.

IsPopup.DESCRIPTION: Returns if the panel was made popup or not. See [Panel:MakePopup](/gmod/Panel:MakePopup)

IsSelectable.DESCRIPTION: Determines if the panel object is selectable (like icons in the Spawn Menu, holding ). This is set with [Panel:SetSelectable](/gmod/Panel:SetSelectable).

IsSelected.DESCRIPTION: Returns if the panel object is selected (like icons in the Spawn Menu, holding ). This can be set in Lua using [Panel:SetSelected](/gmod/Panel:SetSelected).

IsSelectionCanvas.DESCRIPTION: Determines if the panel object is a selection canvas or not. This is set with [Panel:SetSelectionCanvas](/gmod/Panel:SetSelectionCanvas).

IsValid.DESCRIPTION: Returns if the panel is valid and not marked for deletion.

IsVisible.DESCRIPTION: Returns if the panel is visible. This will **NOT** take into account visibility of the parent.

IsWorldClicker.DESCRIPTION: Returns if a panel allows world clicking set by [Panel:SetWorldClicker](/gmod/Panel:SetWorldClicker).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: If the panel allows world clicking.

KillFocus.DESCRIPTION: Remove the focus from the panel.

LerpPositions.DESCRIPTION:
Redefines the panel object's [Panel:SetPos](/gmod/Panel:SetPos) method to operate using frame-by-frame linear interpolation ([Lerp](/gmod/Global.Lerp)). When the panel's position is changed, it will move to the target position at the speed defined. You can undo this with [Panel:DisableLerp](/gmod/Panel:DisableLerp).

Unlike the other panel animation functions, such as [Panel:MoveTo](/gmod/Panel:MoveTo), this animation method will not operate whilst the game is paused. This is because it relies on [FrameTime](/gmod/Global.FrameTime).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: speed
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION:
The speed at which to move the panel. This is affected by the value of `easeOut`. Recommended values are:
* **0.1 - 10** when `easeOut` is `false`.
* **0.1 - 1** when `easeOut` is `true`.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: easeOut
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: This causes the panel object to 'jump' at the target, slowing as it approaches. This affects the `speed` value significantly, see above.

LoadControlsFromFile.DESCRIPTION: Similar to [Panel:LoadControlsFromString](/gmod/Panel:LoadControlsFromString) but loads controls from a file.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: path

The path used to look up the file.

* "GAME" Structured like base folder (garrysmod/), searches all the mounted content (main folder, addons, mounted games etc)
* "LUA" or "lsv" - All Lua folders (lua/) including gamesmodes and addons
* "DATA" Data folder (garrysmod/data)
* "MOD" Strictly the game folder (garrysmod/), ignores mounting.

ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The file path.

LocalCursorPos.DESCRIPTION: Returns the cursor position local to the position of the panel (usually the upper-left corner).
