LocalToScreen.DESCRIPTION:
Takes X and Y coordinates relative to the panel and returns their corresponding positions relative to the screen.

See also [Panel:ScreenToLocal](/gmod/Panel:ScreenToLocal).
NOTES: If the panel uses [Panel:Dock](/gmod/Panel:Dock), this function will return 0, 0 when the panel was created. The position will be updated in the next frame.
WARNINGS: This function uses a cached value for the screen position of the panel, computed at the end of the last VGUI Think/Layout pass, so inaccurate results may be returned if the panel or any of its ancestors have been re-positioned outside of [PANEL:Think](/gmod/PANEL:Think) or [PANEL:PerformLayout](/gmod/PANEL:PerformLayout) within the last frame.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: posX
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The X coordinate of the position on the panel to translate.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: posY
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The Y coordinate of the position on the panel to translate.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The X coordinate relative to the screen.
The Y coordinate relative to the screen.

MakePopup.DESCRIPTION:
Focuses the panel and enables it to receive input.

This automatically calls [Panel:SetMouseInputEnabled](/gmod/Panel:SetMouseInputEnabled) and [Panel:SetKeyboardInputEnabled](/gmod/Panel:SetKeyboardInputEnabled(lowercase)) and sets them to `true`.
NOTES:
Panels derived from [Panel](/gmod/Panel) will not work properly with this function. Due to this, any children will not be intractable with keyboard. Derive from [EditablePanel](/gmod/EditablePanel) instead.

For non gui related mouse focus, you can use [gui.EnableScreenClicker](/gmod/gui.EnableScreenClicker).

MouseCapture.DESCRIPTION: Allows the panel to receive mouse input even if the mouse cursor is outside the bounds of the panel.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: doCapture
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Set to true to enable, set to false to disable.

MoveAbove.DESCRIPTION: Places the panel above the passed panel with the specified offset.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: panel
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Panel to position relatively to.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: offset
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The align offset.

MoveBelow.DESCRIPTION: Places the panel below the passed panel with the specified offset.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: panel
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Panel to position relatively to.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: offset
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The align offset.

MoveBy.DESCRIPTION: Moves the panel by the specified coordinates using animation.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: moveX
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The number of pixels to move by in the horizontal (x) direction.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: moveY
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The number of pixels to move by in the vertical (y) direction.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: time
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The time (in seconds) in which to perform the animation.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: delay
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The delay (in seconds) before the animation begins.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ease
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The easing of the start and/or end speed of the animation. See [Panel:NewAnimation](/gmod/Panel:NewAnimation) for how this works.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: callback
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The function to be called once the animation is complete.

MoveLeftOf.DESCRIPTION: Places the panel left to the passed panel with the specified offset.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: panel
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Panel to position relatively to.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: offset
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The align offset.

MoveRightOf.DESCRIPTION: Places the panel right to the passed panel with the specified offset.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: panel
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Panel to position relatively to.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: offset
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The align offset.

MoveTo.DESCRIPTION: Moves the panel to the specified position using animation.
NOTES: Setting the ease argument to 0 will result in the animation happening instantly, this applies to all MoveTo/SizeTo functions

ARGUMENTS.NAME: posX
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The target x coordinate of the panel.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: posY
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The target y coordinate of the panel.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: time
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The time to perform the animation within.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: delay
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The delay before the animation starts.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ease
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The easing of the start and/or end speed of the animation. See [Panel:NewAnimation](/gmod/Panel:NewAnimation) for how this works.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: callback
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The function to be called once the animation finishes.

MoveToAfter.DESCRIPTION: Moves this panel object in front of the specified sibling (child of the same parent) in the render order, and shuffles up the Z-positions of siblings now behind.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: siblingPanel
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The panel to move this one in front of. Must be a child of the same parent panel.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: `false` if the passed panel is not a sibling, otherwise `nil`.

MoveToBack.DESCRIPTION: Moves the panel object behind all other panels on screen. If the panel has been made a pop-up with [Panel:MakePopup](/gmod/Panel:MakePopup), it will still draw in front of any panels that haven't.

MoveToBefore.DESCRIPTION: Moves this panel object behind the specified sibling (child of the same parent) in the render order, and shuffles up the [Panel:SetZPos](/gmod/Panel:SetZPos) of siblings now in front.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: siblingPanel
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The panel to move this one behind. Must be a child of the same parent panel.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: `false` if the passed panel is not a sibling, otherwise `nil`.

MoveToFront.DESCRIPTION: Moves the panel in front of all other panels on screen. Unless the panel has been made a pop-up using [Panel:MakePopup](/gmod/Panel:MakePopup), it will still draw behind any that have.

NewAnimation.DESCRIPTION:
Creates a new animation for the panel object.

Methods that use this function:
* [Panel:MoveTo](/gmod/Panel:MoveTo)
* [Panel:SizeTo](/gmod/Panel:SizeTo)
* [Panel:SlideUp](/gmod/Panel:SlideUp)
* [Panel:SlideDown](/gmod/Panel:SlideDown)
* [Panel:ColorTo](/gmod/Panel:ColorTo)
* [Panel:AlphaTo](/gmod/Panel:AlphaTo)
* [Panel:MoveBy](/gmod/Panel:MoveBy)
* [Panel:LerpPositions](/gmod/Panel:LerpPositions)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: length
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The length of the animation in seconds.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: delay
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The delay before the animation starts.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ease
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION:
The power/index to use for easing.
* Positive values greater than 1 will ease in; the higher the number, the sharper the curve's gradient (less linear).
* A value of 1 removes all easing.
* Positive values between 0 and 1 ease out; values closer to 0 increase the curve's gradient (less linear).
* A value of 0 will break the animation and should be avoided.
* Any value less than zero will ease in/out; the value has no effect on the gradient.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: callback
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The function to be called when the animation ends.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION:
Partially filled [Structures/AnimationData](/gmod/Structures/AnimationData) with the following members: 
* [number](/gmod/number) **EndTime** - Equal to `length` and `delay` arguments added together, plus either the [SysTime](/gmod/Global.SysTime) if there is no other animation queued or the end time of the last animation in the queue.
* [number](/gmod/number) **StartTime** - Equal to the `delay` argument, plus either the [SysTime](/gmod/Global.SysTime) if there is no other animation queued or the end time of the last animation in the queue.
* [number](/gmod/number) **Ease** - Equal to the `ease` argument.
* [function](/gmod/function) **OnEnd** - Equal to the `callback` argument.

NoClipping.DESCRIPTION:
Sets whether this panel's drawings should be clipped within the parent panel's bounds.

See [render.SetScissorRect](/gmod/render.SetScissorRect) if you wish to set the clipping rect instead.
NOTES:
This only disabled clipping for the Paint Related functions (as far as i can tell at the current moment, more testing should be done) so things like the text of a [DLabel](/gmod/DLabel) will still be clipped to the parent.

To fully disable the clipping of any children see [DisableClipping](/gmod/Global.DisableClipping).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: disableClipping
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Whether to disable clipping or not. `true` to disable clipping, `false` to enable clipping.

NumSelectedChildren.DESCRIPTION: Returns the number of children of the panel object that are selected. This is equivalent to calling [Panel:IsSelected](/gmod/Panel:IsSelected) on all child objects and counting the number of returns that are `true`.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The number of child objects that are currently selected. This does not include the parent object you are calling the method from.

OpenURL.DESCRIPTION:
Instructs a HTML control to download and parse a HTML script using the passed URL.

This function can only be used on [HTML](HTML) panel and its derivatives.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: URL
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION:
URL to open. It has to start or be one of the following:
* `http://`
* `https://`
* `asset://`
* `about:blank`
* `chrome://credits/`

PaintAt.DESCRIPTION: Paints a ghost copy of the panel at the given position.
WARNINGS: This function sets Z pos of panel's children ([PANEL:SetZPos](/gmod/PANEL:SetZPos)). It also briefly unparents and reparents the panel.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: posX
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The x coordinate to draw the panel from.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: posY
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The y coordinate to draw the panel from.

PaintManual.DESCRIPTION: Paints the panel at its current position. To use this you must call [Panel:SetPaintedManually](/gmod/Panel:SetPaintedManually)(true).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: unclamp
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: If set, overrides panels' clipping so that it can render fully when its size is larger than the game's resolution.

ParentToHUD.DESCRIPTION:
Parents the panel to the HUD.
Makes it invisible on the escape-menu and disables controls.

Paste.DESCRIPTION:
Only works for TextEntries.

Pastes the contents of the clipboard into the TextEntry.
DEPRECATED: Due to privacy concerns, this function has been disabled
NOTES: Tab characters will be dropped from the pasted text

PositionLabel.DESCRIPTION: Sets the width and position of a [DLabel](/gmod/DLabel) and places the passed panel object directly to the right of it. Returns the `y` value of the bottom of the tallest object. The panel on which this method is run is not relevant; only the passed objects are affected.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: lblWidth
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The width to set the label to.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: x
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The horizontal (x) position at which to place the label.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: y
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The vertical (y) position at which to place the label.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: lbl
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The label to resize and position.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: panelObj
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The panel object to place to the right of the label.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The distance from the top of the parent panel to the bottom of the tallest object (the `y` position plus the height of the label or passed panel, depending on which is tallest).

Prepare.DESCRIPTION: Installs Lua defined functions into the panel.

Queue.DESCRIPTION: Enables the queue for panel animations. If enabled, the next new animation will begin after all current animations have ended. This must be called before [Panel:NewAnimation](/gmod/Panel:NewAnimation) to work, and only applies to the next new animation. If you want to queue many, you must call this before each.

RebuildSpawnIcon.DESCRIPTION: Causes a [SpawnIcon](/gmod/SpawnIcon) to rebuild its model image.

RebuildSpawnIconEx.DESCRIPTION:
Re-renders a spawn icon with customized cam data.

[PositionSpawnIcon](/gmod/Global.PositionSpawnIcon) can be used to easily calculate the necessary camera parameters.
NOTES: This function does **not** accept the standard [Structures/CamData](/gmod/Structures/CamData).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: data
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION:
A table containing the information needed to re-render the icon:
* [Vector](/gmod/Vector) cam_pos - The relative camera position the model is viewed from.
* [Angle](/gmod/Angle) cam_ang - The camera angle the model is viewed from.
* [number](/gmod/number) cam_fov - The camera's field of view (FOV).
* [Entity](/gmod/Entity) ent - The entity object of the model.

Optional keys:
* [table](/gmod/table) lightbox - (As of 2026.08.26) Sets the "lightbox" for the model render. Wants 6 vectors (start index = 1). See [render.SetModelLighting](/gmod/render.SetModelLighting).
* [table](/gmod/table) lights - (As of 2026.08.26) Sets the "dynamic lights" for the model render. Same format as [render.SetLocalModelLights](/gmod/render.SetLocalModelLights).

See the example below for how to retrieve these values.

Receiver.DESCRIPTION: Allows the panel to receive drag and drop events. Can be called multiple times with different names to receive multiple different draggable panel events.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: name
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Name of DnD panels to receive. This is set on the drag'n'drop-able panels via  [Panel:Droppable](/gmod/Panel:Droppable)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: func
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: This function is called whenever a panel with valid name is hovering above and dropped on this panel.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: menu
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: A table of strings that will act as a menu if drag'n'drop was performed with a right click

Refresh.DESCRIPTION: Refreshes the HTML panel's current page.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ignoreCache
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: If true, the refresh will ignore cached content similar to "ctrl+f5" in most browsers.

Remove.DESCRIPTION:
Marks a panel for deletion so it will be deleted on the next frame.

This will not mark child panels for deletion this frame, but they will be marked and deleted in the next frame.

See also [Panel:IsMarkedForDeletion](/gmod/Panel:IsMarkedForDeletion)

Will automatically call [Panel:InvalidateParent](/gmod/Panel:InvalidateParent).

RequestFocus.DESCRIPTION: Attempts to obtain focus for this panel.

ResetAllFades.DESCRIPTION: Resets all text fades in a [RichText](/gmod/RichText) element made with [Panel:InsertFade](/gmod/Panel:InsertFade).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: hold
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: True to reset fades, false otherwise.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: expiredOnly
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Any value equating to `true` will reset fades only on text segments that are completely faded out.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: newSustain
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The new sustain value of each faded text segment. Set to -1 to keep the old sustain value.

RunJavascript.DESCRIPTION: Executes a string as JavaScript code on a web document panel.
NOTES:
This function does **NOT** allow you to pass variables from JavaScript (JS) to Lua context.  
If you wish to pass/return values from JS to Lua, you may want to use [DHTML:AddFunction](/gmod/DHTML:AddFunction) function to accomplish that job.

The Awesomium web renderer automatically delays the code execution if the document is not ready, but the Chromium web renderer does not!

This means that with Chromium, you cannot JavaScript run code immediatly after calling [Panel:SetHTML](/gmod/Panel:SetHTML) or [Panel:OpenURL](/gmod/Panel:OpenURL). You should wait for the events [HTML:OnDocumentReady](/gmod/HTML:OnDocumentReady) or [HTML:OnFinishLoadingDocument](/gmod/HTML:OnFinishLoadingDocument) to be triggered before proceeding, otherwise you may manipulate an empty / incomplete document.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: js
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Specify JavaScript code to be executed.

SaveUndoState.DESCRIPTION:
Saves the current state (caret position and the text inside) of a [TextEntry](/gmod/TextEntry) as an undo state.

See also [Panel:Undo](/gmod/Panel:Undo).

ScreenToLocal.DESCRIPTION:
Translates global screen coordinate to coordinates relative to the panel.

See also [Panel:LocalToScreen](/gmod/Panel:LocalToScreen).
WARNINGS: This function uses a cached value for the screen position of the panel, computed at the end of the last VGUI Think/Layout pass, so inaccurate results may be returned if the panel or any of its ancestors have been re-positioned outside of [PANEL:Think](/gmod/PANEL:Think) or [PANEL:PerformLayout](/gmod/PANEL:PerformLayout) within the last frame.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: screenX
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The x coordinate of the screen position to be translated.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: screenY
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The y coordinate of the screed position be to translated.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Relativeposition X
Relativeposition Y

SelectAll.DESCRIPTION: Selects all items within a panel or object. For text-based objects, selects all text.
NOTES: Only works on [RichText](/gmod/RichText) and [TextEntry](/gmod/TextEntry) and their derived panels by default (such as [DTextEntry](/gmod/DTextEntry)), and on any panel that manually reimplemented this method.

SelectAllOnFocus.DESCRIPTION: If called on a [TextEntry](/gmod/TextEntry), clicking the text entry for the first time will automatically select all of the text ready to be copied by the user.

SelectAllText.DESCRIPTION: Selects all the text in a panel object. Will not select non-text items; for this, use [Panel:SelectAll](/gmod/Panel:SelectAll).
DEPRECATED: Duplicate of Panel:SelectAll.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: resetCursorPos
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Reset cursor pos?

SelectNone.DESCRIPTION: Deselects all items in a panel object. For text-based objects, this will deselect all text.
NOTES: Only works on [RichText](/gmod/RichText) and [TextEntry](/gmod/TextEntry) and their derived panels by default (such as [DTextEntry](/gmod/DTextEntry)), and on any panel that manually reimplemented this method.

SetAchievement.DESCRIPTION: Sets the achievement to be displayed by [AchievementIcon](/gmod/AchievementIcon).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: id
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Achievement number ID

SetAllowNonAsciiCharacters.DESCRIPTION:
Configures a [TextEntry](/gmod/TextEntry) to allow user to type characters that are not included in the US-ASCII (7-bit ASCII) character set.

Characters not included in US-ASCII are multi-byte characters in UTF-8. They can be accented characters, non-Latin characters and special characters.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: allowed
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Set to true in order not to restrict input characters.

SetAlpha.DESCRIPTION: Sets the alpha multiplier for the panel

ARGUMENTS.NAME: alpha
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The alpha value in the range of 0-255.

SetAnimationEnabled.DESCRIPTION: Enables or disables animations for the panel object by overriding the [PANEL:AnimationThink](/gmod/PANEL:AnimationThink) hook to nil and back.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: enable
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Whether to enable or disable animations.

SetAutoDelete.DESCRIPTION: Sets whenever the panel should be removed if the parent was removed.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: autoDelete
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Whenever to delete if the parent was removed or not.

SetBGColor.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the background color of a panel such as a [RichText](/gmod/RichText), [Label](/gmod/Label), [DColorCube](/gmod/DColorCube) or the base [Panel](/gmod/Panel).

For many panels, such as [DLabel](/gmod/DLabel) and [Panel](/gmod/Panel), you must use [Panel:SetPaintBackgroundEnabled](/gmod/Panel:SetPaintBackgroundEnabled)( true ) for the background to appear.

Please note that for most panels the engine will overwrite the foreground and background colors a frame after panel creation via the [PANEL:ApplySchemeSettings](/gmod/PANEL:ApplySchemeSettings) hook, so you may want to set the color in that hook instead.

See [Panel:SetFGColor](/gmod/Panel:SetFGColor) for the foreground color.
NOTES: This doesn't apply to all VGUI elements and its function varies between them

ARGUMENTS.NAME: r
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The red channel of the color.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: g
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The green channel of the color.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: b
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The blue channel of the color.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: a
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The alpha channel of the color.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: color
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: A [Color](/gmod/Color) object/table to read the color from. This is slower than providing four numbers. You could use [Color:Unpack](/gmod/Color:Unpack) to address this. You should also cache your color objects if you wish to use them, for performance reasons.

SetBGColorEx.DESCRIPTION: Sets the background color of the panel.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: r
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The red channel of the color.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: g
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The green channel of the color.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: b
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The blue channel of the color.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: a
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The alpha channel of the color.

SetCaretPos.DESCRIPTION: Sets the position of the caret (or text cursor) in a text-based panel object.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: offset
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Caret position/offset from the start of text. A value of `0` places the caret before the first character.

SetContentAlignment.DESCRIPTION: Sets the alignment of the contents.
NOTES: This function doesnt work, if [Panel:SetWrap](/gmod/Panel:SetWrap) is true.
This function only works on [Label](/gmod/Label) panels and its derivatives.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: alignment
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION:
The direction of the content, based on the number pad. See [ContentAlignment](/gmod/Enums/ContentAlignment).

: **bottom-left** 
: **bottom-center** 
: **bottom-right** 
: **middle-left** 
: **center** 
: **middle-right** 
: **top-left** 
: **top-center** 
: **top-right**

SetConVar.DESCRIPTION:
Sets this panel's convar. When the convar changes this panel will update automatically.

For developer implementation, see [Derma_Install_Convar_Functions](/gmod/Global.Derma_Install_Convar_Functions).
NOTES: Blocked convars will not work with this, see [Blocked ConCommands](/gmod/Blocked%20ConCommands)
WARNINGS: This function does not exist on all panels
This function cannot interact with serverside convars unless you are host

ARGUMENTS.NAME: convar
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The console variable to check.

SetCookie.DESCRIPTION:
Stores a string in the named cookie using [Panel:GetCookieName](/gmod/Panel:GetCookieName) as prefix.

You can also retrieve and modify this cookie by using the [cookie](/gmod/cookie). Cookies are stored in this format:

```
panelCookieName.cookieName
```
WARNINGS: The panel's cookie name MUST be set for this function to work. See [Panel:SetCookieName](/gmod/Panel:SetCookieName).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: cookieName
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The unique name used to retrieve the cookie later.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: value
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The value to store in the cookie. This can be retrieved later as a [string](/gmod/string) or [number](/gmod/number).

SetCookieName.DESCRIPTION: Sets the panel's cookie name. Calls [PANEL:LoadCookies](/gmod/PANEL:LoadCookies) if defined.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: name
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The panel's cookie name. Used as prefix for [Panel:SetCookie](/gmod/Panel:SetCookie), therefore should be a unique value.

SetCursor.DESCRIPTION: Sets the appearance of the cursor. You can find a list of all available cursors with image previews [here](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: cursor
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION:
The cursor to be set. Can be one of the following:

* [arrow](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=arrow)
* [beam](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=beam)
* [hourglass](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=hourglass)
* [waitarrow](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=waitarrow)
* [crosshair](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=crosshair)
* [up](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=up)
* [sizenwse](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=sizenwse)
* [sizenesw](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=sizenesw)
* [sizewe](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=sizewe)
* [sizens](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=sizens)
* [sizeall](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=sizeall)
* [no](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=no)
* [hand](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=hand)
* [blank](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Cursors#:~:text=blank)

Set to anything else to set it to "none", the default fallback. Do note that a value of "none" does not, as one might assume, result in no cursor being drawn - hiding the cursor requires a value of "blank" instead.

SetDragParent.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the drag parent.

Drag parent means that when we start to drag this panel, we'll really start dragging the defined parent.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: parent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The panel to set as drag parent.

SetDrawLanguageID.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the visibility of the language selection box when typing in non-English mode.

		See [Panel:SetDrawLanguageIDAtLeft](/gmod/Panel:SetDrawLanguageIDAtLeft) for a function that changes the position of the language selection box.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: visible
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: true to make it visible, false to hide it.

SetDrawLanguageIDAtLeft.DESCRIPTION:
Sets where to draw the language selection box.

See [Panel:SetDrawLanguageID](/gmod/Panel:SetDrawLanguageID) for a function that hides or shows the language selection box.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: left
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: true = left, false = right

SetDrawOnTop.DESCRIPTION:
Makes the panel render in front of all others, including the spawn menu and main menu.

Priority is given based on the last call, so of two panels that call this method, the second will draw in front of the first.
NOTES:
This only makes the panel **draw** above other panels. If there's another panel that would have otherwise covered it, users will not be able to interact with it.

Completely disregards [PANEL:ParentToHUD](/gmod/PANEL:ParentToHUD).
WARNINGS: This does not work when using [PANEL:SetPaintedManually](/gmod/PANEL:SetPaintedManually) or [PANEL:PaintAt](/gmod/PANEL:PaintAt).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: drawOnTop
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Whether or not to draw the panel in front of all others.

SetDropTarget.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the target area for dropping when an object is being dragged around this panel using the [dragndrop](/gmod/dragndrop). 

This draws a target box of the specified size and position, until [Panel:DragHoverEnd](/gmod/Panel:DragHoverEnd) is called. It uses [Panel:DrawDragHover](/gmod/Panel:DrawDragHover) to draw this area.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: x
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The x coordinate of the top-left corner of the drop area.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: y
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The y coordinate of the top-left corner of the drop area.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: width
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The width of the drop area.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: height
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The height of the drop area.

SetEnabled.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the enabled state of a panel object that supports being disabled, such as a [DButton](/gmod/DButton) or [DTextEntry](/gmod/DTextEntry).

Disabled panels cannot be interacted with, and have a different appearance to indicate this.

See [Panel:IsEnabled](/gmod/Panel:IsEnabled) for a function that retrieves the "enabled" state of a panel.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: enable
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Whether to enable or disable the panel object.

SetExpensiveShadow.DESCRIPTION: Adds a shadow falling to the bottom right corner of the panel's text.
NOTES: This works only on  panels that derive from [Label](/gmod/Label).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: distance
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The distance of the shadow from the panel.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: Color
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The color of the shadow. Uses [Color](/gmod/Color).

SetFGColor.DESCRIPTION:
Sets the foreground color of a panel.

For a [Label](/gmod/Label) or [RichText](/gmod/RichText), this is the color of its text.

This function calls [Panel:SetFGColorEx](/gmod/Panel:SetFGColorEx) internally. 

Please note that for most panels the engine will overwrite the foreground and background colors a frame after panel creation via the [PANEL:ApplySchemeSettings](/gmod/PANEL:ApplySchemeSettings) hook, so you may want to set the color in that hook instead.

See [Panel:SetBGColor](/gmod/Panel:SetBGColor) for the background color.
NOTES: This doesn't apply to all VGUI elements (such as [DLabel](/gmod/DLabel)) and its function varies between them

ARGUMENTS.NAME: r
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The red channel of the color.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: g
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The green channel of the color.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: b
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The blue channel of the color.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: a
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The alpha channel of the color.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: color

Panel.DESCRIPTION:
This is the base panel for every other [VGUI](vgui) panel.

It contains all of the basic methods, some of which may only work on certain VGUI elements. See also [Panel Hooks](/gmod/Panel%20Hooks).

As their functionality is provided at the game's C/C++ level rather than by its Lua script extension, they are unfortunately unavailable for most practical purposes, however, they can still be obtained in a way similar to that provided by the [baseclass](/gmod/baseclass) library:

```
-- Create a new panel type NewPanel that inherits all of its functionality from DLabel,
-- but has a different SetText method than DLabel does - all without the hassle of that
-- old DLabel's default text getting in the way. Fun stuff.

local PANEL = {}

function PANEL:Init()

	self:SetText_Base( "" )
	self:SetText( "Time for something different!" )

end

function PANEL:Paint( aWide, aTall )

	local TextX, TextY = 0, 0
	local TextColor = Color( 255, 0, 0, 255 )

	surface.SetFont( self:GetFont() or "default" )
	surface.SetTextColor( TextColor )
	surface.SetTextPos( TextX, TextY )
	surface.DrawText( self:GetText() )

end

-- And here we go:
PANEL.SetText_Base = FindMetaTable( "Panel" ).SetText

function PANEL:SetText( aText ) 

	self.Text = tostring( aText ) 

end

function PANEL:GetText() 

	return self.Text or "" 

end

vgui.Register( "NewPanel", PANEL, "DLabel" )
```

For PathFollower objects of the `Follow` type use [PathFollower:Compute](/gmod/PathFollower:Compute)

ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: A function that allows you to alter the path generation. See example on [PathFollower:Compute](/gmod/PathFollower:Compute) for the default function.

Compute.DESCRIPTION:
Compute shortest path from bot to 'goal' via A* algorithm. This only works if the PathFollower is the `Follow` Type.

Internally transforms the vector by the [PhysObj:GetPositionMatrix](/gmod/PhysObj:GetPositionMatrix).

So in GLua it approximates to:
```
local matrixWorldTransform = PhysObj:GetPositionMatrix()
local vecWorldspaced = Vector()
vecWorldspaced:Set( vecLocal )
vecWorldspaced:Mul( matrixWorldTransform )

return vecWorldspaced
```

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The corresponding worldspace vector.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The resulting vector from the rotational transformation.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: vec
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: A worldspace vector.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The resulting vector from the rotational transformation.

PhysObj.DESCRIPTION:
This is the object returned by [Entity:GetPhysicsObject](/gmod/Entity:GetPhysicsObject), [Entity:GetPhysicsObjectNum](/gmod/Entity:GetPhysicsObjectNum) and [Vehicle:GetWheel](/gmod/Vehicle:GetWheel).

It represents a physics object. An entity can have multiple physics objects (ragdolls), one physics objects (props), or none. (NPCs, non physics entities, etc.)

Physics objects are usually simulated by the physics engine and usually dictate the position of the entity, and not the other way around.

AccountID.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the player's AccountID part of their full SteamID.

Since this does not include other vital parts of the SteamID such as "Account Type" and "Account Instance", it should be avoided, as AccountIDs are finite, and can theoretically be the same for multiple valid accounts.

See [Player:SteamID](/gmod/Player:SteamID) for the text representation of the full SteamID.
See [Player:SteamID64](/gmod/Player:SteamID64) for a 64bit representation of the full SteamID.
NOTES:
In a `-multirun` environment, this will return `-1` for all "copies" of a player because they are not authenticated with Steam.

For bots this will return values starting with `0` for the first bot, `1` for the second bot and so on.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The AccountID of Player's SteamID.

AddCleanup.DESCRIPTION: Adds an entity to the player's clean up list. This uses [cleanup.Add](/gmod/cleanup.Add) internally.
NOTES: This function is only available in Sandbox and its derivatives.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: type
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The Cleanup type for this Entity.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The Entity to add.

AddCount.DESCRIPTION: Adds an entity to the player's list of entities of the same type. See [Player:GetCount](/gmod/Player:GetCount) to get the current count of entities of an entity type added with this function.
NOTES: This function is only available in Sandbox and its derivatives.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: str
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The type of this Entity.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The Entity you want to add to the list.

AddDeaths.DESCRIPTION: Adds the provided amount to the player's death count.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: count
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The amount to add to the death count.

AddFrags.DESCRIPTION: Adds the provided amount to the player's frag/kill count.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: count
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The amount to add.

AddFrozenPhysicsObject.DESCRIPTION: Adds an entity to the player's list of frozen objects.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ent
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The Entity to add.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: physobj
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The physics object of the Entity.

AddPlayerOption.DESCRIPTION:
Sets up the voting system for the player.
This is a really barebone system. By calling this a vote gets started, when the player presses 0-9 the callback function gets called along with the key the player pressed. Use the draw callback to draw the vote panel.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: name
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Name of the vote

ARGUMENTS.NAME: timeout
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Time until the vote expires

ARGUMENTS.NAME: vote_callback
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The function to be run when the player presses 0-9 while a vote is active.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: draw_callback
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Used to draw the vote panel.

AddVCDSequenceToGestureSlot.DESCRIPTION: Plays a sequence directly from a sequence number, similar to [Player:AnimRestartGesture](/gmod/Player:AnimRestartGesture). This function has the advantage to play sequences that haven't been bound to an existing [ACT](/gmod/Enums/ACT)
WARNINGS: This is not automatically networked. This function has to be called on the client to be seen by said client.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: slot
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Gesture slot using [GESTURE_SLOT](/gmod/Enums/GESTURE_SLOT)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: sequenceId
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The sequence ID to play, can be retrieved with [Entity:LookupSequence](/gmod/Entity:LookupSequence).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: cycle
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The cycle to start the animation at, ranges from 0 to 1.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: autokill
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: If the animation should not loop. true = stops the animation, false = the animation keeps playing.

Alive.DESCRIPTION:
Checks if the player is alive. 

Player specific implementation of [Entity:Alive](/gmod/Entity:Alive), the value is synchronized to the client.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the player is alive

AllowFlashlight.DESCRIPTION:
Sets if the player can toggle their flashlight. Function exists on both the server and client but has no effect when ran on the client.

This is a Lua method that internally uses [GM:PlayerSwitchFlashlight](/gmod/GM:PlayerSwitchFlashlight). If current gamemode overwrites that hook and doesn't respect [Player:CanUseFlashlight](/gmod/Player:CanUseFlashlight), this function will not have any effect.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: canFlashlight
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: True allows flashlight toggling

AllowImmediateDecalPainting.DESCRIPTION: Lets the player spray their decal without delay

ARGUMENTS.NAME: allow
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Allow or disallow

AnimResetGestureSlot.DESCRIPTION: Resets player gesture in selected slot.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: slot
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Slot to reset. See the [GESTURE_SLOT](/gmod/Enums/GESTURE_SLOT).

AnimRestartGesture.DESCRIPTION: Restart a gesture on a player, within a gesture slot.
WARNINGS: This is not automatically networked. This function has to be called on the client to be seen by said client.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: slot
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Gesture slot using [GESTURE_SLOT](/gmod/Enums/GESTURE_SLOT)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: activity
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The activity ( see [ACT](/gmod/Enums/ACT) ) or sequence that should be played

ARGUMENTS.NAME: autokill
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the animation should be automatically stopped. true = stops the animation, false = the animation keeps playing/looping

AnimRestartMainSequence.DESCRIPTION: Restarts the main animation on the player, has the same effect as calling [Entity:SetCycle](/gmod/Entity:SetCycle)( 0 ).

AnimSetGestureSequence.DESCRIPTION: Sets the sequence of the animation playing in the given gesture slot.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: slot
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The gesture slot. See [GESTURE_SLOT](/gmod/Enums/GESTURE_SLOT)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: sequenceID
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Sequence ID to set.

AnimSetGestureWeight.DESCRIPTION: Sets the weight of the animation playing in the given gesture slot.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: slot
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The gesture slot. See [GESTURE_SLOT](/gmod/Enums/GESTURE_SLOT)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: weight
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The weight this slot should be set to. Value must be ranging from 0 to 1.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The player's armor.

Ban.DESCRIPTION: Bans the player from the server for a certain amount of minutes.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: minutes
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Duration of the ban in minutes (0 is permanent)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: kick
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Whether to kick the player after banning them or not

CanUseFlashlight.DESCRIPTION: Returns true if the player's flashlight hasn't been disabled by [Player:AllowFlashlight](/gmod/Player:AllowFlashlight).
NOTES: This is not synchronized between clients and server automatically!

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the player can use flashlight.

ChatPrint.DESCRIPTION: Prints a string to the chatbox of the client.
WARNINGS: Just like the [usermessage](/gmod/usermessage), this function is affected by the 255 byte limit!

ARGUMENTS.NAME: message
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: String to be printed

CheckLimit.DESCRIPTION:
Checks if the limit of an entity type added by [Player:AddCount](/gmod/Player:AddCount) is hit or not. If it's hit, it will call the [GM:PlayerCheckLimit](/gmod/GM:PlayerCheckLimit) hook, and call [Player:LimitHit](/gmod/Player:LimitHit) if the hook doesn't return `false`.

This will always return `true` in singleplayer, as singleplayer does not have limits.
NOTES: This function is only available in Sandbox and its derivatives.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: str
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION:
The entity type to check the limit for. Default types:
* "constraints"
* "props"
* "ragdolls"
* "vehicles"
* "effects"
* "balloons"
* "cameras"
* "npcs"
* "sents"
* "dynamite"
* "lamps"
* "lights"
* "wheels"
* "thrusters"
* "hoverballs"
* "buttons"
* "emitters"

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Returns `true` if the limit of this type is not hit, `false` otherwise.

ConCommand.DESCRIPTION:
Runs the concommand on the player. This does not work on bots. If used clientside, always runs the command on the local player.

If you wish to directly modify the movement input of bots, use [GM:StartCommand](/gmod/GM:StartCommand) instead.
NOTES: Some commands/convars are blocked from being run/changed using this function, usually to prevent harm/annoyance to clients. For a list of blocked commands, see [Blocked ConCommands](/gmod/Blocked%20ConCommands).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: command
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: command to run

CreateRagdoll.DESCRIPTION:
Creates the player's death ragdoll entity and deletes the old one.

This is normally used when a player dies, to create their death ragdoll.

The ragdoll will be created with the player's properties such as [Position](/gmod/Entity:GetPos), [Angles](/gmod/Entity:GetAngles), [PlayerColor](/gmod/Player:GetPlayerColor), [Velocity](/gmod/Entity:GetVelocity) and [Model](/gmod/Entity:GetModel).

You can retrieve the entity this creates with [Player:GetRagdollEntity](/gmod/Player:GetRagdollEntity).

CrosshairDisable.DESCRIPTION: Disables the default player's crosshair. Can be reenabled with [Player:CrosshairEnable](/gmod/Player:CrosshairEnable). This will affect [WEAPON:DoDrawCrosshair](/gmod/WEAPON:DoDrawCrosshair).

CrosshairEnable.DESCRIPTION: Enables the player's crosshair, if it was previously disabled via [Player:CrosshairDisable](/gmod/Player:CrosshairDisable).

Crouching.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether the player is crouching or not ([FL_DUCKING](/gmod/Enums/FL) flag).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the player is crouching.
The number of deaths the player has had.

DebugInfo.DESCRIPTION: Prints the players' name and position to the console.

DetonateTripmines.DESCRIPTION: Detonates all tripmines belonging to the player.

DisableWorldClicking.DESCRIPTION: Disables world clicking for given player. See [Panel:SetWorldClicker](/gmod/Panel:SetWorldClicker) and [Player:IsWorldClickingDisabled](/gmod/Player:IsWorldClickingDisabled).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: disable
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the world clicking should be disabled.

DoAnimationEvent.DESCRIPTION:
Sends a third person animation event to the player.

Calls [GM:DoAnimationEvent](/gmod/GM:DoAnimationEvent) with [PLAYERANIMEVENT_CUSTOM_GESTURE](/gmod/Enums/PLAYERANIMEVENT) as the event, data as the given data.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: data
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The data to send.

DoAttackEvent.DESCRIPTION:
Starts the player's attack animation. The attack animation is determined by the weapon's HoldType.

Similar to other animation event functions, calls [GM:DoAnimationEvent](/gmod/GM:DoAnimationEvent) with [PLAYERANIMEVENT_ATTACK_PRIMARY](/gmod/Enums/PLAYERANIMEVENT) as the event and no extra data.

DoCustomAnimEvent.DESCRIPTION:
Sends a specified third person animation event to the player.

Calls [GM:DoAnimationEvent](/gmod/GM:DoAnimationEvent) with specified arguments.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: event
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The event to send. See [PLAYERANIMEVENT](/gmod/Enums/PLAYERANIMEVENT).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: data
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The data to send alongside the event.

DoReloadEvent.DESCRIPTION:
Sends a third person reload animation event to the player.

Similar to other animation event functions, calls [GM:DoAnimationEvent](/gmod/GM:DoAnimationEvent) with [PLAYERANIMEVENT_RELOAD](/gmod/Enums/PLAYERANIMEVENT) as the event and no extra data.

DoSecondaryAttack.DESCRIPTION:
Sends a third person secondary fire animation event to the player.

Similar to other animation event functions, calls [GM:DoAnimationEvent](/gmod/GM:DoAnimationEvent) with [PLAYERANIMEVENT_ATTACK_SECONDARY](/gmod/Enums/PLAYERANIMEVENT) as the event and no extra data.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: draw
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Should draw

ARGUMENTS.NAME: vm
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Which view model to show/hide, 0-2.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: draw
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Should draw

DropNamedWeapon.DESCRIPTION: Drops the players' weapon of a specific class.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: class
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The class to drop.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: target
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: If set, launches the weapon at given position. There is a limit to how far it is willing to throw the weapon. Overrides velocity argument.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: velocity
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: If set and previous argument is unset, launches the weapon with given velocity. If the velocity is higher than 400, it will be clamped to 400.

DropObject.DESCRIPTION:
Drops any object the player is currently holding with either Gravity Gun, Physics Gun or `+use` (E key)

See also [Entity:ForcePlayerDrop](/gmod/Entity:ForcePlayerDrop).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: entity
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Only drop if the held entity is this entity. If left blank, drop any held entity.

DropWeapon.DESCRIPTION: Forces the player to drop the specified weapon

ARGUMENTS.NAME: weapon
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Weapon to be dropped. If unset, will default to the currently equipped weapon.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: target
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: If set, launches the weapon at given position. There is a limit to how far it is willing to throw the weapon. Overrides velocity argument.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: velocity
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: If set and previous argument is unset, launches the weapon with given velocity. If the velocity is higher than 400, it will be clamped to 400.

EnterVehicle.DESCRIPTION:
Force puts the player into a specified vehicle.
This **does not** bypass [GM:CanPlayerEnterVehicle](/gmod/GM:CanPlayerEnterVehicle).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: vehicle
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Vehicle the player will enter

EquipSuit.DESCRIPTION:
Equips the player with the HEV suit.

Allows the player to zoom, walk slowly, sprint, pickup armor batteries, use the health and armor stations and also shows the HUD.
The player also emits a flatline sound on death, which can be overridden with [GM:PlayerDeathSound](/gmod/GM:PlayerDeathSound).

The player is automatically equipped with the suit on spawn, if you wish to stop that, use [Player:RemoveSuit](/gmod/Player:RemoveSuit).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: playEffects
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: If set to `true`, play the suit glove admire animation if player is holding no weapons.

ExitLadder.DESCRIPTION: Forces the player off the current ladder if they are on one.

ExitVehicle.DESCRIPTION:
Forces the player to exit the vehicle if they're in one.

This function will bypass [GM:CanExitVehicle](/gmod/GM:CanExitVehicle). See also [GM:PlayerLeaveVehicle](/gmod/GM:PlayerLeaveVehicle)

Flashlight.DESCRIPTION:
Enables/Disables the player's flashlight.

[Player:CanUseFlashlight](/gmod/Player:CanUseFlashlight) must be true in order for the player's flashlight to be changed.
[GM:PlayerSwitchFlashlight](/gmod/GM:PlayerSwitchFlashlight) can block this function.
NOTES:
Added in [2025.11.12](https://gmod.facepunch.com/changelist/4026), the `gmod_flashlight` attachment is used as a source for the player's flashlight. In thirdperson, the playermodel and weapon worldmodel are checked; in firstperson, the viewmodel is checked. If the attachment isn't found, default engine functionality is used.

The light sprite attached to the playermodel when the flashlight is on will also follow the playermodel's `gmod_flashlight` attachment if it exists.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: isOn
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Turns the flashlight on/off

FlashlightIsOn.DESCRIPTION: Returns true if the player's flashlight is on.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the player's flashlight is on.

Frags.DESCRIPTION: Returns the amount of frags a player has.
NOTES: The value will change depending on the player's kill or suicide: +1 for a kill, -1 for a suicide.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: frags

Freeze.DESCRIPTION:
Freeze the player. Frozen players cannot move, look around, or attack. Key bindings are still called. Similar to [Player:Lock](/gmod/Player:Lock) but the player can still take damage.

Manages the [FL_FROZEN](/gmod/Enums/FL#FL_FROZEN) flag on the player.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: frozen
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the player should be frozen.

GetActiveWeapon.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the player's active weapon.

If used on a [LocalPlayer](/gmod/Global.LocalPlayer)() and the player is spectating another player with `OBS_MODE_IN_EYE`, the weapon returned will be of the spectated player.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The weapon the player currently has equipped or NULL if the player doesn't have an active weapon eg. when they're dead.

RETURNS.NAME: act
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The player's current activity. See [ACT](/gmod/Enums/ACT).

GetAimVector.DESCRIPTION: Returns the direction that the player is aiming.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The direction vector of players aim

GetAllowFullRotation.DESCRIPTION: Returns true if the players' model is allowed to rotate around the pitch and roll axis.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Allowed

GetAllowWeaponsInVehicle.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether the player is allowed to use their weapons in a vehicle or not.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the player is allowed to use their weapons in a vehicle or not.

GetAmmo.DESCRIPTION: Returns a table of all ammo the player has.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION:
A table with the following format
* [number](/gmod/number) Key - AmmoID to be used with functions like [game.GetAmmoName](/gmod/game.GetAmmoName).
* [number](/gmod/number) Value - Amount of ammo the player has of this kind.

GetAmmoCount.DESCRIPTION: Gets the amount of ammo the player has.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: ammotype
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The ammunition type. Can be either [number](/gmod/number) ammo ID or [string](/gmod/string) ammo name.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The amount of ammo player has in reserve.

GetAvoidPlayers.DESCRIPTION: Gets if the player will be pushed out of nocollided players.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: pushed

GetCanWalk.DESCRIPTION: Returns true if the player is able to walk using the (default) alt key.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: AbleToWalk

GetCanZoom.DESCRIPTION: Determines whenever the player is allowed to use the zoom functionality.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: canZoom
The player's class id.

GetCount.DESCRIPTION:
Gets the total amount of entities of an entity type added by [Player:AddCount](/gmod/Player:AddCount).

Default types:
```
balloons
buttons
cameras
dynamite
effects
emitters
hoverballs
lamps
lights
npcs
props
ragdolls
sents
thrusters
vehicles
wheels
```
NOTES: This function is only available in Sandbox and its derivatives.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: type
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Type to get entity count of.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: minus
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: If specified, it will reduce the counter by this value. Works only serverside.

RETURNS.NAME: count
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The returned count.

GetCrouchedWalkSpeed.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the crouched walk speed multiplier.

See also [Player:GetWalkSpeed](/gmod/Player:GetWalkSpeed) and [Player:SetCrouchedWalkSpeed](/gmod/Player:SetCrouchedWalkSpeed).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The crouched walk speed multiplier.

GetCurrentCommand.DESCRIPTION: Returns the last command which was sent by the specified player. This can only be called on the player which [GetPredictionPlayer](/gmod/Global.GetPredictionPlayer)() returns.

BUGS.DESCRIPTION: This will fail in [GM:StartCommand](/gmod/GM:StartCommand).

NOTES: When called clientside in singleplayer during [WEAPON:Think](/gmod/WEAPON:Think), it will return nothing as the hook is not technically predicted in that instance. See the note on the page.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Last user commands

GetCurrentViewOffset.DESCRIPTION:
Gets the current applied view offset, which transitions between the player's standing and ducked view offset depending on their duck state.

Do not confuse with [Player:GetViewOffset](/gmod/Player:GetViewOffset) and [Player:GetViewOffsetDucked](/gmod/Player:GetViewOffsetDucked), which always return the standing or ducked offset respectively.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The actual view offset.

GetDrivingEntity.DESCRIPTION: Gets the entity the player is currently driving via the [drive](/gmod/drive) library.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The currently driven entity, or NULL entity

GetDrivingMode.DESCRIPTION: Returns driving mode of the player. See [Entity Driving](/gmod/Entity%20Driving).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The drive mode ID or 0 if player doesn't use the drive system.

GetDuckSpeed.DESCRIPTION: Returns a player's duck speed (in seconds)

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: duckspeed

GetEntityInUse.DESCRIPTION: Returns the entity the player is currently using, like func_tank mounted turrets or +use prop pickups.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Entity in use, or NULL entity otherwise. For +use prop pickups, this will be NULL clientside.

GetEyeTrace.DESCRIPTION:
Returns a table with information of what the player is looking at.

The results of this function are **cached** clientside every frame.

Uses [util.GetPlayerTrace](/gmod/util.GetPlayerTrace) internally and is therefore bound by its limits.

See also [Player:GetEyeTraceNoCursor](/gmod/Player:GetEyeTraceNoCursor).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Trace information, see [Structures/TraceResult](/gmod/Structures/TraceResult).

GetEyeTraceNoCursor.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the trace according to the players view direction, ignoring their mouse (holding  and moving the mouse in Sandbox).

The results of this function are **cached** clientside every frame.

Uses [util.GetPlayerTrace](/gmod/util.GetPlayerTrace) internally and is therefore bound by its limits.

See also [Player:GetEyeTrace](/gmod/Player:GetEyeTrace).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Trace result. See [Structures/TraceResult](/gmod/Structures/TraceResult).

GetFlashlightColor.DESCRIPTION: Returns the color of a player's flashlight.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Flashlight color

GetFOV.DESCRIPTION: Returns the FOV of the player.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Field of view as a float

GetFriendStatus.DESCRIPTION: Returns the steam "relationship" towards the player.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Should return one of four different things depending on their status on your friends list: "friend", "blocked", "none", "requested" or "error_nofriendid" for bots.

GetHands.DESCRIPTION: Gets the hands entity of a player

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The hands entity if players has one

GetHoveredWidget.DESCRIPTION: Returns the widget the player is hovering with their mouse.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The hovered widget.

GetHull.DESCRIPTION:
Retrieves the minimum and maximum [Vectors](/gmod/Vector) of the [Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minimum_bounding_box) used for the [Player's](/gmod/Player) physics and movement [Hull Traces](/gmod/util.TraceHull).

		See also: [Player:SetHull](/gmod/Player:SetHull), [Player:SetHullDuck](/gmod/Player:SetHullDuck), [Player:GetHullDuck](/gmod/Player:GetHullDuck)

RETURNS.NAME: mins
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The hull mins, the lowest corner of the Player's bounding box.

RETURNS.NAME: maxs
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The hull maxs, the highest corner of the Player's bounding box, opposite of the mins.

GetHullDuck.DESCRIPTION:
Retrieves the minimum and maximum [Vectors](/gmod/Vector) of the [Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minimum_bounding_box) used for the [Player's](/gmod/Player) physics and movement [Hull Traces](/gmod/util.TraceHull) while they are crouching (or "Ducking").

		See also: [Player:SetHullDuck](/gmod/Player:SetHullDuck), [Player:GetHull](/gmod/Player:GetHull), [Player:SetHull](/gmod/Player:SetHull)

RETURNS.NAME: mins
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The hull mins, the lowest corner of the Player's bounding box while crouching.

RETURNS.NAME: maxs
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The hull maxs, the highest corner of the Player's crouching bounding box, opposite of the mins.

GetInfo.DESCRIPTION:
Retrieves the value of a client-side [ConVar](/gmod/ConVar). The [ConVar](/gmod/ConVar) must have a [FCVAR_USERINFO](/gmod/Enums/FCVAR) flag for this to work.

On client this function will return value of the local player, regardless of which player the function was called on!

See [Player:GetInfoNum](/gmod/Player:GetInfoNum) for the same function that automatically converts the string to a number.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: convarName
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The name of the client-side [ConVar](/gmod/ConVar).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The value of the [ConVar](/gmod/ConVar). Will return empty string if the convar doesn't exist (when called on the server), or `nil` when called on client, or the convar is blacklisted, such as password convars (both realms).
WARNINGS: The returned value is truncated to 259 bytes.

GetInfoNum.DESCRIPTION: Retrieves the numeric value of a client-side convar, returns nil if value is not convertible to a number. The [ConVar](/gmod/ConVar) must have a [FCVAR_USERINFO](/gmod/Enums/FCVAR) flag for this to work.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: cVarName
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The name of the [ConVar](/gmod/ConVar) to query the value of

ARGUMENTS.NAME: default
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Default value if we failed to retrieve the number.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The value of the [ConVar](/gmod/ConVar) or the default value

GetJumpPower.DESCRIPTION: Returns the jump power of the player

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Jump power

GetLadderClimbSpeed.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the player's ladder climbing speed.

See [Player:GetWalkSpeed](/gmod/Player:GetWalkSpeed) for normal walking speed, [Player:GetRunSpeed](/gmod/Player:GetRunSpeed) for sprinting speed and [Player:GetSlowWalkSpeed](/gmod/Player:GetSlowWalkSpeed) for slow walking speed.

RETURNS.NAME: speed
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The ladder climbing speed.

GetLaggedMovementValue.DESCRIPTION: Returns the timescale multiplier of the player movement.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The timescale multiplier, defaults to `1`.

GetMaxArmor.DESCRIPTION: Returns the maximum amount of armor the player should have. Default value is 100.

RETURNS.NAME: maxarmor
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The new max armor value

GetMaxSpeed.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the player's maximum movement speed.

See also [Player:SetMaxSpeed](/gmod/Player:SetMaxSpeed), [Player:GetWalkSpeed](/gmod/Player:GetWalkSpeed) and [Player:GetRunSpeed](/gmod/Player:GetRunSpeed).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The maximum movement speed the player can go at.

GetName.DESCRIPTION: Returns the player's name, this is an alias of [Player:Nick](/gmod/Player:Nick).
DEPRECATED: Use Player:Nick.
NOTES: This function overrides [Entity:GetName](/gmod/Entity:GetName) (in the Lua metatable, not in c++), keep it in mind when dealing with [ents.FindByName](/gmod/ents.FindByName) or any engine function which requires the mapping name.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The player's name.

GetNoCollideWithTeammates.DESCRIPTION: Returns whenever the player is set not to collide with their teammates.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: noCollideWithTeammates

GetObserverMode.DESCRIPTION: Returns the the observer mode of the player

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Observe mode of that player, see [OBS_MODE](/gmod/Enums/OBS_MODE).

GetObserverTarget.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the entity the player is currently observing.

Set using [Player:SpectateEntity](/gmod/Player:SpectateEntity).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The entity the player is currently spectating, or [NULL](/gmod/Global_Variables) if the player has no target.

GetPData.DESCRIPTION:
Returns a **P**ersistent **Data** key-value pair from the SQL database. (`sv.db` when called on server, `cl.db` when called on client)

Internally uses the [sql](/gmod/sql) library. See [util.GetPData](/gmod/util.GetPData) for cases when the player is not currently on the server.
NOTES: PData is not networked from servers to clients!

This function internally uses [Player:SteamID64](/gmod/Player:SteamID64), it previously utilized [Player:UniqueID](/gmod/Player:UniqueID) which can cause collisions (two or more players sharing the same PData entry). [Player:SetPData](/gmod/Player:SetPData) now replaces all instances of [Player:UniqueID](/gmod/Player:UniqueID) with [Player:SteamID64](/gmod/Player:SteamID64) when running [Player:SetPData](/gmod/Player:SetPData)

ARGUMENTS.NAME: key
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Name of the PData key

ARGUMENTS.NAME: default
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Default value if PData key doesn't exist.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The data in the SQL database or the default value given.

GetPlayerColor.DESCRIPTION:
Returns a player's character model color.

The part of the model that is colored is determined by the model's materials, and is therefore different for each model.

See [Player:GetWeaponColor](/gmod/Player:GetWeaponColor) for the accompanying function for the weapon color.
NOTES: Override this function clientside on any Entity (including a player) with a supported model set (such as default player models) and returned color will apply to the model. This is done via the `PlayerColor` [matproxy](/gmod/matproxy).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The format is `Vector(r,g,b)`, and each color component should be between 0 and 1.

GetPlayerInfo.DESCRIPTION: Returns a table containing player information.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: A table containing player information.

GetPreferredCarryAngles.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the preferred carry angles of an object, if any are set.

Calls [GM:GetPreferredCarryAngles](/gmod/GM:GetPreferredCarryAngles) with the target entity and returns the carry angles.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: carryEnt
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Entity to retrieve the carry angles of.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Carry angles or nil if the entity has no preferred carry angles.

GetPressedWidget.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the widget entity the player is using.

Having a pressed widget stops the player from firing their weapon to allow input to be passed onto the widget.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The pressed widget.

GetPreviousWeapon.DESCRIPTION: Returns the weapon the player previously had equipped.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The previous weapon of the player.
WARNINGS: This is not guaranteed to be a weapon entity so it should be checked with [Entity:IsWeapon](/gmod/Entity:IsWeapon) for safety.

GetPunchAngle.DESCRIPTION: Returns players screen punch effect angle. See [Player:ViewPunch](/gmod/Player:ViewPunch) and [Player:SetViewPunchAngles](/gmod/Player:SetViewPunchAngles)
DEPRECATED: You should use Player:GetViewPunchAngles instead.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The punch angle

GetRagdollEntity.DESCRIPTION: Returns players death ragdoll. The ragdoll is created by [Player:CreateRagdoll](/gmod/Player:CreateRagdoll).
NOTES: Calling [Entity:GetPos](/gmod/Entity:GetPos) server-side with this function then will return the position where [Player:CreateRagdoll](/gmod/Player:CreateRagdoll) was used, as it is a hl2mp_ragdoll which is a serverside point entity that creates a clientside ragdoll for everyone (opposed to prop_ragdoll that is serverside and networks).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION:
The ragdoll.

Unlike normal clientside ragdolls (`C_ClientRagdoll`), this will be a `C_HL2MPRagdoll` on the client, and `hl2mp_ragdoll` on the server.

GetRenderAngles.DESCRIPTION: Returns the render angles for the player.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The render angles of the player. Only **yaw** part of the angle seems to be present.

GetRunSpeed.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the player's sprint speed.

See also [Player:SetRunSpeed](/gmod/Player:SetRunSpeed), [Player:GetWalkSpeed](/gmod/Player:GetWalkSpeed) and [Player:GetMaxSpeed](/gmod/Player:GetMaxSpeed).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The sprint speed

GetShootPos.DESCRIPTION: Returns the position of a Player's view
NOTES: This is the same as calling [Entity:EyePos](/gmod/Entity:EyePos) on the player.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The position of the player's view.

GetSlowWalkSpeed.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the player's slow walking speed, which is activated via  keybind.

See [Player:GetWalkSpeed](/gmod/Player:GetWalkSpeed) for normal walking speed, [Player:GetRunSpeed](/gmod/Player:GetRunSpeed) for sprinting speed and [Player:GetLadderClimbSpeed](/gmod/Player:GetLadderClimbSpeed) for ladder climb speed.

RETURNS.NAME: speed
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The new slow walking speed.

GetStepSize.DESCRIPTION: Returns the maximum height player can step onto.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The maximum height player can get up onto without jumping, in hammer units.

GetSuitPower.DESCRIPTION: Returns the player's HEV suit power.

BUGS.DESCRIPTION: This will only work for the local player when used clientside.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The current suit power.

GetTimeoutSeconds.DESCRIPTION: Returns the number of seconds that the player has been timing out for. You can check if a player is timing out with [Player:IsTimingOut](/gmod/Player:IsTimingOut).
NOTES: This function is relatively useless because it is tied to the value of the `sv_timeout` ConVar, which is irrelevant to the description above. [This is not considered as a bug](https://discord.com/channels/565105920414318602/567617926991970306/748970396224585738).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Timeout seconds.

GetTool.DESCRIPTION: Returns [TOOL](/gmod/Structures/TOOL) table of players current tool, or of the one specified.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: mode
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Classname of the tool to retrieve. ( Filename of the tool in gmod_tool/stools/ )

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: TOOL table, or nil if the table wasn't found or the player doesn't have a tool gun.

GetUnDuckSpeed.DESCRIPTION: Returns a player's unduck speed (in seconds)

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: unduck speed

GetUseEntity.DESCRIPTION: Returns the entity the player would use if they would press their `+use` keybind.
NOTES:
Because entity physics objects usually do not exist on the client, the client's use entity will resolve to whatever the crosshair is placed on within a little less than 72 units of the player's eye position. This differs from the entity returned by the server, which has fully physical use checking. See [util.TraceHull](/gmod/util.TraceHull).

Issue tracker: [5027](https://github.com/Facepunch/garrysmod-issues/issues/5027)

RETURNS.NAME: ent
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The entity that would be used or NULL.

GetUserGroup.DESCRIPTION: Returns the player's user group. By default, player user groups are loaded from `garrysmod/settings/users.txt`.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The user group of the player. This will return `"user"` if player has no user group.

GetVehicle.DESCRIPTION: Returns the vehicle the player is driving.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION:
The vehicle the player is currently driving, if any.

Returns [NULL](/gmod/NULL) entity if the player is not driving.

GetViewEntity.DESCRIPTION: Returns the entity the player is using to see from (such as the player itself, the camera, or another entity).
NOTES: This function will not return the currently spectated entity. See [Player:GetObserverTarget](/gmod/Player:GetObserverTarget).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The entity the player is using to see from

GetViewModel.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the player's view model entity by the index.
Each player has 3 view models by default, but only the first one is used.

To use the other viewmodels in your SWEP, see [Entity:SetWeaponModel](/gmod/Entity:SetWeaponModel).
NOTES: In the Client [realm](/gmod/States), other players' viewmodels are not available unless they are being spectated.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: index
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: optional index of the view model to return, can range from 0 to 2

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The view model entity

GetViewOffset.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the view offset of the player, which equals the difference between the player's actual position and their view when standing.

See also [Player:GetViewOffsetDucked](/gmod/Player:GetViewOffsetDucked).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: New view offset, must be local vector to player's [Entity:GetPos](/gmod/Entity:GetPos)

GetViewOffsetDucked.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the ducked view offset of the player, which equals the difference between the player's actual position and their view when ducked.

See also [Player:GetViewOffset](/gmod/Player:GetViewOffset).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: New crouching view offset, must be local vector to player's [Entity:GetPos](/gmod/Entity:GetPos)

GetViewPunchAngles.DESCRIPTION: Returns players screen punch effect angle.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The punch angle

GetViewPunchVelocity.DESCRIPTION: Returns client's view punch velocity. See [Player:ViewPunch](/gmod/Player:ViewPunch) and [Player:SetViewPunchVelocity](/gmod/Player:SetViewPunchVelocity)

RETURNS.NAME: punchVel
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The current view punch angle velocity.

GetVoiceVolumeScale.DESCRIPTION: Returns the current voice volume scale for given player on client.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The voice volume scale, where 0 is 0% and 1 is 100%.

GetWalkSpeed.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the player's normal walking speed. Not sprinting, not slow walking. (+walk)

See also [Player:SetWalkSpeed](/gmod/Player:SetWalkSpeed), [Player:GetMaxSpeed](/gmod/Player:GetMaxSpeed) and [Player:GetRunSpeed](/gmod/Player:GetRunSpeed).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The normal walking speed.

GetWeapon.DESCRIPTION: Returns the weapon for the specified class

ARGUMENTS.NAME: className
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Class name of weapon

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The weapon for the specified class, or NULL ENTITY if the player does not have this weapon.

GetWeaponColor.DESCRIPTION:
Returns a player's weapon color.

The part of the model that is colored is determined by the model itself, and is different for each model. 

See [Player:GetPlayerColor](/gmod/Player:GetPlayerColor) for the accompanying function for the player character model color.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The format is `Vector(r,g,b)`, and each color should be between 0 and 1.

GetWeapons.DESCRIPTION: Returns a table of the player's weapons.
NOTES: This function returns a sequential table. Prefer to loop it with [ipairs](/gmod/Global.ipairs) instead of the [pairs](/gmod/Global.pairs) function.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: All the weapons the player currently has.

Give.DESCRIPTION:
Gives the player a weapon.

This function will call [GM:PlayerCanPickupWeapon](/gmod/GM:PlayerCanPickupWeapon). If that hook returns false, this function will do nothing.
NOTES: While this function is meant for weapons/pickupables only, it is **not** restricted to weapons. Any entity can be spawned using this function, including NPCs and SENTs.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: weaponClassName
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Class name of weapon to give the player

ARGUMENTS.NAME: bNoAmmo
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Set to true to not give any ammo on weapon spawn. (Reserve ammo set by DefaultClip)

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The weapon given to the player, if one was given. It will return NULL if the player already has the weapon, or the weapon entity (entity with given classname) doesn't exist.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: amount
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Amount of ammo

ARGUMENTS.NAME: type
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION:
Type of ammo.
This is a string for named ammo types, and a number for ammo ID.

You can find a list of default ammo types [here](/gmod/Default_Ammo_Types).

ARGUMENTS.NAME: hidePopup
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Hide display popup when giving the ammo

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Ammo given.

GodDisable.DESCRIPTION: Disables god mode on the player. Removes the [FL_GODMODE](/gmod/Enums/FL#FL_GODMODE) flag from the player.

GodEnable.DESCRIPTION: Enables god mode on the player. Adds the [FL_GODMODE](/gmod/Enums/FL#FL_GODMODE) flag to the player.

HasGodMode.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether the player has god mode or not, contolled by [Player:GodEnable](/gmod/Player:GodEnable) and [Player:GodDisable](/gmod/Player:GodDisable).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the player has god mode or not.

HasWeapon.DESCRIPTION: Returns if the player has the specified weapon

ARGUMENTS.NAME: className
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Class name of the weapon

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: True if the player has the weapon

InVehicle.DESCRIPTION: Returns if the player is in a vehicle

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the player is in a vehicle.

IPAddress.DESCRIPTION: Returns the player's IP address and connection port in ip:port form
NOTES: Returns `Error!` for bots.

RETURNS.NAME: ip
RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The player's IP address and connection port

IsAdmin.DESCRIPTION:
Returns whether the player is an admin or not. It will also return `true` if the player is [Player:IsSuperAdmin](/gmod/Player:IsSuperAdmin) by default.

Internally this is determined by [Player:IsUserGroup](/gmod/Player:IsUserGroup).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: True if the player is an admin or a super admin.

IsBot.DESCRIPTION: Returns if the player is an bot or not

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: `true` if the player is a bot.

IsConnected.DESCRIPTION: Returns true from the point when the player is sending client info but not fully in the game until they disconnect.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: isConnected

IsDrivingEntity.DESCRIPTION: Used to find out if a player is currently 'driving' an entity (by which we mean 'right click > drive' ).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: A value representing whether or not the player is 'driving' an entity.

IsFrozen.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether the players movement is currently frozen, controlled by [Player:Freeze](/gmod/Player:Freeze).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the players movement is currently frozen or not.

IsFullyAuthenticated.DESCRIPTION:
Returns whether the player identity was confirmed by the Steam network.

See also [GM:NetworkIDValidated](/gmod/GM:NetworkIDValidated).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION:
Whether the player has been fully authenticated or not.

This will always be true for singleplayer and the listen server host.
This will always be false for bots.

IsListenServerHost.DESCRIPTION: Returns if a player is the host of the current session.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION:
`true` if the player is the listen server host, `false` otherwise.

This will always be `true` in single player, and `false` on a dedicated server.

IsMuted.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether or not the player is voice muted locally.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: whether or not the player is muted locally.

IsPlayingTaunt.DESCRIPTION: Returns true if the player is playing a taunt.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the player is playing a taunt.

IsSpeaking.DESCRIPTION: Returns whenever the player is heard by the local player clientside, or if the player is speaking serverside.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Is the player speaking or not.

IsSprinting.DESCRIPTION:
Returns whether the player is currently sprinting or not, specifically if they are holding their sprint key and are allowed to sprint.

This will not check if the player is currently sprinting into a wall. (i.e. holding their sprint key but not moving)

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Is the player sprinting or not

IsSuitEquipped.DESCRIPTION: Returns whenever the player is equipped with the suit item.

BUGS.DESCRIPTION: This will only work for the local player when used clientside.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Is the suit equipped or not.

IsSuperAdmin.DESCRIPTION:
Returns whether the player is a super admin.

Internally this is determined by [Player:IsUserGroup](/gmod/Player:IsUserGroup). See also [Player:IsAdmin](/gmod/Player:IsAdmin).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: True if the player is a super admin.

IsTimingOut.DESCRIPTION:
Returns `true` if the player is timing out (i.e. is losing connection), `false` otherwise.

A player is considered timing out when more than 4 seconds has elapsed since a network packet was received from given player.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the player is timing out.

IsTyping.DESCRIPTION:
Returns whether the player is typing in their chat.

This may not work properly if the server uses a custom chatbox.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the player is typing in their chat or not.

IsUserGroup.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether the player is in specified group or not. See [Player:GetUserGroup](/gmod/Player:GetUserGroup) for a way to get player's user group.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: groupName
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Group to check the player for.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: `true` if the player has the given user group.

IsVoiceAudible.DESCRIPTION: Returns if the player can be heard by the local player.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: isAudible

IsWalking.DESCRIPTION: Returns if the player currently walking. (`+walk` keybind)

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: `true` if the player is currently walking.

IsWorldClicking.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether the player is using the world clicking feature, see [Panel:SetWorldClicker](/gmod/Panel:SetWorldClicker)

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Is the player world clicking or not.

IsWorldClickingDisabled.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether the world clicking is disabled for given player or not. See [Player:DisableWorldClicking](/gmod/Player:DisableWorldClicking).

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Whether the world clicking is disabled or not.

KeyDown.DESCRIPTION: Returns whether a key is down. This is not networked to other players, meaning only the local client can see the keys they are pressing.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: key
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The key, see [IN](/gmod/Enums/IN)

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: whether the key is down or not.

KeyDownLast.DESCRIPTION: Gets whether a key was down one tick ago.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: key
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The key, see [IN](/gmod/Enums/IN)

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Is key down ?

KeyPressed.DESCRIPTION: Gets whether a key was just pressed this tick.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: key
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Corresponds to an [IN](/gmod/Enums/IN). You can use [bit.bor](/gmod/bit.bor) here (see example 2)

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Was pressed or not

KeyReleased.DESCRIPTION: Gets whether a key was just released this tick.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: key
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The key, see [IN](/gmod/Enums/IN)

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Was released or not

Kick.DESCRIPTION: Kicks the player from the server.
NOTES: This can not be run before the player has fully joined in. Use [game.KickID](/gmod/game.KickID) for that.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: reason
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Reason to show for disconnection.
WARNINGS: This will be shortened to ~512 chars, though this includes the command itself and the player index so will realistically be more around ~498. It is recommended to avoid going near the limit to avoid truncation.

KillSilent.DESCRIPTION:
Kills a player without notifying the rest of the server.

This will call [GM:PlayerSilentDeath](/gmod/GM:PlayerSilentDeath) instead of [GM:PlayerDeath](/gmod/GM:PlayerDeath).

LagCompensation.DESCRIPTION:
This allows the server to mitigate the lag of the player by moving back all the entities that can be lag compensated to the time the player attacked with his weapon.

This technique is most commonly used on things that hit other entities instantaneously, such as traces.



Lag compensation only works for players and entities that have been enabled with [Entity:SetLagCompensated](/gmod/Entity:SetLagCompensated)

Despite being defined shared, it can only be used server-side in a [Predicted Hook](/gmod/~search?q=%3Cpredicted%3EYes).

BUGS.DESCRIPTION: Lag compensation does not support pose parameters.

NOTES: [Entity:FireBullets](/gmod/Entity:FireBullets) calls this function internally.
WARNINGS: This function NEEDS to be disabled after you're done with it or it will break the movement of the entities affected!

ARGUMENTS.NAME: lagCompensation
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: The state of the lag compensation, true to enable and false to disable.

LastHitGroup.DESCRIPTION: Returns the hitgroup where the player was last hit.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Hitgroup, see [HITGROUP](/gmod/Enums/HITGROUP)

NOTES: This function is only available in Sandbox and its derivatives.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: type
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Type of hit limit.

LocalEyeAngles.DESCRIPTION:
Returns the direction a player is looking as a entity/local-oriented angle.

Unlike [Entity:EyeAngles](/gmod/Entity:EyeAngles), this function does not include angles of the Player's [Entity:GetParent](/gmod/Entity:GetParent).

BUGS.DESCRIPTION: Does not work correctly clientside for non local players when in a vehicle. (validate: when parented in general?)

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: The local eye angles.

Lock.DESCRIPTION:
Stops a player from using any inputs, such as moving, turning, or attacking. Key binds are still called. Similar to [Player:Freeze](/gmod/Player:Freeze) but the player takes no damage.

Adds the [FL_FROZEN](/gmod/Enums/FL) and [FL_GODMODE](/gmod/Enums/FL) flags to the player.

MotionSensorPos.DESCRIPTION: Returns the position of a Kinect bone.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: bone
ARGUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Bone to get the position of. Must be from 0 to 19.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Position of the bone.

Name.DESCRIPTION: Returns the player's nick name. Identical to [Player:Nick](/gmod/Player:Nick) and [Player:GetName](/gmod/Player:GetName).
DEPRECATED: Use Player:Nick.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Player's name.

Nick.DESCRIPTION: Returns the player's nick name also known as display name, as it appears in Steam.

RETURNS.DESCRIPTION: Player's nick name

OwnerSteamID64.DESCRIPTION:
